trg: Centre ya ke talaka bitembo ya kigonsa to National Hurricane Center (NHC) ke tuba nde na mpila yayi, Jerry kele kigonsa mosi ve sambu na ntoto.

src: The U.S. Corps of Engineers estimated that 6 inches of rainfall could breach the previously damaged levees.
trg: Kimvuka ya ba Ingenieurs ya Etats-Unis kana mvula kuyika ata 6 metre ya mvula na yo, yo lenda buka lupangu ya kukanga masa ya yitaka kubeba.

src: The Ninth Ward, which saw flooding as high as 20 feet during Hurricane Katrina, is currently in waist-high water as the nearby levee was overtopped.
trg: Sumbulu ya ivwa, yina ya monaka mvula kumata zulu na metre 6.096 na ntangu ya mvula ya mipepe Hurricane Katrina, kele ntangu yai na nda ya luketu mpamba ve lupangu ya nsi masa pasulaka yo.

src: Water is spilling over the levee in a section 100 feet wide.
trg: Masa ke panzana na zulu ya kibaka ya bo kangaka na kitini mosi ya metre 30.48 na nene.

src: Commons Administrator Adam Cuerden expressed his frustration over the deletions when he spoke to Wikinews last month.
trg: Nzo ya kisalu ya bakommune Adam Cuerden yo tadisaka kukatula na yo na ntangu bo solulaka ti Wikinews na ngonda kulutaka.

src: "He [Wales] basically lied to us from the start. First, by acting as if this was for legal reasons. Second, by pretending he was listening to us, right up to his art deletion."
trg: "Yandi [Wales] kusaka beto na yonso tuka na luyantiku. Ntete, na kusalaka bonso nde yai vandaka kikuma ya kieleka. Ya zole, na kusalaka nde yandi vandaka kuwila beto, tii na kuvwansa yina yandi salaka."

src: The community irritation led to current efforts to draft a policy regarding sexual content for the site which hosts millions of openly-licensed media.
trg: Kutatika ya bantu yo nataka na makambu ya bubu sambu na kusala politiki ya ke tala dikambu ya sexuel sambu na site ya bamilion ya bamedia ke salamaka na licence ouverte.

src: The work done was mostly theoretical, but the program was written to simulate observations made of the Sagittarius galaxy.
trg: Kisalu yina salamaka vandaka mingi kaka kinzonzi, kansi pologalame sonamaka sambu na kupesa mvingu na binotika ya Galakisi ya Sagittaire yina salamaka.

src: The effect the team was looking for would be caused by tidal forces between the galaxy's dark matter and the Milky Way's dark matter.
trg: Mambu yina ekipe vandaka kusosa katukaka na bangolo ya kubendana na kati ya bima ya ndombe ya galaxie mpi bima ya ndombe ya Voie lactée.

src: Just like the moon exerts a pull on the earth, causing tides, so does the Milky Way exert a force on the Sagittarius galaxy.
trg: Mutindu ngonda ke bendaka ntoto, yo basisaka poto-poto, la Voie lactée ke bendaka galaxie Sagittaire.

src: The scientists were able to conclude that the dark matter affect other dark matter in the same way regular matter does.
trg: Bantu ya siansi kukaka kutuba nde kima ya mpimpa ke bebisaka bima ya nkaka ya kitombe ne nzila mosi mpi na kima ya mbote.

src: This theory says that most dark matter around a galaxy is located around a galaxy in a kind of halo, and is made of lots of small particles.
trg: Dilongi yayi me tuba mambu ya mpimpa na ntoto kele na ntoto mutindu matadi, na me yilama na matidi ya fyoti mingi.

src: Television reports show white smoke coming from the plant.
trg: Rapports ya Television ke songa midinga ya mpembe kwisa katuka na mwa banti.

src: Local authorities are warning residents in the vicinity of the plant to stay indoors, turn off air-conditioners and not to drink tap water.
trg: Bamfumu ya bwala ke na kubenda makutu ya bantu ya bwala na nkinzi ya kuvanda na bifulu na kati ya banzo, yo ke kuzwa kisika ya baKilimatizere na yo ke sosaka ve masa ya lobine.

src: According to Japan's nuclear agency, radioactive caesium and iodine has been identified at the plant.
trg: Na kizonzi ya nzo ke talaka mambu ya minduki ya nene ya Japon, radioactive na iode talanaka na kisika na yo.

src: Authorities speculate that this indicates that containers holding uranium fuel at the site may have ruptured and are leaking.
trg: Banfumu kele baka ngindu nde yayi kele monisa nde bangungulu yayi kele na petrole ya uranium na site yo lenda beba mpi kutangisa masa malembe.

src: Dr. Tony Moll discovered the Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberculosis (XDR-TB) in the South African region KwaZulu-Natal.
trg: Munganga Tony Moll me mona nde maladi ya tuberculose ke manaka ve na nkisi (XDR-TB) na provense ya Afrika ya Sude, KwaZulu-Natal.

src: In an interview, he said the new variant was "very highly troubling and alarming because of the very high fatality rate."
trg: Na disolo mosi, yandi tubaka mpila ya mpa yo vandaka "ya mutungisi mpi na yayi ke tala mpila bantu mingi kele na kufwa."

src: Some patients might have contracted the bug in the hospital, Dr. Moll thinks, and at least two were hospital health workers.
trg: Bambefo ya nkaka kubakaka mukolobe/virus yina na lopitalo, Dr. Moll ke yindila, mpi na fioti zole vandaka bisadi minganga ya lopitalo.

src: In one year's time, an infected person may infect 10 to 15 close contacts.
trg: Na mvula mosi ke kwisa, mbefo mosi lenda kupesa dyaka kimbefo na bantu 10 to 15 yina yansi ke vukana na bo.

src: However, the percentage of XDR-TB in the entire group of people with tuberculosis still seems to be low; 6,000 of the total 330,000 people infected at any particular moment in South Africa.
trg: Na lweka ya kaka, ntalu ya XDR-TB na kati ya kikunku yonso ya bantu ke na kimbefo ya kukosula ya ngolo ke ntete ya kukuluka, 6.000 kati na bantu 330.000 kele na kimbefo na konso tangu na Afrika ya banda.

src: The satellites, both of which weighed in excess of 1,000 pounds, and traveling at approximately 17,500 miles per hour, collided 491 miles above the Earth.
trg: Basatellite, yayi kuvalutaka yonso zolo kuluta balivre 1 000 ti yo vandaka kutambula 17 500 ya bametre na ntangu mosi, yo kutanaka na 491 ya bametre na zulu ya Ntoto.

src: Scientists say the explosion caused by the collision was massive.
trg: Bantu ya siansi tubaka kumwana na kuloka ya nene ya kima katukaka na kuvukana ya bima zole vandaka ya ngolo ya kulutila.

src: They are still trying to determine just how large the crash was and how the Earth will be affected.
trg: Bo vandaka meka kuyindula mutindu kumwangana ya avio salamaka ngolo na mutindu Ntoto lenda ku vanda na mpasi.

src: The United States Strategic Command of the U.S. Department of Defense office is tracking the debris.
trg: Kikunku ya Bansosa ya biwani ya Etats Unis, ya ministere ya defence ke landdila bamvindu.

src: The result of plotting analysis will be posted to a public website.
trg: Nsuka ya kupasula banzila ya kutala kukabila ya ntoto na bitini ta zabisama na site interneti ya bantu yonso.

src: A doctor who worked at Children's Hospital of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania will be charged with aggravated murder after her mother was found dead in the trunk of her car Wednesday, authorities in Ohio say.
trg: Bamfumu ya Ohio, me tuba, munganga mosi ke salaka na lupitalu ya bana ya Pittsburgh, na Pennsylvanie ke zwa lukanu ya ba zuzi na yina me tadila lufwa ya nene na nima ya ku tala nitu ya mama ya yandi na nima ya kamio ya yandi.

src: Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, 29, was found in Blue Ash, Ohio, a suburb approximately 15 miles north of Cincinnati lying on the ground beside the road in a T-shirt and underwear in an apparently heavily medicated state.
trg: Bo talaka Munganga Malar Balasubramanian ya mvula 29, na Blue Ash Ohio, na bwala na yinda ya bamile 15 na Cincinnati ya norde vandaka lala na nganda ya nzila na Mariniere mpi billele ya yisi na kifwani ya bulawu.

src: She directed officers to her black Oldsmobile Intrigue which was 500 feet away.
trg: Yandi twadisaka bamfumu na Oldsmobile Intrigue noire yayi kuvandaka na bametre 500.

src: There, they found the body of Saroja Balasubramanian, 53, covered with blood-stained blankets.
trg: Kuna, ba talaka nitu ya Saroja Balasubramanian, mvula 53, zingamaka na mavunga ya menga.

src: Police said that the body appeared to have been there for about a day.
trg: Polisi kubaka nde nitu kuvandaka pana kubanda kilumbu mosi yayi.

src: The first cases of the disease this season were reported in late July.
trg: Bo monaka mbefo ya ntete na nsungi yai na nsuka ya ngonda ya Nsambwadi.

src: The disease is carried by pigs, which then migrates to humans through mosquitos.
trg: Kimbefo ke vandaka na bangulu, ebuna na nima bo ke pesaka yo na bantu na nzila ya bambembele.

src: The outbreak has prompted the Indian government to undertake such measures as deployment of pig catchers in seriously affected areas, distributing thousands of mosquito curtains and spraying pesticides.
trg: Makambu yina ya kubwaka me tinda mbula-matari ya Inde kubaka lukanu yina bonso kutanda bakangi ya ngulu na binziunga ya kuluta kubela, na kukabaka funda na funa ya mustkele mpi nkisi ya mbembele.

src: Several million vials of encephalitis vaccine have also been promised by the government, which will help prepare health agencies for next year.
trg: Luyalu me sila mpi na kupesa bamilio mingi ya milangi ya mangwele ya encéphalite to maladi ya ntu mpasi, yo ta sadisa bimvuka ya minganga na sambu na kuyilama sambu na mvula ke kwisa.

src: Plans for vaccines to be delivered to the historically most affected areas this year were delayed due to lack of funds and low prioritisation relative to other diseases.
trg: Ngindu sambu na nkisiya mangwele kukabulana na bisika ya beto waka nde kele bisika bantu me bela mingi mvula yai ta kwisa na nima sambu na kukonda mbongo mpi sambu na kutula diambu yina na nima ya bimbefo ya nkaka.

src: In 1956 Słania moved to Sweden, where three years later he began work for the Swedish Post Office and became their chief engraver.
trg: Na 1956 Stania kwendaka na swede, na nima ya bamvula tatu yandi bandaka kusala na nzo ya kufidisa mpi ku yamba mikanda ya Swede na kukuma mfumu ya bo.

src: He produced over 1,000 stamps for Sweden and 28 other countries.
trg: Yandi me kubasisa kulutila ya ba timbre 1000 ya Suède mpi 28 timbre ya ba insi ya nkaka.

src: His work is of such recognized quality and detail that he is one of the very few "household names" among philatelists. Some specialize in collecting his work alone.
trg: Kisalu na yandi kele ya mfunu mingi mpi ya dikambu yayi ke zabana nde yandi kele mosi ya "bazina me zabana" na kati ya baphilatéliste. Bankaka ke salaka na kati ya kisalu na yandi mosi.

src: His 1,000th stamp was the magnificent "Great Deeds by Swedish Kings" by David Klöcker Ehrenstrahl in 2000, which is listed in the Guinness Book of World Records.
trg: Ngunga na yandi ya mbala ya 1 000 vandaka "Bisalu ya Neneme salama na Mfumu ya Swede" na David Klöcker Ehrenstrahl na 2000, yai kele na kati ya buku Guinness ya makambu ya mbalu kuluta ya baisi ya mvimba.

src: He was also engaged in engraving banknotes for many countries, recent examples of his work including the Prime Ministerial portraits on the front of the new Canadian $5 and $100 bills.
trg: Yandi kudipesaka diaka na kusonika bamatiti ya mbongo ya banque sambu na ba insi mingi, ba mbandu ya sasaipi yai ya kisalu na yandi, kele bafoto ya premier ministre yai ya kele na ntwala ya dititi ya mpa ya 5 $ mpi 100 $ ya canada.

src: After the accident occurred, Gibson was transported to a hospital but died shortly afterwards.
trg: Na nima ya kigonsa, bo nataka Gibson na Lopitalo kansi yandi fwaka mwa ntangu fioti na nima.

src: The truck driver, who is aged 64, was not injured in the crash.
trg: Chauffeur ya kamio, ya bamvula 64, ya lwalaka ve na accident.Chauffeur ya kamio, ya bamvula 64, ya lwalaka ve na accident.

src: The vehicle itself was taken away from the scene of the accident at approximately 1200 GMT on the same day.
trg: Bo katulaka kamio yo mosi na kisika ya kisumbula pene-pene ya 12h00 GMT kaka na kilumbu yina.

src: A person working in a garage near where the accident occurred said: "There were children waiting to cross the road and they were all screaming and crying."
trg: Muntu mosi ke salaka na nzo ke ku yidikaka ba kamio kisika aksida me kusalama me kutuba: "bana vandaka kuvingila na kusabuka nzila na bo talaka boma mpi vandaka kudila".

src: They all ran back from where the accident had happened.
trg: Bo yonso tinaka ntinu kisika salamaka aksida.

src: Other subjects on the agenda in Bali include saving the world's remaining forests, and sharing technologies to help developing nations grow in less-polluting ways.
trg: Masolo ya nkaka ya vandaka na manaka ya Bali kele kutanina bamfinda ya ntoto ya mvimba ya me bikala, mpi kukabula teknolozi sambu na kusadisa bansi ya bunsukami na kuyela kukonda kubebisa mupepe mingi.

src: The U.N. also hopes to finalize a fund to help countries affected by global warming to cope with the impacts.
trg: Nations Unies ke tula kivuvu na kumanisa kutula mbongo sambu na kusadisa bansi ya bulama mingi na mpasi ya ntangu ya ngolo ya insi ya mvimba sambu na kusadisa mpasi na yo.

src: The money could go toward flood-proof houses, better water management, and crop diversification.
trg: Mbongo lenda sadisa ba nzo me kota na masa, yo kele mbote na kuvanda na politike ya kusadilaka masa mbote, na kukunda banti.

src: Fluke wrote that the efforts by some to drown out women from speaking out about women’s health were unsuccessful.
trg: Fluke sonikaka ti ngolo ya bankento na kuzonzila mambu ya mavimpi ya bankento ya nkaka zwaka mvutu ya mbote ve.

src: She came to this conclusion due to the multitude of positive comments and encouragement sent to her by both female and male individuals urging that contraception medication be considered a medical necessity.
trg: Yandi kangaka mambu sambu na bintona ya mbote mpi ngolo yina babakala mpi bankento fidisilaka yandi na kutuba ti nkisi ya kukanga nzila ya kuzua kivumu kele mfunu mingi.

src: When the fighting ceased after the wounded were transported to the hospital, about 40 of the other remaining inmates stayed in the yard and refused to return to their cells.
trg: Na ntangu ba manisaka mvita na nima yaina Bo nataka muntu lwalaka na lupitalu, 40 kati na bantu ya muvuzu vandaka ya nganda bo mangaka kuvutuka bifulu ya bo na boloko ya bo.

src: Negotiators tried to rectify the situation, but the prisoners' demands are not clear.
trg: Banégociateur bomekaka kubongisa dikambu, kansi kutelemila ya bantu ya boloko yo kele mbote ve.

src: Between 10:00-11:00 pm MDT, a fire was started by the inmates in the yard.
trg: Na katikati ya 10:00-11:00 tii na mpimpa, Ntangu ya Ngumba na Amerika, muntu mosi ya boloko tulaka tiya boloko.

src: Soon, officers equipped with riot gear entered the yard and cornered the inmates with tear gas.
trg: Ntama mingi ve, bantu ya kisalu yina vandaka ti bisadilu ya kupanza bantu ya mubulu mpi bo panzaka losilaka bantu ya boloko mopepe ya ke panzaka bantu.

src: Fire rescue crews eventually doused the fire by 11:35 pm.
trg: Binkuku ya kufwa tiya nungaka na kufwa tiya na ngunga ya 11:35 ya nkokila.

src: After the dam was built in 1963, the seasonal floods that would spread sediment throughout the river were halted.
trg: Na nima ya kuyidika kikaku na 1963, kufuluka ya bamasa yina salama sukaka.

src: This sediment was necessary for creating sandbars and beaches, which served as wildlife habitats.
trg: Sediment yayi vandaka nkinzi sambu na kuyidika dielo na ntwala ya mabundu, yina talanaka mutindu kisika bantu ke vandaka.

src: As a result, two fish species have become extinct, and two others have become endangered, including the humpback chub.
trg: Mutindu mvutu, bifwani ya bambisi zole me talana, na zole ya nkaka vandaka na mpasi, kubwela mbisi kele na nkunki, bake bingaka Chevesne à bosse.

src: Although the water level will only rise a few feet after the flood, officials are hoping it will be enough to restore eroded sandbars downstream.
trg: Ata ndilu ya masa vandaka kumata kaka mwa milimetre fioti na zulu na nima ya mvula, bamfumu ke na kivuvu yo ta lunga sambu na kuvutula ntoto yina kwendaka na masa.

src: No tsunami warning has been issued, and according to the Jakarta geophysics agency, no tsunami warning will be issued because the quake did not meet the magnitude 6.5 requirement.
trg: Na kutala bansangu yina nzo ke talaka mambu ya bansoba ya ntoto ya Jakarta, ata bitambi ya tsunami vandaka ve ya kutalana, tsunaùi ke kuvanda ve sambu ti ntoto me kuningisa ve ntoto na kiteso ya 6.5.

src: Despite there being no tsunami threat, residents started to panic and began to leave their businesses and homes.
trg: Ata kitembo ya nene ya tsunami nwanisaka bo ve, bantu ya bwala bandaka ku tala boma na bandaka kubika bisalu ya bo mpi banzo ya bo.

src: Although Winfrey was tearful in her farewell, she made it clear to her fans she will be back.
trg: Peleko Winfrey vanda kudila na ntangu yandi pesaka mbote ya nsuka, yandi bangulaka na bilandi ya yandi ti yandi ke kuvutuka.

src: "This is not going to be goodbye. This is the closing of one chapter and the opening of a new one."
trg: "Yai ta vanda Aurevoir ve. Yai kele kukangama ya chapitre mosi mpi luyantiku ya mosi ya mpa."

src: Final results from Namibian presidential and parliamentary elections have indicated that the incumbent president, Hifikepunye Pohamba, has been reelected by a large margin.
trg: Mambu ya nsuka ya bo monaka na president mpi badepute ya Namibie ke songa nde president ya nungaka, Hifikepunye Pohamba, kuponmaka na matonsi mingi kuluta.

src: The ruling party, South West Africa People's Organisation (SWAPO), also retained a majority in the parliamentary elections.
trg: Kimvuka ya luyalu SWAPO, na ndinga ya nda, South West Africa People Organization bo mpi vandaka kuzwa mingi kuluta na nima ya maponami ya badepite.

src: Coalition and Afghan troops moved into the area to secure the site and other coalition aircraft have been sent to assist.
trg: Bimvuka ya kusangana ti baafghani bokwendaka na zone sambu na kutanina kisika ti bankaka kuvandaka disanga bo tindamaka sambu na kusadisa.

src: The crash occurred high up in mountainous terrain, and is believed to have been the result of hostile fire.
trg: Aksida salamaka na bisika ya ntoto kele na zulu ya ngumba, ya kutalana ti ya katukaka ya tiya ya nene.

src: Efforts to search for the crash site are being met by bad weather and harsh terrain.
trg: Makuki sambu na kusosa kisika kigonsa kusalamaka yo vandaka mpasi sambu na ntangu ya mbi ti ntoto ya mbi.

src: The medical charity Mangola, Medecines Sans Frontieres and the World Health Organisation say it is the worst outbreak recorded in the country.
trg: Kikunku me tadila kusadisa mavimpi Mangola, Medecins sans Frontiere na OMS tubaka ti yo zolaka kunana mbi mingi na ntoto.

src: Spokesman for Medecines Sans Frontiere Richard Veerman said: "Angola is heading for its worst ever outbreak and the situation remains very bad in Angola," he said.
trg: Kinzonzi ya Medecins Sans Frontière, Richard Veerman me zonza: "Anglo ke na kukota kaka na mpasi ya kulutila na mambu kele na kutatamana kuvanda mbi na Angola".

src: The games kicked off at 10:00am with great weather and apart from mid morning drizzle which quickly cleared up, it was a perfect day for 7's rugby.
trg: Bansaka kubandaka na 10h00 ti ntangu ya mbote mpi kukatula wa mvula ya fioti yayi kunokaka na suka yayi kumanaka nswala, kuvandaka kilumbu mosi ya mbote sambu na rugby ya 7.

src: Tournament top seeds South Africa started on the right note when they had a comfortable 26 - 00 win against 5th seeded Zambia.
trg: Na ntu ya ndonga ya tournoi Afrika ya sudi yantikaka mbote ntangu bo vandaka na matonsi ya kununga mbote 26-00 bo nyataka Zambia ekipi ya tanu na ndonga ya ntu.

src: Looking decidedly rusty in the game against their southern sisters, South Africa however steadily improved as the tournament progressed.
trg: Kumonana ya kubeba na nsaka ti bampangi na bo ya bankento ya sud, Afrique du Sud me kuma mbote na ntangu bansaka kuvabulamaka.

src: Their disciplined defence, ball handling skills and excellent team work made them stand out and it was clear that this was the team to beat.
trg: Babudi ya nkweso yai ya ke kangaka nima na bulemfu ya bansiku, mayele ya kuzabansaka ya nkweso mpi kisalu ya kitoko na ekipi kunungisaka bo, mpi yo monanaka polele nde yina vandaka ekipi ya bwisa.

src: Officials for the city of Amsterdam and the Anne Frank Museum state that the tree is infected with a fungus and poses a public health hazard as they argue that it was in imminent danger of falling over.
trg: Bantwadisi ya bwala ya Amsterdam ti ya Mize ya Frank ke tubaka nde nti me baka maladi ya buboko ti yo kele kigonsa sambu na luzingu ya bantu sambu bo ketuba nde yo vandaka kigonsa ya ngolo nakubwa.

src: It had been scheduled to be cut down on Tuesday, but was saved after an emergency court ruling.
trg: Ya me kukubukwa ti na kilumbu ya zole ya lumingu yo ke kuzengwa, kansi yo ke kubumbwa na nima ya lukanu ya nswalu nswalu ya ba zuzi.

src: All of the cave entrances, which were named "The Seven Sisters", are at least 100 to 250 meters (328 to 820 feet) in diameter.
trg: Bankotolo yonso ya ditadi ya nene, na zina ya Bampangi ya nkento Nsambwadi to "The Seven Sisters", vandaka yinda ya metre 100 tii 250 (yinda ya makulu 328 tii na 820) na kati kati.

src: Infrared images show that the temperature variations from night and day show that they are likely caves.
trg: Bizizi ke songaka mutindu ntangu ke sobaka na nkokila mpi na kilumbu, yo kesongaka mutindu bamatadi kele na mabulu ya yinda.

src: "They are cooler than the surrounding surface in the day and warmer at night.
trg: Yo kele madidi kuluta bisika ya mfinama na ntangu mpi tiya na mpimpa.

src: Their thermal behavior is not as steady as large caves on Earth that often maintain a fairly constant temperature, but it is consistent with these being deep holes in the ground," said Glen Cushing of the United States Geological Survey (USGS) Astrogeology Team and of Northern Arizona University located in Flagstaff, Arizona.
trg: Glen Cushing muntu ya ekipi ya Etudes Géographique des Etats Unis, Ekipi ya Astrologie na universite ya Nene ya Arizona ya nordi ya Flagstaff na Arizona, tubaka, "mutindu na bo ya kuvanda na ntangu ke vandaka kisika mosi ve sambu na mabulu ya nene na Ntoto kele na matadi to bagolote ke vandaka na ntangu ya kuvanda, kansi, ntangu kele mutindu ya nkaka na bagolote kele na mabulu ya yinda".

src: In France, voting has traditionally been a low-tech experience: voters isolate themselves in a booth, put a pre-printed sheet of paper indicating their candidate of choice into an envelope.
trg: Na France, vote yoke vandaka mumesano mosi ya kuzaba ya low-tech: baponami bokebumbanaka na kati ya stand, boketulaka dititi mosi ya papier pré-imprimée yayi kele na kandida ya nswa ya muntu yandi mosi na kati ya anvelope.

src: After officials verify the voter's identity, the voter drops the envelope into the ballot box and signs the voting roll.
trg: Kana bamfumu me manisa kutala identite ya muntu ke sala vote, muntu yango ke tulaka amvelopi na kesi ya voti mpi ke tulaka siniatire na mukanda.

src: French electoral law rather strictly codifies the proceedings.
trg: Lukanu ya vote ya France ke zitisaka bansiku na bo ya ngolo-ngolo.

src: Since 1988, ballot boxes must be transparent so that voters and observers can witness that no envelopes are present at the start of the vote and that no envelopes are added except those of the duly counted and authorized voters.
trg: Kubanda 1988, bitunga ya voti fwete kumonana na nganda mpi na kati sambu bantu ya ke vote mpi bantu ya ke tala (observateur) bo mona nde amvelope mosi ve kele na na kati na ntwala nde voti kuyantika mpi amvelope mosi ve me yikama katula kaka ya bantu ya me vote yina bo me tanga mpi yina kele ti nswa ya kuvote.

src: Candidates can send representatives to witness every part of the process. In the evening, votes are counted by volunteers under heavy supervision, following specific procedures.
trg: Ba candidat lenda tinda bantumwa na bo sambu kuvanda batemwe ya ndambu yonso ya kisala. Na nkokila, voti ke tangama na bantu ya luzolo na nsi ya kutala bo mbote mbote, na kulandaka bansiku ya kusala mosi mosi.

src: ASUS Eee PC, earlier launched world-wide for cost-saving and functionality factors, became a hot topic in 2007 Taipei IT Month.
trg: ASUS Eee PC, yina ya bokangula na luyantiku na ntoto ya mvimba sambu na ntalu ya nsi mpi mutindu ya mbote yo ke sala, kuma disolo ya muntu yonso na ngonda ya makambu ya IT na Tapei na 2017.

src: But the consumer market on laptop computer will be radically varied and changed after ASUS was awarded in the 2007 Taiwan Sustainable Award by Executive Yuan of the Republic of China.
trg: Bisumbi ya ordinateur na nzandu ke vanda na ya mutindu mpi na nsoba mingi na nima ya kutula ASUS na kisika ya ntete na Manaka ya kupesa mundayi ya Taiwan na ntwala ya Yuan, kinama ya luyalu ya Chine.

src: The station's web site describes the show as "old school radio theater with a new and outrageous geeky spin!"
trg: Site interneti ya radio ke tendula dikambu yina bonso "theatre ya nzo-nkanda ya ntama na mayele ya mpa ya fim ya nsoni!"

src: In its early days, the show was featured solely at the long-running internet radio site TogiNet Radio, a site focused on talk radio.

trg: Na ntwala ya kukwisa ya basoda, Haiti monaka ve makambu ya bimbefo ykuluta mvula 1800.

src: The Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy has referenced independent studies that suggest the Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion unknowingly brought the disease to Haiti.
trg: Institut ya Haiti ya Justice mpi Democratie me tula malongi ya kulonguka yai kupesa ngindu nde basoda ya Nepal ya Nations Unies nde bantu nataka maladi na Haiti.

src: California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger signed into law a bill that bans the sale or rental of violent video games to minors.

src: The bill requires violent video games sold in the state of California to be labeled with a decal reading "18" and makes their sale to a minor punishable by a fine of $1000 per offense.

src: The Director of Public Prosecutions, Kier Starmer QC, gave a statement this morning announcing the prosecution of both Huhne and Pryce.

src: Huhne has resigned and he will be replaced in the Cabinet by Ed Davey MP. Norman Lamb MP is expected to take the Business Minister job Davey is vacating.

src: Huhne and Pryce are scheduled to appear at the Westminster Magistrates Court on February 16.

src: The fatalities were Nicholas Alden, 25, and Zachary Cuddeback, 21. Cuddeback had been the driver.

src: Edgar Veguilla received arm and jaw wounds while Kristoffer Schneider was left requiring reconstructive surgery for his face.

src: Beyond Wednesday's event, Carpanedo competed in two individual races at the Championships.

src: Her first was the Slalom, where she earned a Did Not Finish in her first run. 36 of the 116 competitors had the same result in that race.

src: Her other race, the Giant Slalom, saw her finish in tenth in the women's sitting group with a combined run time of 4:41.30, 2:11.60 minutes slower than first place finisher Austrian Claudia Loesch and 1:09.02 minutes slower than the ninth place finisher Gyöngyi Dani of Hungary.

src: Four skiers in the women's sitting group failed to finish their runs, and 45 of the 117 total skiers in the Giant Slalom failed to rank in the race.
trg: Bantu ya ski iya ya kimvuka ya bankento ya ke salaka yo ya kuvanda me manisaka ve toure na bo, mpi bantu 45 na kati ya sky 117 ya slalom ya nene, bo kukaka ve kutula bo na ndonga.

src: The Madhya Pradesh Police recovered the stolen laptop and mobile phone.
trg: Polisi ya Madhya Pradesh yobakaka ordinateur portable ti téléfone portable yayi boyibaka.

src: Deputy Inspector General D K Arya said, "We have arrested five persons who raped the Swiss woman and recovered her mobile and laptop".
trg: Mumonisi mpi kilongisi General D K Arya me tuba, "beto me kanga bantu tanu me sala busafu na nitu ya nkento ya mwisi Swisse na me baka singa mpi kompota ya yandi.

src: The accused are named as Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar and Vishnu Kanjar.
trg: Bantu yina Bo me funda kele Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar na Vishnu Kanjar.

src: Police superintendent Chandra Shekhar Solanki said the accused appeared in court with covered faces.
trg: Mfumu ya bapolisi Chandra Shekhar Solanki tubaka ti muntu yina ba fundaka lutaka na ntwala bazuzi na kizizi ya kukangama na lele.

src: Although three people were inside the house when the car impacted it, none of them were hurt.
trg: Ata bantu tatu vandaka na kati ya nzo ntangu kaminio tutaka yo, ata muntu mosi ve lwalaka.

src: However, the driver sustained serious injuries to the head.
trg: Kansi, sofele lwalaka mputa ya ngolo na ntu.

src: The road where the crash happened was temporarily closed while emergency services freed the driver from the red Audi TT.
trg: Nzila yayi kisika aksida ya avio salamaka ba kangaka yo sambu na kusala Bansosa na mwa ntangu kangamaka, ntangu na kisalu ke talaka mambu ya aksida na kubasisa shofere na kamio ya mbwaki ya Auti TT.

src: He was initially hospitalised in the James Paget Hospital in Great Yarmouth.
trg: Yandi vandaka na mbala ya ntete na lupitalu ya James Paget na Great Yarmouth.

src: He was subsequently relocated to Addenbrooke's Hospital in Cambridge.
trg: Bo nataka yandi na nima na lupitalu ya Addenbrooke na Cambridge.

src: Adekoya has since been in Edinburgh Sheriff Court charged with murdering her son.
trg: Adekoya yavandaka na ntwala ya Nzo ya kusamba ya Sheriff Édimbourg, bofundaka yandi sambu na lufwa ya mwana na yandi ya bakala.

src: She is in custody pending indictment and trial, but any eyewitness evidence may be tainted because her image has been widely published.
trg: Yandi ke na boloko na kulandaka kubwa na kusamba, kansi bidimbu ya meso ke talanaka na mutindu mingi, sambu bo panzaka bafoto ya kimuntu na yandi ke na kubeba.

src: This is common practice elsewhere in the UK but Scottish justice works differently and courts have viewed publication of photos as potentially prejudicial.
trg: Yokele kisalu ya ntangu yonso na bantu ya nkaka na Royome-Uni, kansi justice ya Ecosse yoke salamaka ya kukesana ti ba tribunaux bobakaka publication ya bafoto bonso kima mosi ya kubebisa.

src: Professor Pamela Ferguson of the University of Dundee notes "journalists do seem to be walking a dangerous line if publishing photos etc of suspects."
trg: Kilongisi na lokolo ya malongi ya yinda ya Dundee me sala kintona ti: "bimwangisi nsangu lenda sala kisalu ya bo mbi kana bo ke na kusonga bizizi ya bantu ya mvwanzi".

src: Crown Office, which is in overall charge of prosecutions, has indicated to journalists that no further comment will be made at least until indictment.
trg: Biro ya Crown, yina ke talaka mambu ya biyidiki mambu ya mbi na bantu, tubaka na bimwangisi nsangu ti bo kepesa ve mpangula mingi tii ntangu yina mfundusu ke kusalama.

src: The document, according to the leak, will refer to the borders dispute, which Palestine wants based on the borders before the 1967 Mideast War.
trg: Mukanda yango, na kulanda bansangu yina bo me basisa, ke tubila kunwanisa bandilu, yai Palestine ke zola nde yo tadila bandilu yina ya kuvandaka na ntwala ya mvita ya Moyen-Orient ya 1967.

src: Other topics covered reportedly include the future state of Jerusalem which is sacred to both nations and the Jordan Valley issue.
trg: Makambu ya nkaka ya bo zabisaka vandaka bilumbu ya ke kwisa ya Jérusalem, yai ya kele santu sambu na ba insi yonso zole, mpi mambu ya Jourdan Valley.

src: Israel demands an ongoing military presence in the valley for ten years once an agreement is signed while the PA agrees to leave such presence only for five years.
trg: Israel me lomba basoda tatamana kuvanda na bwala na Distrike yina kele pene na masa bwela ba mvula kumi na nima ya kutula kiniemo na mukanda ya nguisani na ntangu PA me kundima kuzinga kaka ba mvula tanu.

src: Shooters in the supplementary pest control trial were to be closely supervised by rangers, as the trial was monitored and its effectiveness evaluated.
trg: Bo ke bwela ntangu ya kutatamana sala Bansosa ya kimbefo ya bambisi na zina ya peste, sambu Bikebi bamfinda sala yo, mutindu yo kuzabukuswaka na kutala kana ba ke nunga na yo.

src: In a partnership of NPWS and the Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, qualified volunteers were recruited, under the Sporting Shooters Association's hunting program.
trg: Na mpila ya partenariat ya NPWS ti ya Sporting Shooters Association of Australie (NSW) Inc, ya bavolontaire ya mbote bosolamaka na kisalu ya pologalami ya kurse ya Sporting Shooters Association.

src: According to Mick O'Flynn, the Acting Director Park Conservation and Heritage with the NPWS, the four shooters selected for the first shooting operation received comprehensive safety and training instruction.
trg: Na mabanza ya Mick O'Flynn, Directeur ya Conservation et Heritage du Parque na NPWS, Bikubudi minduki iya yina soluaka na nsalulu ya ntete ya kulongoka kukubul munduki yambaka malongi mpi luzabu ya kubumba nitu mpi bima ya mbote.

src: Martelly swore in a new Provisional Electoral Council (CEP) of nine members yesterday.
trg: Martelly diaka ndefi mazono na kusala na komite ya vote ya ntangu fioti (CEP) yina kele ti bantu ivwa.

src: It is Martelly's fifth CEP in four years.
trg: Yo kele CEP ya mbala ya tanu sambu na Martelly na mvula iya.

src: Last month a presidential commission recommended the prior CEP's resignation as part of a package of measures to move the country towards new elections.
trg: Ngonda ya lutaka kimvuka ya bantumwa ya president lombaka nde CEP kupesa ntete demission bonso mosi ya balukanu ya kunata insi na maponami ya mpa.

src: The commission was Martelly's response to widespread anti-regime protests that started in October.
trg: Kinkuku ya bitadi mambu vandaka mvutu ya Martelly na kumwangisa bimangi kimfumu ya luyalu yina bandaka na ngonda ya Kumi.

src: The sometimes-violent protests were triggered by failure to hold elections, some due since 2011.
trg: Matata ya ntangu ya nkaka ya bantu vandaka kutambula na mbula-matari kubandaka sambu bo salaka ve maponami, ya nkaka kondaka kusalama kubanda na 2011.

src: Around 60 cases of malfunctioning iPods overheating have been reported, causing a total of six fires and leaving four people with minor burns.
trg: Bo zabisaka mfinama ya mambu 60 ya iPod ya kubeba ya ke pesa tiya mingi yomonisamaka, yayi kusalaka babigonsa sambanu ti yo bikaka bantu ya kuyokama na tia ya ngolo ve.

src: Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) said that it had been aware of 27 accidents related to the devices.
trg: Ministre ya Japon ya mambu ya mbongo, kuteka bima mpi industrie (METI) tubaka nde bo me zaba nde bisadilu yina salaka bisumbula 27.

src: Last week, METI announced that Apple had informed it of 34 additional overheating incidents, which the company called "non-serious."
trg: Mposo me kuluta, METI me tuba ti Apple me me kuzabisa yandi na 34 ya ba mambu ke ukuma, yina kompani me kubinga "mambu ya ngolo fyoti."

src: The ministry responded by calling Apple's postponement of the report "truly regrettable."
trg: Na mvutu na yandi, ministre ya luyalu tubaka nde mutindu bo ta sala rapore na bilumbu ke kwisa kele "kiadi mingi kibeni."

src: The eathquake struck Mariana at 07:19 a.m. local time (09:19 p.m. GMT Friday).
trg: Kunikana ya ntoto bulaka Marina na 07:19 na suka, ntangu ya kisika yina (09:19 na nkokila ntangu ya Greenwich na kitanu).

src: The Northern Marianas emergency management office said that there were no damages reported in the nation.
trg: Biro ya kisalu ya Marianas ya Nord yo tubaka nde kima ya mbi kuvandaka ve na Rapore yayi kpesamaka na bwala.

src: Also the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center said that there was no Tsunami indication.
trg: Biro ke talaka mambu ya Tsunami ya Pacifique mpi tubaka ata kidimbu yina vandaka lakisa nkwizulu ya Tsunami vandaka ve.

src: A former Filipino policeman has kept Hong Kong tourists hostage by hijacking their bus in Manila, the capital of the Philippines.
trg: Polisi mosi ya ntama ya Phillipines kangaka batouriste ya Hong Kong na kubalulaka bus na bo na Manille, bwala ya luyalu ya insi.

src: Rolando Mendoza fired his M16 rifle at the tourists.
trg: Rolando Mendoza yokaka Munduki ya yandi ya M16 na bibumini bisika.

src: Several hostages have been rescued and least six have been confirmed dead so far.
trg: Mingi ya baminanga bo bakaka na kingolo tinaka na sambanu kati na bo fwaka.

src: Six hostages, including the children and elderly, were released early, as were the Filipino photographers.
trg: Bantu sambanu, na kati kuvandaka ti bana ti bambuta, pesaka bo kimpwanza bo na ntangu ya mbote, bonso ba fotografe ya Philippine.

src: The photographers later took the place of an aged lady as she needed the lavatory. Mendoza was gunned down.
trg: Bibaki bizizi zwa kisika ya nkento ya kiboba vandaka na ka kisika ya kunenina. Mendoza zwaka lufua kuna.

src: Liggins followed in his father’s footsteps and entered a career in medicine.
trg: Liggins yalandaka banzila ya tata na yandi mpi ya kotaka na kisalu ya médecine.

src: He trained as an obstetrician and began to work at the Auckland's National Women's Hospital in 1959.
trg: Bo longaka yandi kisalu ya kubutisa bankento sambu na kusala na Lopitalo Auckland's National Women's Hospital na 1959.

src: While he was working at the hospital Liggins began to investigate premature labor during his spare time.
trg: Na ntangu yandi vandaka ke sala na Lopitalo, Liggins bandaka kusala anketi na bantu ya ke sala bisalu na ntwala ya kulungisa mvula ya kisalu.

src: His research showed that if a hormone was administered it would speed up the baby's foetal lung maturation.
trg: Bansosa ya yandi me lakisa kana olomone me tulwa na nitu ya nkento yo ke kudisa na mabu kuyilama mwana na kivumu.

src: Xinhua reported that government investigators recovered two 'black box' flight recorders on Wednesday.
trg: Xinhua kutubaka nde batadi ya guvernema bobakaka na Kilumbu ya tatu ba enregistreur ya bandinga zole ya avion "boîte noire".

src: Fellow wrestlers also paid tribute to Luna.
trg: Banduku na yandi ya ke nwanaka kumisa Luna.

src: Tommy Dreamer said "Luna was the first Queen of Extreme. My first manager. Luna passed away on the night of two moons. Pretty unique just like her. Strong woman."
trg: Tommy Dreamer tubaka: "Luna vandaka mfumu ya nkento ya ntete ya Extreme. Manager na mono ya ntete. Luna fwaka na mpimpa ya bangonda zole. Ya nkaka bonso yandi kele ve. nkento ya ngolo."

src: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels commented that "Luna was as freaky as me...maybe even more...love her and will miss her...hopefully she's in a better place."
trg: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels tubaka nde "Luna vandaka muntu ya mbi bonso mono…lenda vanda kuluta mingi…beto zolaka yandi mpi beto ke konda yandi…na kivuvu nde yandi kele na kisika ya mbote kibeni."

src: Out of 1,400 people polled prior to the 2010 federal election, those who oppose Australia becoming a republic grew by 8 per cent since 2008.
trg: Na kati ya bantu 1.400 ya bantu kuvotaka na ntwala ya maponami, bayina zolaka ve Australie kukuma republika mataka na bantu 8 na nkama mosi kubanda mvula 2008.

src: Caretaker Prime Minister Julia Gillard claimed during the campaign of the 2010 federal election that she believed Australia should become a republic at the end of Queen Elizabeth II's reign.
trg: Mfumu ya zole Julia Gillard tubaka na ntangu ya manaka ya bavote ya bwala ya 2010 ti yandi kele na kivuvu ti Australie ke kukuma insi bame kubolila republique na nsuka ya ntumunu ya ntinu Elizabeth II.

src: 34 per cent of those in the poll share this view, wanting Queen Elizabeth II to be Australia's last monarch.
trg: 34% ya bantu yayi boyufulaka bo kele kutuba kaka ndinga mosi, bo ke zola nde rene Elizabeth yandi vanda mfumu ya nsuka na Australie.

src: At the extremes of the poll, 29 per cent of those surveyed believe Australia should become a republic as soon as possible, while 31 per cent believe Australia should never become a republic.
trg: Na kutala bisalu ya mfimpulu, Ntalu ya 29 ya bantu tubaka ti Australi fuana kukuma Kintuadi ya ba bwala na ntinu, na ntangu 31 ya Ntalu ya bantu ke na kuikila ti Australie kukuma ata fioti ve kintuadi ya bambanza.

src: The Olympic gold medalist was due to swim in the 100m and 200m freestyle and in three relays at the Commonwealth Games, but due to his complaints his fitness has been in doubt.
trg: Muntu ya kubaka medaille ya wolo na nsaka ya olimpiki lombaka kuzenga masa na metre 100 mpi na metre 200 na kusala na kimpwanza mpi na kubaka nzila mbala tatu na bankaka na nsaka ya Commonwealth, kansi na kikuma ya kufunda na yandi bo tulaka ngolo na yandi ntembe.

src: He has been unable to take the drugs needed to overcome his pain as they are banned from the Games.
trg: Yandi lungaka ve kunwa bankisi ya kulombamaka sambu na kununga mpasi na yandi sambu bo me pimisa bo na kusakana.

src: Curtis Cooper, a mathematician and computer science professor at the University of Central Missouri, has discovered the largest known prime number to date on January 25.
trg: Curtis Cooper, mathématicien ti professeur ya informatique na Université ya Missouri central, yamonaka nombre mosi ya ntete ya nene na kilumbu ya 25 ya ngonda ya ntete.

src: Several people verified the discovery using different hardware and software by the beginning of February and it was announced on Tuesday.
trg: Bantu mingi fimpaka bima yina bantu ya siansi yidikaka na kompota mpi bisandulu na yo na mbadukulu ya ngonda ya zole na bansangu pesamaka na kilumbu ya zole.

src: Comets may possibly have been a source of water delivery to the earth along with organic matter that can form proteins and support life.
trg: Bambwetete lenda kuvanda wapi masa ya ntoto ke tukaka mpila mosi na bima ya me fwaka ntama yai lenda kusala proteine mpi lusadisu ya luzingu.

src: Scientists hope to understand how planets form, especially how the Earth formed, since comets collided with the Earth long ago.
trg: Bantu ya siansi ke tula ntima nde bo ta bakisa mutindu bapalanete ke salamaka, mingi-mingi mutindu ntoto kusalamaka, sambu bakomete vukanaka ti Ntoto bamvula mingi me luta.

src: Cuomo, 53, began his governorship earlier this year and signed a bill last month legalizing same-sex marriage.
trg: Cuomo, muntu ya bamvula 53 bandaka kintinu ya yandi ya mbadukulu ya mvula yayi mpi zengaka lukanu ngonda me kuluta ya ku dedikisa makwela ya bantu ya nkento na nkento to bakala na bakala.

src: He referred to the rumors as "political chatter and silliness".
trg: Yandi kutubaka nde bansangu kele "makelele ya politiki ti bima ya mpamba mpamba".

src: He is speculated to make a run for president in 2016.
trg: Bantu ke yindula nde yandi ta vanda kandida na vote ya president na 2016.

src: NextGen is a system the FAA claims would allow aircraft to fly shorter routes and save millions of gallons of fuel each year and cut carbon emissions.
trg: NextGen kele nsadilu FAA ke zonzilaka yina lenda sala ti avio nanguka na bitini ya nkufi na ku bumba ba milio ya litele ya mafuta konso mvula mpi kuzenga mwangusulu ya makala.

src: It uses satellite-based technology as opposed to older ground-radar-based technology to allow air traffic controllers to pinpoint aircraft with greater precision and give pilots more accurate information.
trg: Yo ke sadilaka tekinoloji ya satelite na kuluta tekinoloji ya ntama na yai bo vandaka kusadila radar na ntoto sambu na kupesa bantu ya ke yalaka kutambula ya ba avion kumona baavion ata ya fioti fioti na mpila mosi ya mbote mpi kupesa ba piloti bansangu ya mbote mpenza.

src: No extra transport is being put on and overground trains will not stop at Wembley, and car parking and park-and-ride facilities are unavailable at the ground.
trg: Bo yikaka ve transport ya nkaka mpi train ya zuku ya ntoto ke telemaka ve na Wembley, mpi parking ya kaminion mpi bisika ya nkaka ya kubaka bantu ke monana ve na ntoto.

src: Fears of lack of transportation raised the possibility that the game would be forced to play behind closed doors without the team's supporters.
trg: Boma ya kuzanga transport pesaka nzila ya kuyindula nde yo ta lomba bo bula match na bakielo ya kukonda mpi kukonda bafana ya ekipe.

src: A study published on Thursday in the journal Science reported on formation of a new bird species on the Ecuadorean Galápagos Islands.
trg: Malongi yina mukanda ya Luzabu tulaka na nganda bantu yonso na kilumbu ya iya ya lumingu, pesaka bansangu ya kifwani ya ndeke ya bantoto ya kati ya masa ya Galapagos ya equateur.

src: Researchers from Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden reported the new species evolved in just two generations, though this process had been believed to take much longer, due to breeding between an endemic Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes, and the immigrant cactus finch, Geospiza conirostris.
trg: Bachercheur ya Université ya Princeton na Etats-Unis ti ya Université ya Uppsala na Suède bonungaka kuluta espèce ya mpa kuyelaka kaka na generation mosi, Ata mpila yayi kelombaka bantangu mingi, na mpila ya reproduction ya pinson endémique ya Darwin, Geospiza ya ngolo ti cactus immigrant. Roselin, Geospiza conirostris.

src: Gold may be worked into all sorts of shapes. It can be rolled into tiny shapes.
trg: Wolo lenda salama na ba forme ya mpila yonso. Yolenda salama na mpila mosi ya fioti.

src: It can be pulled into thin wire, which can be twisted and plaited. It can be hammered or rolled into sheets.
trg: Ba lenda kubalula yo na kibende, yina ba lenda kutengimisa na kufutika. Ba lenda koma yo na malato to kubalula yo na mabende ya fyoti mingi mutindu mpimpapela.

src: It can be made very thin, and stuck onto other metal. It can be made so thin that it was sometimes used to decorate the hand-painted pictures in books called "illuminated manuscripts".
trg: Yo lenda kuma fyoti mpi kuvukana na kibende ya nkaka. Na yina yo lenda kuma fyoti mingi, ya sadulwaka na kutula zitona na bizizi ya mabuku yina sonukwaka ya maboko na zina ya "bansonokono ya nsamina".

src: This is called a chemical's pH. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.
trg: Yai bo ke binga yo PH ya chimie. Nge lenda sala indicateurmosi na kusadilaka jus ya mbwaki ya choux.

src: The cabbage juice changes color depending on how acidic or basic (alkaline) the chemical is.
trg: Masa ya lesu ke sobaka kifwani na kutala kiteso ya acide to ya ntoto ke na chimie.

src: The pH level is indicated by the amount of Hydrogen (the H in pH) ions in the tested chemical.
trg: Kiteso ya pH ke pesamaka na ntalu ya ba ion ya Hydrogène (yina kisono H me lakisa na pH) ya bizama ya chimie.

src: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).
trg: Bitini ya fioti ya hydrogène kele ba proton yina bo me katulaka ba electron na yo (sambu ba atome ya hydrogène ke vandaka ti proton mosi mpi electron mosi).

src: Swirl the two dry powders together and then, with clean wet hands, squeeze them into a ball.
trg: Kuvukisa fufu ya kutula na nitu kisika mosi, na maboko ya kusema, ke vandaka zila ya sa mukembo.

src: The moisture on your hands will react with the outer layers, which will feel funny and form a sort of shell.
trg: Kubola ya maboko ya nge ke basisa kima ya nzenza kana yo me vukana na mukanda ya nganda, yina ke vanda mbote mpi ke kituka mpusu.

src: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system.
trg: Basiti ya Harappa ti ya Mohenjo-daro ke vandaka na batwalete ya masa na banzo yonso, yo tulamaka na mutindu ya kusala ya mbote ya kupepa.

src: Remains of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece.
trg: Bo monaka bandambu ya bima ya bikalaka na banzila ya masa na banzo ya Minoan na mbanza Crete mpi Santorini na Grece.

src: There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In Roman civilization, toilets were sometimes part of public bath houses where men and women were together in mixed company.
trg: Batwaleti vandaka mpi na Égypte ya ntama, Perse ti Chine. Na Luyalu ya Roma, batwalete/bisika ya kabini ntangu ya nkaka kuvandaka bisika ya kuyobila ya bantu kisika babakala ti bankento vandaka kutana zole zole.

src: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
trg: Kana nge me binga na telefone muntu yina kele na kisika ya ntama kibeni, nge nge ke sadila satelite.

src: The satellite in space gets the call and then reflects it back down, almost instantly.
trg: Satelite yina kele na zulu ke yambaka appel, na nima yo ke vutulaka yo awa na ntoto, kukonda kusukinina.

src: The satellite was sent into space by a rocket. Scientists use telescopes in space because the Earth’s atmosphere distorts some of our light and view.
trg: Bo tindaka satelite na zulu na lusadisu ya fizé. Bantu ya siansi ke sadilaka batelescope na zulu sambu mupepe ya Ntoto ke bebisaka ndambu nsemo mpi ya bima ya beto ke monaka.

src: It takes a giant rocket over a 100 feet high to put a satellite or telescope in space.
trg: Yo ke lombaka fizé mosi ya nda kuluta bametre 30,48 sambu na kutula satelite to telescope mosi na zulu.

src: The wheel has changed the world in incredible ways. The biggest thing that the wheel has done for us is given us much easier and faster transportation.
trg: Pine me sobaka nsi-ntoto na mitindu ya kuyituka. Kima ya kuluta nene yina pine me salaka kele mutindu yo me sadisaka beto sambu kutambula kuvanda pete mpi ntinu.

src: It has brought us the train, the car, and many other transportation devices.
trg: Yo me natilaka beto train, kamio, mpi bisadilu ya nkaka ya transport.

src: Under them are more medium sized cats that eat medium sized prey ranging from rabbits to antelopes and deer.
trg: Na nsi na bo, kele ti banyawu mingi ya nene ya katikati yina ke diaka bima ya nene ya katikati banda na balapin tii na ba-antilope mpi ngombe ya mfinda.

src: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose pet cats) that eat the far more numerous small prey like insects, rodents, lizards, and birds.
trg: Nsuka-nsuka, kele ti banyawu ya mingi ya fyoti (tanga mpi banyawu mingi ya ke zingaka ti bantu) yina ke diaka bima mingi ya fioti kibeni mu mbandu baniama, bampuku, bambalambongo, mpi bandeke.

src: The secret to their success is the concept of the niche, a special job each cat holds that keeps it from competing with others.
trg: Kinsweki ya kununga na bo kele mayele ya bo ke bingaka niche, kisalu mosi ya mfunu yina konso nyawu ke salaka mpi ke sadisaka yo na kutesana ti bankaka.

src: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.
trg: Bantambu kele baniau yina ke zolanaka, bo ke zingaka na bimvuka ya nene bo ke bingaka ba pride.

src: Prides are made up of one to three related adult males, along with as many as thirty females and cubs.
trg: Ba pride ke vandaka ti ntambu mosi tii na bantambu tatu ya babakala ya bambuta, kumosi ti bankento mpi bana makumi tatu.

src: The females are usually closely related to each other, being a large family of sisters and daughters.
trg: Mbala mingi bantu ke vandaka na kuwakana na kati na bo, yo ke vandaka kimvuka ya nene ya bampangi ya bankento mpi ya bana ya bankento.

src: Lion prides act much like packs of wolves or dogs, animals surprisingly similar to lions (but not other big cats) in behavior, and also very deadly to their prey.
trg: Kimvuka ya bantambu ke salaka mambu mbala mingi bonso bibulu to bambwa, bambisi yina me fwanana mingi ti bandambu (kansi ve ti banyawu ya nkaka ya nene) na bikalulu, mpi yo ke fwaka kibeni bambisi yina yo ke diaka.

src: A well rounded athlete, the tiger can climb (though not well), swim, leap great distances and pull with five times the force of a strong human.
trg: Tigre, yina ke bakaka ntinu mbote, lenda mata (kansi ve na dibulu), kukasa, kupumbuka na kitamina ya nda mpi kunangula bima ti ngolo ya me luta ngolo ya muntu ya ngolo.

src: The tiger is in the same group (Genus Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four cats are the only ones who can roar.
trg: Tire kele na kimvuka mosi (Genus Pathera) ti bantambu, bankoyi, mpi ba jaguards. Banyawu iya yai mpamba ke kukaka kungana.

src: The tiger's roar is not like the full-voiced roar of a lion, but more like a sentence of snarly, shouted words.
trg: Kungana ya tigre kele ve bonso kungana ya ndinga ya ngolo ya ntambu, kansi yo ke vandaka bonso nsa ya bangogo ya bo me tuba na ndinga ya ngolo.

src: Ocelots like to eat small animals. They will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents and birds if they can. Almost all of the animals that the ocelot hunts are far smaller than it is.
trg: Bibulu ke zolaka kudia bambisi ya fioti. Yo ke kangaka bamakaku, banioka, bampuku ya ke timunaka ntoto mpi bandeke kana mpila kele. Bambisi yonso yina kibulu ke landaka kele fioti kuluta yo.

src: Scientists think that ocelots follow and find animals to eat (prey) by smell, sniffing for where they've been on the ground.
trg: Bantu ya siansi ke yindula nde bibulu ke landaka mpi ke kangaka bambisi ya yo ke diaka, yo ke landaka yo na nsudi sambu na kuzaba kisika yo kele na ntoto.

src: They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.
trg: Yo lenda mona mbote kibeni na kisika ya mudidi na nsemo ya mpimpa, mpi kutambula mbote mpi. Bibulu ke zombaka bambisi ya yo ke kangaka na kutambulaka na bisika yo ke zingaka mpi na nima kubwila yo.

src: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
trg: Kana kimvuka mosi ya fioti ya bima ya ke zingaka (kimvuka fioti ya bantu) me kabwana ti kimvka ya nene oyo bo vandaka kisika mosi (bonso kana bo me kwenda na zulu ya ngumba to na lweka ya nzadi, to to kana bo me kwenda na kisanga ya mpa na mpila nde bo lenda vutuka diaka ve), mbala mingi bo ke monaka nde bo me kuma na kisika ya me swaswana ti kisika ya bo vandaka kuzinga ntete.

src: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.
trg: Kisika yai ya mpa ke vandaka ti bima kuswaswana mpi bantu ya kuswaswana ya kunwana ti bo, yo yina bantu yina ya mpa ta vanda ti mfunu ya bima ya mpa to kuyikana sambu bo vanda bantu ya ngolo ya ke nwanaka kuluta mutindu bo vandaka ntete.

src: The original population hasn't changed at all, they still need the same adaptations as before.
trg: Bantu ya ntete ya bwala banda kinkulu sobaka ve, bo ke zolaka kaka kuvanda mutindu bo vandilaka na mbadukulu.

src: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population.
trg: Na nima ya bantangu, na ntangu bantu yina ya mpa me banda kuyikana na kisika na bo ya mpa, bo ta kuma ya kuswaswana kibeni ti bantu yina ya ntama.

src: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.
trg: Nsuka-nsuka, na nima ya bafunda to ata bamilio ya bamvula, bimvuka zole yina ya bantu ta kuma ya kuswaswana kibeni, yo yina bo lenda tuba diaka ve nde bo kele kimvuka mosi.

src: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.
trg: Beto ke bingaka mutindu yina ya kusala mambu speciation, yina ke tendula kaka kusalama ya bifwanisu ya mpa. Spéciation kele diambu yina fwete salama kaka mpi yo kele ti kitini ya mfunu mingi ya evolution.

src: Plants make oxygen which humans breathe, and they take in carbon-dioxide which humans exhale (that is, breathe out).
trg: Banti ke basisaka oxygène to mupepe ya mbote yina bantu ke fulumunaka, yo ke bakaka dioxyde ya carbone to mupepe ya mbi yina bantu ke basisaka.

src: Plants make their food from the sun by photosynthesis. They also provide shade.
trg: Banti ke salaka madia na yo katuka na ntangu na nzila ya photosynthese, yo mpi ke pesaka kivudi (ombre).

src: We make our houses from plants and make clothes from plants. Most foods that we eat are plants. Without plants, animals could not survive.
trg: Beto ke tungaka banzo na beto na banti mpi ke ke salaka bilele na banti. Madia mingi ya beto ke diaka kele banti. Kukonda banti, bambisi lenda lenda kuvanda ve na luzingu.

src: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.
trg: Mosasaurus vandaka mbisi ya ngolo na ntangu na yandi, yo vandaka kutina kima mosi ve, katula kaka ba mosasaures ya nkaka.

src: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.
trg: Matama na yandi ya nda yina ke kangamaka ngolo na meno ya makasi 70 kuluta, mpi bima ya nkaka kuluta na zulu ya munoko na yandi, yo ke tendula nde kima mosi ve ke kuna ti yo lenda guluka.

src: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.
trg: Beto me zaba mbotei ve, kansi yo lenda kuvanda na ludimi ya nsongi. Madia na yo kele mfulu, mbisi ya masa ya nene, ba mosasaurs na ya nkaka, mpi mbala ya nkaka yo vandaka kudia bantu.

src: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.
trg: Yo vandaka kunwanisa konso kima yina vandaka kukota na masa; ata dinosaure ya nene bonso T. rex lenda telama ve na ntwala na yo.

src: While most of their food would be familiar to us, Romans did have their share of strange or unusual feast items, including wild boar, peacock, snails, and a type of rodent called a dormouse
trg: Ata madia na bo mingi kele mpila mosi na ya beto, Baroma vandaka na bima na bo ya kuyituka to ya mpila ya ya nkaka na bafeti, mu mbandu ngulu ya mfinda, ndeke ya bo ke bingaka paon, bambembe ti bampuku ya mpila ya nkaka na zina ya loir.

src: Another difference was that while the poor people and the woman ate their food while sitting in chairs, the rich men liked to have banquets together where they would lounge on their sides while they ate their meals.
trg: Luswaswanu ya nkaka vandaka nde ntangu bansukami ti bankento vandaka kudia madia ntangu bo me vanda na kiti, bamvwama vandaka kuzola kusala bafete kumosi kisika bo vandaka kufonga na balweka na bo ntangu bo ke dia.

src: Ancient Roman meals couldn't have included foods that came to Europe from America or from Asia in later centuries.
trg: Madia ya Baroma ya ntama lendaka ve kuvanda na madia yina kwisaka na Europa/Mputu katuka na Amerika to na Azia na bamvu-nkama ya me luta.

src: For instance, they didn't have corn, nor tomatoes, nor potatoes, nor cocoa, and no ancient Roman ever tasted a turkey.
trg: Mu mbandu, bo kele ve na masangu, batomate, bambala, bacacao mpi muntu mosi ve ya Rome ya ntama me diaka dindon.

src: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god.
trg: Bana ya Babylone tungilaka banzambi na bo yonso tempolo mosi ya nene yina bo vandka kumona bonso nzo ya nzambi.

src: People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals.
trg: Bantu vandaka kunata bimenga na banzambi mpi banganga-nzambi vandaka kumeka kulungisa bampusa ya banzambi na nzila ya bankinsi.

src: Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter.
trg: Konso tempelo vandaka ti kibansala na y ya kukanguka mpi kisika ya santu na kati yina banganga-nzambi mpamba vandaka kukota.

src: Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples.
trg: Bantangu ya nkaka, banzo ya zulu ya mfunu, ya bo ke bingaka ziggurats, yina vandaka bonso bapyramide, yo salamaka sambu na kuvanda na batempelo.

src: The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.
trg: Nsongi ya nzozulu vandaka kisika ya santu sambu na nzambi.

src: In the warm climate of the Middle East, the house was not so important.
trg: Na climat ya tiya ya Moyen-Orient, nzo vandaka ve mfunu mingi.

src: Most of the life of the Hebrew family happened in the open air.
trg: Mambu mingi ya luzingu ya Baebreo vandaka kusalama na nganda.

src: Women did the cooking in the yard; stores were just open counters looking into the street. Stone was used for building houses.
trg: Bankento vandaka kulamba na kibansala; bamagasin vandaka kaka ba coin ya kukangula ya ke lata na balabala. Bo vandaka kusadila maadi sambu kutunga banzo.

src: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so wood was extremely expensive.
trg: Bayiti vandaka ve na ntoto ya Canaan, na bankuni vandaka ntalu mingi.

src: Greenland was settled sparsely. In the Norse sagas they say that Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder, and when travelling further west, found Greenland and named it Greenland.
trg: Groenland vandaka ve ti bantu mingi. Na masolo ya bantu ya norde, bo ke tubaka nde Erik the Red kwendaka kuzinga na Islande sambu yandi fwaka muntu, mpi na nzietelo na yandi na ndambu ya weste, yandi monaka Groenland mpi pesaka yo zina Groenland.

src: But regardless of his discovery, Eskimo tribes were already living there at the time.
trg: Kansi, ata mambu yina yandi monaka, makanda ya ba Eskimo vandaka dezia kuzinga kuna na ntangu yina.

src: Though each country was 'Scandinavian', there were many differences between the people, kings, customs and history of Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Iceland.
trg: Atanso insi vandaka ya "Scandinaveie", luswaswanu kuvandaka mingi na kati ya bantu, bantotila, bakiliya mpi mambu ya ntama ya Danemark, Suede, Norvege mpi Islande.

src: If you have watched the movie National Treasure, you may think a treasure map was written on the back of the Declaration of Independence.
trg: Kana nge talaka filme Kimvwama ya Insi, nge lenda yindula bo sonikaka karte ya kimvwama na nima ya bangogo ya kimpwanza.

src: However, that is not true. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a treasure map.
trg: Kansi, yo kele masonga ve. Ata yo kele ti kima mosi ya kusonika na nima ya mukanda, yo kele ve karte ya kimvwama.

src: Written on the back of the Declaration of Independence were the words "Original Declaration of Independence dated 4th July 1776". The text appears on the bottom of the document, upside down.
trg: Na na nima ya mukanda ya Bangogo ya Kimpwanza, bo sonikaka mambu yai "Bangogo ya Kimpwanza ya Luyantiku ya kilumbu ya 4 juillet 1776". Bangogo yango kele na nsuka ya mukanda, na lweka.

src: While no one knows for certain who wrote it, it is known that early in its life, the large parchment document (it measures 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was rolled up for storage.
trg: Ata muntu mosi ve me zaba na kieleka nani sonikaka yo, yo me zabana nde na luyantiku na yo, mukanda ya nene ya parchement (yo kele nene musapi ya ntete ya diboko 29¾ mpe 24½), bo bumbaka yo mbote kibeni.

src: So, it is likely that the notation was added simply as a label.
trg: Yo yina, yo ke monana nde bo yikaka bisono kaka bonso kidimbu ya kuzaba bo.

src: The D-Day landings and the following battles had freed the north of France, but the south still wasn't free.
trg: Na kilumbu ya Kulunga ya kubwa ya bavions mpi bitumba yina landaka pesaka norde ya France kimpwanza, kansi sude vandaka na kimpwanza te.

src: It was ruled by the "Vichy" French. These were French people who had made peace with the Germans in 1940 and worked with the invaders instead of fighting them.
trg: Bo vandaka kuyala yo na "Vichy" ya France. Bo vandaka bantu ya France yina salaka ngemba ti bantu ya Allemagne na mvu 1940 mpi bo salaka kumosi ti bantu yina botulaka bwalana kisika ya kunwanisa bo.

src: On 15 August 1940, the Allies invaded southern France, the invasion was called "Operation Dragoon".
trg: Na le 15 Août 1940, Ba Alliés kukotaka na sude ya France, bo bingaka kukota yina nde "Opération Dragoon".

src: In just two weeks the Americans and Free French forces had liberated southern France and were turning towards Germany.
trg: Kaka na bamposo zole, basoda ya Amerika mpi ya France yina kumaka na kimpwanza gulusaka sude ya France mpi vandaka kubaluka na Allemagne.

src: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.
trg: Civilisation kele kinkulu mosi yina kimvuka ya nene ya bantu ke vandaka ti yo, bantu yango ke zingaka mpi ke salaka kumosi, bo kele kimvuka.

src: The word civilization comes from the Latin civilis, meaning civil, related to the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and that also somehow defines the size of the society.
trg: Ngogo civilisation me katuka na ngogo ya Latin civilis, yina ke tendula sivile, yo me katuka na ngogo civis, yina ke tendula muntu ya, mpi civitas, yina ke tendula mbanza to mbanza yina kele insi, mpi yo ke tendulaka mpi ntangu ya bantu ya kele kuna.

src: City-states are the precursors of nations. A civilizational culture implies the passing on of knowledge across several generations, a lingering cultural footprint and fair dissemination.
trg: Bambanza yina kele bansi sadisaka na kubasisa bansi. Kinkulu ya civilisation mosi ke tendula kulutisa mayele na bandonga mingi ya bantu, kubikila bantu ya nkaka mambu ya ntama mpi kukabula yo mbote.

src: Minor cultures often vanish without leaving relevant historic evidence and fail to be recognized as proper civilizations.
trg: Mbala mingi binkulu ya fioti ke vilaka kukonda kubikisa banzikisaya ngolo mpi bantu ke yibukaka yo ve bonso civilisation ya mbote.

src: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation.
trg: Na ntangu ya mvita ya Kimpwanza, baprovense kumi na tatu salaka ntete luyalu mosi ya kimvuka; Congrès vandaka kisadilu na yo mosi mpamba, na kulanda nsiku ya Confédération.

src: Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts.
trg: Congrès vandaka ve ti kiyeka ya kufutisa bampaku, mpi sambu bo vandaka ve ti kimfumu ya nene to bantu ya kusambisa, yo vandaka kutula ntima na bamfumu ya baprovense, yina mbala mingi vandaka ve kuwakana ti bo, sambu na kupusa bantu na kuzitisa bansiku na bo.

src: It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states.
trg: Yo vandaka mpi ve ti kiyeka ya kufwa bansiku mpi bantalu ya mpaku na kati ya baprovense.

src: The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.
trg: Yo vandaka kulomba baprovense yonso kundima Bansiku na ntwala nde bo soba yo mpi baprovense vandaka kuzitisa ve luyalu yo yina mbala mingi mimonisi na bo vandaka kukwisa ka bo ve.

src: Italy's national football, along with German national football team is the second most successful team in the world and were the FIFA World Cup champions in 2006.
trg: Ekipe nationale ya nkweso ya Italie, kumosi ti ekipe nationale ya nkweso ya Allemagne, kele ekipe zole ya me nngaka mingi na ntoto ya mvimba mpi bo nungaka Coupe du Monde ya FIFA na 2006.

src: Popular sports include football, basketball, volleyball, water-polo, fencing, rugby, cycling, ice hockey, roller hockey and F1 motor racing.
trg: Bansaka ya bantu yonso kele nkweso, basketball, volleyball, Water polo, fencing, rugby, kunata velo, kusielumuka na glace, kulosa Hockey mpi F1 to ntinu ya voitures.

src: Winter sports are most popular in the Northern regions, with Italians competing in international games and Olympic events.
trg: Bansaka ya nsungi ya madidi ke mingi na bandambu ya norde, mpi bantu ya Italie ke vukanaka na bansaka ya bansi yonso mpi ya Olimpique.

src: Japans holds nearly 7,000 islands (the biggest being Honshu), making Japan the 7th largest island in the world!
trg: Japon kele na bisanga kiteso ya 7 000 (ya nene kuluta kele Honshu), yo ke salaka nde Japon kuvanda kisanga ya 7 ya kuluta nene na ntoto ya mvimba!

src: Due to the cluster/group of islands Japan has, Japan is often referred to, on a geographical stance, as an "archipelago"
trg: Sambu na kimvuka ya bisanga yina Japon kele ti yo, mbala mingi bo ke bingaka Japon, "archipel" to kimvuka ya bisanga.

src: Taiwan beginning start way back in 15th century where European sailors passing by record the island’s name as Ilha Formosa, or beautiful island.
trg: Taïwan bandaka na mvu-nkama ya 15, ntangu bantu ya maswa ya Europa yina vandaka kuluta pesaka kisanga yina zina ya Ilha Formosa, to kisanga ya kitoko.

src: In 1624,Dutch East India Company establishes a base in southwestern Taiwan, initiating a transformation in aboriginal grain production practices and employing Chinese laborers to work on its rice and sugar plantations.
trg: Na 1624, Kompani ya Pays-Bas ya Inde ya est salaka camp mosi na sude-weste ya Taiwan, bo bandaka kusoba bisadilu ya ba céréale ya bantu ya bwala ti kutula bantu ya kisalu ya Chines na kisalu sambu na kusala bilanga ya loso ti ya mikuku.

src: In 1683, Qing dynasty (1644-1912) forces take control of Taiwan’s western and northern coastal areas and declared Taiwan as a province of the Qing Empire in 1885.
trg: Na mvula 1683, luyalu ya Qing (1644-1912) bakaka na kingolo-ngolo weste mpi norde ya Taiwan mpi yo kumisaka Taiwan provense ya Kintinu ya Qing na 1885.

src: In 1895, after defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signs the Treaty of Shimonoseki, by which it cedes sovereignty over Taiwan to Japan, which rules the island until 1945.
trg: Na 1895, na nima ya kubela na bitumba ya ntete ya Chine na Japon (1894-1895), luyalu ya Qing kutulaka maboko na mukanda ya kuwakana ya Shimonoseki, yai wapi bo pesaka Japon kiyeka ya kuyala Taiwan, yina yalaka kisanga yina tii na 1945.

src: Machu Picchu consist of three main structures, namely Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun, and the Room of the Three Windows.
trg: Macchu Picchu kele na bitini tatu ya mfunu, disongidila Intuhuatana, Tempelo ya Ntangu, mpi Nzo ya Bafenetre Tatu.

src: Most of the buildings on the edges of the complex have been rebuilt in order to give tourists a better idea of how they originally appeared.
trg: Banzo mingi ya kele na balweka ya nzo yina, bo tungaka yo sambu na kusadisa bantu ya ke kwisaka kutala babwala na kumona mutindu yo basikaka na luyantiku.

src: By 1976, thirty percent of Machu Picchu had been restored and restoration continues till today.
trg: Na 1976, bo yidikaka deja 30 pour cent ya Machu Picchu, mpi bo ke landa kuyidika yo tii bubu yai.

src: For example, the most common still image photography format in the world is 35mm, which was the dominant film size at the close of the analog film era.
trg: Mu mbandu, kifwanisu ya photo ya bantu yonso kuzaba kuluta kele mm35, yai ya vandaka nene ya filme ya kumonana mingi ntangu ya bafilme ya ntama ya analogie.

src: It is still produced today, but more importantly its aspect ratio has been inherited by digital camera image sensor formats.
trg: Bo ke landaka kubasisa yo tii bubu, kansi kima ya kuluta mfunu kele nde, luswaswanu ya kele na kati ya nda / largeur katukaka na midele ya bima ya ke bendaka bifwanisu ya appareil ya foto ya numérique.

src: The 35mm format is actually, somewhat confusingly, 36mm in width by 24mm in height.
trg: Format ya 35 mmm ke kotisaka mavwanga mbala mingi, mpi 36 mmm na nene na 24 mmm na nda.

src: The aspect ratio of this format (dividing by twelve to obtain the simplest whole-number ratio) is therefore said to be 3:2.
trg: Kifwani ya ratio ya format yai (kukabula na kumi na zole sambu na kuzwa lutangu ya ratio ya mbote) yo kele 3:2.

src: Many common formats (APS family of formats, for example) are equal to or closely approximate this aspect ratio.
trg: Baformat mingi ya me zabanaka (mu mbandu, ya kimvuka ya APS) kele na kiteso mosi to kele pene-pene ya kiteso yina.

src: The much-abused and often-ridiculed rule of thirds is a simple guideline creating dynamism while keeping a measure of order in an image.
trg: Mpila ya mbala ya tatu, yai bo bebisaka ti ya mbote mpenza ve, kele ndonga ya nene sambu na kusala dynamisme na kubumba mpila mosi ya mbote na kati ya kifwanisu.

src: It states that the most effective place for the main subject is at the intersection of lines dividing the image into thirds vertically and horizontally (see example).
trg: Yo ke tuba nde kisika ya kuluta mfunu sambu na ntu diambu kele na kukutana ya bandonga ya ke kabisa kifwanisu na bitini ya tatu na kukulumuka na nsi mpi na kulandana na nene (tala mbandu).

src: During this period of European history, the Catholic Church, which had become rich and powerful, came under scrutiny.
trg: Na ntangu yai ya disolo ya bantu ya Europa, Nzo-Nzambi ya Katolika, yina kumaka ti kimvwama mpi ngolo, bo kumaka kulandila yo.

src: For over a thousand years the Christian religion had bound European states together despite differences in language and customs. I
trg: Na nsungi ya kulufa funda mosi, dibundu ya Bukristu kangaka makanda ya Europa kumosi ata bo swaswanaka na bandinga mpi na bikalulu.

src: Its all-pervading power affected everyone from king to commoner.
trg: Kiyeka na yo ya nene vandaka na bantu yonso, banda na ntotila tii na muntu ya mpamba.

src: One of the main Christian tenets is that wealth should be used to alleviate suffering and poverty and that the monetary funds of the church are there specifically for that reason.
trg: Dilongo mosi ya mfunu ya Bukristu kele nde bo fwete sadila kimvwama sambu na kulembika mpasi mpi kinsukami mpi nde mbongo ya bo ke bakaka na dibundu ke vandaka sambu na lukanu yina.

src: The central authority of the church had been in Rome for over a thousand years and this concentration of power and money led many to question whether this tenet was being met.
trg: Kiyeka ya nene ya dibundu ke vandaka na Roma na nsungi ya kuluta funda mosi mpi kiyeka yina ya kele kisika mosi mpi mbongo yina me pusaka bantu mingi na kutula ntembe kana bo ke lungisaka lukanu yina.

src: Soon after the outbreak of hostilities, Britain initiated a naval blockade of Germany.
trg: Ntangu fyoti, na nima ya luyantiku ya bitumba, Grande Bretagne bakaka lukanu ya kukanga basoda ya maswa ya Allemagne nzila.

src: The strategy proved effective, cutting off vital military and civilian supplies, although this blockade violated generally accepted international law codified by several international agreements of the past two centuries.
trg: Mayele yina sadisaka mingi, yo kangaka basoda mpi bima mingi ya mfunu ya bo vandaka kunatila bo, ata diambu yina fwaka nsiku yina bansi mingi ndimaka na bamvu-nkama zole yina lutaka.

src: Britain mined international waters to prevent any ships from entering entire sections of ocean, causing danger to even neutral ships.
trg: Grande-Bretagne bebisaka bamasa ya bansi mingi sambu na kukanga konso maswa ya basoda na kukota na bitini ya nzadi-mungwa, mpi yo vandaka kigonsa ata sambu na bamaswa ya kele ve na bitumba.

src: Since there was limited response to this tactic, Germany expected a similar response to its unrestricted submarine warfare.
trg: Sambu bantu tubaka mpenza ve kima sambu na mayele yina, Allemagne vandaka kukinga mvutu ya mutindu mosi na binwaninu na yandi ya sous-marin.

src: During the 1920s, the prevailing attitudes of most citizens and nations was that of pacifism and isolation.
trg: Na bamvu 1920, bikalulu ya bantu mpi ya bansi mingi vandaka ya ngemba mpi kudivandila.

src: After seeing the horrors and atrocities of war during World War I, nations desired to avoid such a situation again in the future.
trg: Na nima ya kutala booma mpi ya bampasi ya bitumba ya Ntete ya Ntoto ya Mvimba, makanda vandaka kubuya kukuktana diaka ti mambu ya mutindu yina na bilumbu ke kwisa.

src: In 1884, Tesla moved to the United States of America to accept a job with the Edison Company in New York City.
trg: Na 1884, Tesla kwendaka na Etats-Unis ya Amerika samb una kundima kisalu na kompangi Edison na mbanza New York.

src: He arrived in the US with 4 cents to his name, a book of poetry, and a letter of recommendation from Charles Batchelor (his manager in his previous job) to Thomas Edison.
trg: Yandi kumaka na Etats Unis na bacent 4 na zina na ayndi, mukanda mosi ya poemi, mpi mukanda ya recommandaion ya me katuka na Charles Batchelor (mfumu na yandi ya ntama ya kisalu) yina yandi tindilaka Thomas Edison.

src: Ancient China had a unique way of showing different time periods; each stage of China or each family that was in power was a distinctive dynasty.
trg: Chine ya ntama vandaka ti mpila na yo mosi ya kusonga bansungi ya kuswaswa; konso kitambi ya Chine to ya konso dibuta yina vandaka na kiyeka vandaka kimfumu ya kuswaswana.

src: Also between each dynasty was an unstable age of divided provinces. The best-known of these periods was the Three Kingdoms epoch taking place for 60 years between the Han and the Jin Dynasty.
trg: Diaka, na kati ya konso luyalu yo vandaka ti nsungi mosi ya baprovense ya kukabwana. Nsungi ya me zabana mingi vandaka nsungi ya Bimfumu Tatu yina salaka bamvula 60 banda na luyalu ya Han mpi ya Jin.

src: During these periods fierce warfare took place between many nobles fighting for the throne.
trg: Na bansungi yina, bitumba ya ngolo salamaka na kati ya mabuta mingi ya kimfumu yina vandaka kunwana kiti ya kimfumu.

src: The Three Kingdoms was one of the bloodiest eras in Ancient China’s history thousands of people died fighting to sit in the highest seat in the grand palace at Xi’an.
trg: Bimfumu Tatu vandaka nsungi yina bo fwaka bantu mingi kibeni na disolo ya Chine ya ntama, bo fwaka sambu bo vandaka kusosa kuvanda na kiti ya kimfumu ya nzo ya nene ya Xi’an.

src: There are a lot of social and political effects such as the use of metric system, a shift from absolutism to republicanism, nationalism and the belief the country belongs to the people not to one sole ruler.
trg: yo kele na bamvutu mingi na kikunku ya bantu na na politiki ke bebisaka mutindu kusadila ntezolo, nsalulu ya luyalu mosi ti na luyalu na lutumu na bantu, luyalu ya yinsi kaka na ku sala kivuvu na yinsi kele kima yina kele ya bana ya yinsi ya muntu mosi ve ke kuyala.

src: Also after the Revolution occupations were open to all male applicants allowing the most ambitious and successful to succeed.
trg: Diaka, na nima ya Kimpwanza, nzila pesamaka na bana ya bakala nyonso na kulonguka mpi bayina vandaka ti nzala mingi mpi kununga, bakaka kiyeka.

src: Same goes for the military because instead of army rankings being based on class they were now based on cailaber.
trg: Yo kele mpila mosi na basoda, sambu na kisika ya kupesa kiyeka na kisosa na kutadila nzo-nkanda, bo vandaka kupesa yo na kutadila cailaber.

src: The French Revolution also inspired many other repressed working class people of other country's to began their own revolutions.
trg: Kusosa kimpwanza ya France pesaka mpi bantu mingi ya bo vandaka kuniokula ya bansi ya nkaka na kuyantika kusosa kimpwanza na bo mpi.
