src: Muhammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. He used to frequent a cave that became known as “Hira‘” on the Mountain of “Noor” (light) for contemplation.
trg: Muhammed vandaka kudipesa mingi na mambu ya kuluta mambu ya luzingu yai. Yandi vandaka kusadila mbala mingi dibundu yina bo kumaka kuvinga "Hira" na Ngumba ya " Nor" (nsemo) sambu na kuyindulula.

src: he cave itself, which survived the times, gives a very vivid image of Muhammad’s spiritual inclinations.
trg: Yandi timunaka yo yandi mosi, mpi yo zingaka mingi, yo ke sadisa na kuzaba bikalulu ya kimpeve ya Muhammad.

src: Resting on the top of one of the mountains north of Mecca, the cave is completely isolated from the rest of the world.
trg: Sambu yo kele na zulu ya ngumba mosi ya norde ya Mecque, dibulu yina kele mpenza na kingenga ya ntoto ya mvimba.

src: In fact, it is not easy to find at all even if one knew it existed. Once inside the cave, it is a total isolation.
trg: Ya kieleka, yo kele mpasi na kumona ata nge me zaba nde yo kele. Kana nge kota na kati, yo kele kibeni na kingenga.

src: Nothing can be seen other than the clear, beautiful sky above and the many surrounding mountains. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.
trg: Nge lenda mona ve ata kima mosi katula kaka zulu ya pwelele mpi ya kitoko mpi bangumba ya pene-pene. Nge lenda mona to kuwa kaka mambu fioti ya nsi-ntoto yai kana nge kele na kati ya dibulu yina.

src: The Great Pyramid at Giza is the only one of the seven wonders that is still standing today.
trg: Pyramide ya nene ya Gaza kele pyramide mosi mpamba na kati ya bima ya kuyituka nsambwadi yina me fwaka ntete ve tii bubu yai.

src: Built by the Egyptians in the third century BCE, the Great Pyramid is one of many large pyramid structures built to honor dead Pharaoh.
trg: Bantu ya Egypte bantu tungaka Pyaramide ya Nene na mvu-nkama ya tatu na ntwala ya ntangu na beto, yo kele mso na kati ya bapyramide ya nene oyo bo me tungaka sambu na lukumu ya Farao ya me fwaka.

src: The Giza Plateau, or "Giza Necropolis" in the Egyptian Valley of the Dead contains several pyramids (of which the great pyramid is the largest), several small tombs, several temples, and the great Sphinx.
trg: Plateau ya Giza to "Giza Necropolis" na muwanda ya kufwa ya Egypte kele ti bapyramide mingi (pyramide ya nene kekle ya kuluta nene), bamaziamu mingi ya fioti, batempelo mingi mpi Sphinx ya nene.

src: The great pyramid was created to honor the Pharaoh Khufu, and many of the smaller pyramids, tombs, and temples were built to honor Khufu's wives and family members.
trg: Bo salaka pyramide ya nene sambu na lukumu ya Pharaon Khufu, mpi bo tungaka mingi ya bapyramide ya nkaka ya fioti, bamaziami ti batempelo sambu na kupesa lukumu na bankento mpi na bantu ya dibuta ya Khufu.

src: The "up bow" mark looks like a V and the "down bow mark" like a staple or a square missing its bottom side.
trg: Kidimbu ya "bula na zulu" ke monana bonso V mpi "kidimbu ya bula na insi" bonso agraphe to bonso carre yoa kukonda bansuka na yo.

src: Up means you should start at the tip and push the bow, and down means you should start at the frog (which is where your hand is holding the bow) and pull the bow.
trg: Na zulu ke tendula nde nge fwete yantika na nsongi mpi kupusa tolotolo, mpi na nsi yo ke tendula nge fwete yantika dikototo (kisika yayi diboko na nge ke simba tolotolo) mpi kubula tolotolo.

src: An up-bow usually generates a softer sound, while a down-bow is stronger and more assertive.
trg: Arc en ciel na zulu ke pesaka ndinga ya pete, kana yo ke na nsi yo ke pesaka ndinga ya ngolo mpi ya mbote.

src: Feel free to pencil in your own marks, but remember the printed bowing marks are there for a musical reason, so they should usually be respected.
trg: Nge ke na kimpwanza ya kusonika na biki na nge mosi, kansi kuvila ve nde kidimbu ya tolotolo ya bo me niema kele sambu na miziki, yo yina nge fwete zitisa yo ntangu yonso.

src: The terrified King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette their two young children (11 year old Marie Therese and four year old Louis-Charles) and the King's sister, Madam Elizabeth, on the 6th October 1789 were forced back to Paris from Versailles by a mob of market women.
trg: Mfumu Louis XVI, mfumu ya nkento Marie-Antoinette, bana na bo zole ya baleke (Marie Thérèse, ya bamvula 11 ti Louis-Charles, ya bamvula 4) mpi mpangi ya nkento ya mfumu, Mama Elizabeth, yina vandaka na boma ya ngolo na le 6 Octobre 1789 bo vutulaka bo na ngolo na Paris katuka na Versailles na bantu ya mbulu yina vandaka na zandu ya bankento.

src: In a carriage, they traveled back to Paris surrounded by a mob of people screaming and shouting threats against the King and Queen.
trg: Na vwaturi mosi, bo vutukaka na Paris ya kuziungama na kimvuka ya bantu vandaka kuboka mpi kubangisa Ntotila mpi Mfumu ya nkento.

src: The mob of people forced the King And Queen to have their carriage windows wide open.
trg: Bantu ya mbulu pusaka Ntotila mpi Mfumu ya nkento na kubikisa bafenetre ya kaminio na bo ya kukangula.

src: At one point a member of the mob waved the head of a royal guard killed at Versailles in front of the terrified Queen.
trg: Na ntangu mosi buna, muntu mosi na kimvuka ya bantu nikisaka ntu ya sosa ya vandaka kukengila dibuta ya kimfumu na Versailles na ntwala ya Mfumu ya nkento yina vandaka na boma ya ngolo.

src: The war expenditures of U.S. imperialism in the conquest of the Philippines were paid for by the Filipino people themselves.
trg: Bantu ya Philippines bo mosi bantu futaka mbongo ya bitumba yina bantu ya Amerika sadilaka sambu na kubotula Philippines.

src: They were compelled to pay taxes to the U.S. colonial regime to defray a major part of the expenditures and the interest on bonds floated in the name of the Philippine government through the Wall Street banking houses.
trg: Bo pusaka bo na ngolo na kufuta bampaku na luyalu ya nku ya Etats-Unis sambu bo pesa mingi ya mbongo yina na depanse ya bitumba mpi na mambote ya na bo, bo vandaka kutinda yo na babanke ya Wall Street na zina ya luyalu ya Philippines.

src: Of course, the superprofits derived from the protracted exploitation of the Filipino people would constitute the basic gains of U.S. imperialism.
trg: Ya kieleka, mbongo ya vandaka kukatuka na mutindu bo vandaka kuniokula bantu ya Philippines na kusala bisalu ya ngolo, sadisaka mingi Etats-Unis na kuzwa mbongo.

src: To understand the Templars one must understand the context that prompted the creation of the order.
trg: Sambu na kubakisa Templars, muntu fwete bakisa ntete nki mambu salaka nde bo tula ndonga.

src: The age where the events took place is commonly referred as the High Middle Ages the period of European history in the 11th, 12th, and 13th centuries (AD 1000–1300).
trg: Nsungi yina mambu yango salamaka, bo ke bingaka yo mbala nde Moyen Age ya Nene, nsungi ya disolo ya Europa ya mvu-nkama ya 11, 12, mpi 13 (1000-1300 ya Ntangu na beto).

src: The High Middle Ages were preceded by the Early Middle Ages and followed by the Late Middle Ages, which by convention ends around 1500.
trg: Haut Moyen Âge ya landaka début du moyen âge mpi yo landamaka na nsuka ya Moyen Âge, yina mpila bantu ke tubaka sukaka pene ya mvu 1500.

src: Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of ideas in practice, from technology-push or the technological imperative to a strict sense that human destiny is driven by an underlying logic associated with scientific laws and their manifestation in technology.
trg: Déterministe Technologique kele bangogo yina kele ti bantendula mingi, banda na kutindika technologie to yina technologie fwete sala, tii na ngindu ya ke monisa nde makwisa ya bantu me simbama na mambu ya mfunu ya kele na kuwakana ti bansiku ya siansi mpi mutindu bo ke monisaka yo na techonologie.

src: Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has "effects" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned.
trg: Bangindu mingi ya ke tadila Déterministe Technologique ke vandaka ti mabanza zole: kuyela ya technologie yo mosi ke landaka nzila yina ke wakana ve ti bupusi ya kinkulu to ya politiki, mpe nde technologie ke vandaka na "boupusi" na luzingu ya bantu kele ya kuwakana kansi ve mambu ya luzingu.

src: For example, one might say that the motor car necessarily leads to the development of roads.
trg: Mu mbandu, muntu lenda tuba nde bakamio kele bima yina sadisaka sambu bo sala banzila.

src: However, a nationwide road network is not economically viable for just a handful of cars, so new methods of production are developed to reduce the cost of car ownership.
trg: Kansi, nzila ya nene ya bantu nyonso ke lutilaka kele ve mfunu na mambu ya mbongo kaka sambu na ndambu ya bakamio, yo yina bametode ya mpa ya kusala yo, bo ke salama sambu na kukulumusa bantu ya bantu ya kele ti bakamio.

src: Mass car ownership also leads to a higher incidence of accidents on the roads, which leads to the invention of new techniques in healthcare for repairing damaged bodies.
trg: Kuvanda ti bakamion mingi salaka mpi nde bisumbula kusalama mingi na banzila, yo sadisaka na kubasisa mayele ya mpa na mambu ya kimunganga sambu na kuyidika nitu ya me bukana.

src: Romanticism had a large element of cultural determinism, drawn from writers such as Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel.
trg: Kusonika mikanda ya zola kele ti bupusi mingi na kinkulu ya determinisme, ya bo me baka na bansoniki mu mbandu Goethe, Fichte, na Schlegel.

src: In the context of Romanticism, the geography molded individuals, and over time customs and culture related to that geography arose, and these, being in harmony with the place of the society, were better than arbitrarily imposed laws.
trg: Na yayi ketala romantisme, géografi yo me sobaka bantu, mpi na nima ya bambula binkulu mpi bansiku ya bambuta ya ke wakana ti geographi yina basikaka, mpi mambu yina, sambu yo ke wakana ti kisika ya kimvuka ya bantu, yo vandaka mbote kuluta bansiku ya bo me tula na kingolo-ngolo.

src: In the manner that Paris is known as the fashion capital of the contemporary world, Constantinople was regarded as the fashion capital of feudal Europe.
trg: Mutindu Paris me zabanaka bonso nto-mbanza ya mode ya ntoto ya mvimba ya bubu, Constantinople vandaka bonso nto-mbanza ya mode ya Europa féodale.

src: Its renown for being an epicenter of luxury began in about 400 A.D. and lasted up until about 1100 A.D.
trg: Lukumu na yo bonso kisika ya nene ya luxe yantikaka pene-pene ya mvu 400 ya ntangu na beto mpi yo kwendaka tii pene-pene ya mvu 1100 ya ntangu na beto.

src: Its status declined during the twelfth century mainly due to the fact that Crusaders had returned bearing gifts such as silks and spices that were valued more than what Byzantine markets offered.
trg: Lukumu na yo kulumukaka na mvu-nkama ya 12 mingi-mingi sambu na bantu ya kwendaka bitumba ya santu kwisaka kuvutuka ti makabu mu mbandu ba soies ti baépice yina bantu vandaka kuzola kuluta bima yina vandaka na bazandu ya Byzance.

src: It was at this time that the transfer of the title of Fashion Capital from Constantinople to Paris was made.
trg: Bo katulaka Constantinople lukumu ya nto-mbanza ya mode mpi bo pesaka yo na Paris na nsungi yina.

src: Gothic style peaked in the period between the 10th - 11th centuries and the 14th century.
trg: Modele ya ba Gothique vandaka na nsungi yina kele na kati ya mvu-nkama ya 10 mpi 11 mpi mvu-nkama ya 14.

src: At the beginning dress was heavily influenced by the Byzantine culture in the east.
trg: Na luyantiku, bilele ya bo vandaka kusala bandaka kulanda mingi kinkulu ya Byzantine ya este.

src: However, due to the slow communication channels, styles in the west could lag behind by 25 to 30 year.
trg: Kansi, sambu nsangu vandaka kumwangana ve nswalu, mode ya ouest lendaka kubikala na nsima na bamvula 25 tii na 30.

src: towards the end of the Middle Ages western Europe began to develop their own style. one of the biggest developments of the time as a result of the crusades people began to use buttons to fasten clothing.
trg: Pene-pene ya nsuka ya Moyen Âge, Europe ya ouest yantikaka kusala mode na bo mosi. Kima mosi ya mfunu mingi ya bo salaka na ntangu yina sambu na bitumba ya santu kele mutindu bantu yantikaka kusadila babuton sambu na kukanga bilele.

src: Subsistence agriculture is agriculture carried out for the production of enough food to meet just the needs of the agriculturalist and his/her family.
trg: Kisalu ya bilanga kaka sambu na kudia kele yina ke salema sambu nde mingi ya madia yina ya bo ke basisa kulunga sambu na kulungisa bampusa ya muntu ya me sala bilanga mpi dibuta na yandi.

src: Subsistence agriculture is a simple, often organic, system using saved seed native to the ecoregion combined with crop rotation or other relatively simple techniques to maximize yield.
trg: Kusala bilanga sambu kaka na kusansa dibuta kele mpasi ve, mbala mingi bo ke salaka yo ya bima ya bwala, bambuma ya kukuna kele yina bantu bumbaka, mpi bo ke sadilaka mayele ya nkaka sambu bambuma kubuta mingi.

src: Historically most farmers were engaged in subsistence agriculture and this is still the case in many developing nations.
trg: Na kutadila masolo ya ntama, bantu mingi ya bilanga vadnaka kusala bilanga sambu na kudia na bo mosi mpi yo kele kaka mutindu yina na bansi mingi ya kinsukami.

src: Subcultures bring together like-minded individuals who feel neglected by societal standards and allow them to develop a sense of identity.
trg: Ba sous-cultures ke vukisaka bantu yina ke vandaka na bangindu ya mutindu mosi, bayina ke yindulaka nde bo ke kipaka bo ve mpi yo ke sadisaka bo na kudizaba mbote.

src: Subcultures can be distinctive because of the age, ethnicity, class, location, and/or gender of the members.
trg: Ba sous-culture lenda vanda ya kuswaswana sambu na mvula, dikanda, kimvuka ya bantu, kisika, mpi/to kana yandi kele bakala to nkento.

src: The qualities that determine a subculture as distinct may be linguistic, aesthetic, religious, political, sexual, geographical, or a combination of factors.
trg: Bikalulu ya ke monisaka sous-cultures nde yo kele ya kuswaswana lenda vanda ndinga, esthetique, mambu ya lusambu, ya politiki, ya kuvukisa nitu, ya geographi, to ya mambu mingi na mbala mosi.

src: Members of a subculture often signal their membership through a distinctive and symbolic use of style, which includes fashions, mannerisms, and argot.
trg: Mbala mingi bantu ya sous-cultures ke monisaka nde bo kele na kimvuka yina na kusadila mutindu mpi bidimbu ya kuswaswana, yo lenda vanda mutindu ya kulwata, ya kusala mambu mpi ya kutuba.

src: One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up.
trg: Mosi ya mitindu ya me zabanaka ya bo ke sadilaka sambu na kumonisa mfunu ya socialisation kele ya kubakisa mabandu ya bana ya me kutanaka ti mambu ya mbi yina, sambu bo kipaka bo ve, bo kutanaka ti bampasi, to bo sadilaka bo mambu ya nku, bo vandaka kuvukana ve ti bambuta ntangu bo vandaka kuyela.

src: Such children are called "feral" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment.
trg: Bo ke bingaka bana yai "bambisi" to sauvages. Bana ya nkaka ya bambisi bo bumbaka bo na bantu (mingi mingi bibuti na bo); na bambandu ya nkaka, bibuti na bo kulaka bana yina sambu yandi vandaka mayele to vandaka ti kifu na nitu.

src: Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away.
trg: Bana ya bambisi, bo me sadilaka bo mambu ya nku to ya ke yangisaka mabanza na ntwala nde bo yambula bo to bo tina bo mosi.

src: Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own.
trg: Bo ke tubaka nde bo sansaka bankaka na bambisi; bo ke tubaka nde bankaka zingaka na mfinda na luzolo na bo mosi.

src: When completely brought up by non-human animals, the feral child exhibits behaviors (within physical limits) almost entirely like those of the particular care-animal, such as its fear of or indifference to humans.
trg: Kana bo me sansa bo kaka na bambisi yina kele ve bantu, bana yai ya bambisi ke vandaka ti bikalulu (na nitu na bo) ya kiteso mosi mpenza na ya bambisi yina sansaka bo, mu mbandu boma to kusepela ve ti bantu.

src: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond.
trg: Ata bisalu ya kulonguka fwete sadisa sambu kulonguka kuvanda pete mingi mpi kusepedisa, échafaudage yo ke sadisaka diaka mingi kuluta.

src: Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project.
trg: Escalier kele mpila mosi ya mbote ve ya kulonga kansi yo ke sadisaka sambu na kupesa lusadisu na bantu yayi ke longuka mpila ya mpa ya luzingu ya kulonguka bonso kusadila programe ya mpa ya ordinateur to kuyantika kisalu ya mpa.

src: Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office.
trg: Mutalaka lenda vanda ya virtuel mpi ya kieleka, na kutuba ya nkaka, longi kele bonso mutalaka kansi mutindu mosi ti trombone mosi ya fioti sambu na Microsoft Office.

src: Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.
trg: Baescalier ya virtuel ke vandaka na kati ya programe ya ordinateur mpi lukanu na yo kele ve ya kuyula, kubasisa, to kutendula mutindu ya kusala mambu yina lenda vandaka mpasi nde longoki kusala yo yandi mosi.

src: Children are placed in Foster Care for a wide variety of reasons that range from neglect, to abuse, and even to extortion.
trg: Bo ke tulaka bana na Mabuta ya Kusansa sambu na bikuma mingi mu mbandu kukipe bo ve, kuniokula bo, mpi nkutu kusadisa bo bisalu ya ngolo.

src: No child should ever have to grow up in an environment that is not nurturing, caring, and educational, but they do.
trg: Mwana mosi ve lenda yela na kisika yina kele ve ya mbote, ya zola, mpi ya bo ke longaka bo, kansi yo ke salamaka mutindu yina.

src: We perceive the Foster Care System to be a safety zone for these children.
trg: Beto ke monsaka ngidika ya Mabuta ya Kusansabana bonso kisika ya lutaninu sambu na bana yai.

src: Our foster care system is supposed to provide safe homes, loving caregivers, stable education, and reliable health care.
trg: Ngidika na beto ya mabuta ya kusana bana fwete pesa bana nzo ya ke na lutaninu, bantu ya zola ya ke keba yandi, malongi ya me fwana, mpi kukeba mbote sante na yandi.

src: Foster care is supposed to provide all the necessities that were lacking in the home they were previously taken from.
trg: Mabuta ya kusana fwete pesa bana bima yonso ya mfunu yina bo kondaka na nzo yina bo katulaka bo kisika bo vandaka ntete.

src: The Internet combines elements of both mass and interpersonal communication.
trg: Internet ke vukisaka bima ya kusolula ya bantu mingi mpi ya muntu mosi.

src: The distinct characteristics of the Internet lead to additional dimensions in terms of the uses and gratifications approach.
trg: Mutindu ya pwelele yina Internet ke salaka mambu me sadisaka na kubasisa mambu ya nkaka na yina me tala mutindu ya kusadila mpi mayele ya kusadila.

src: For example, “learning” and “socialization” are suggested as important motivations for Internet use (James et al., 1995).
trg: Mu mbandu, bantu ke tubaka nde "kulonguka" mpi "kuvukana ti bantu" ke pusaka mingi bantu na kusadila Internet (James ti banduku, 1995).

src: “Personal involvement” and “continuing relationships” were also identified as new motivation aspects by Eighmey and McCord (1998) when they investigated audience reactions to websites.
trg: Eighmey na McCord (1998) tubaka mpi nde "kudipesa ya muntu" mpi "kulanda kinduku" kele bima ya mpa ya ke pusaka bantu; bo tubaka yo na nima ya kulandila mambu ya bantu ke salaka na baiste Internet.

src: The use of video recording has led to important discoveries in the interpretation of micro-expressions, facial movements which last a few milliseconds.
trg: Kusadila video me sadisaka na kubasisa mambu ya fioti-fioti ya kutuba, bidimbu ya luse ya ke bakaka basegondi fioti kibeni.

src: In particular, it is claimed that one can detect whether a person is lying by interpreting micro-expressions correctly.
trg: Mingi-mingi, bo ke tubaka nde nge lenda zaba kana muntu ke kusa kana nge me zaba mbote kubakisa bidimbu ya fioti-fioti.

src: Oliver Sacks, in his paper The President's Speech, indicated how people who are unable to understand speech because of brain damage are nevertheless able to assess sincerity accurately.
trg: Oliver Sack, na mukanda na yandi Bangogo ya President, monisaka mutindu bantu yina ke kukaka ve kubakisa mambu ya bo ke tuba sambu butomfu me fwana ke kukaka kubakisa mbote kana yo kele masonga.

src: He even suggests that such abilities in interpreting human behavior may be shared by animals such as domestic dogs.
trg: Yandi tubaka nkutu nde makuki ya mutindu yai ya kuzaba bidimbu ya nitu ya muntu ke vandaka mpi na bamibisi mu mbandu bambwa ya bwala.

src: Twentieth century research has shown that there are two pools of genetic variation: hidden and expressed.
trg: Na mvu-nkama ya 20, bansosa me monisa nde yo kele ti mitindu zole ya me swaswana: yina ya kubumbana mpi yina ya ke monana.

src: Mutation adds new genetic variation, and selection removes it from the pool of expressed variation.
trg: Nsoba me yikaka mutindu ya mpa, mpi kupona ke katulaka yo na ndonga ya yina ke monanaka.

src: Segregation and recombination shuffle variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.
trg: Kukabula mpi kuvutula kisika mosi na ke sobaka luswaswanu na kati ya bimvuka zole na konso ndonga na yo.

src: Out on the savanna, it is hard for a primate with a digestive system like that of humans to satisfy its amino-acid requirements from available plant resources.
trg: Na nganda ya matiti, yo kele mpasi sambu na mbisi yina kele ngidika ya kudia bonso ya bantu kulungisa bampusa na yandi ya amino-acide na banti ya kele kuna.

src: Moreover, failure to do so has serious consequences: growth depression, malnutrition, and ultimately death.
trg: Diaka, kukonda kusala mpidina ke na kigonsa ya nene: mpasi ya kuyela, kudia mbote ve, mpi nsuka-nsuka lufwa.

src: The most readily accessible plant resources would have been the proteins accessible in leaves and legumes, but these are hard for primates like us to digest unless they are cooked.
trg: Bima ya kukonda mpasi yina bo lenda banka na banti zolaka kuvanda baproteine yina kele na matiti mpi na bandunda, kansi yo kele mpasi nde beto dia yo mbote kana bo me lamba yo ve.

src: In contrast, animal foods (ants, termites, eggs) not only are easily digestible, but they provide high-quantity proteins that contain all the essential amino acids.
trg: Na kuswanswa, madia ya bambisi (bafurmi, binyonyia ya mbwaki ya mwa nene, maki) ke vandaka mpasi ve na kudia, kansi yo ke vandaka ti baproteine mingi kibeni yina ke vandaka ti amino-acide yonso ya mfunu.

src: All things considered, we should not be surprised if our own ancestors solved their "protein problem" in somewhat the same way that chimps on the savanna do today.
trg: Kana beto tadila mambu yonso, beto fwete yituka ve kana ba-nkaka na beto vandaka kumanisa "makambu na bo ya protéines" mutindu maboko ya nseke ke salaka yo bubu.

src: Sleep interruption is the process of purposefully awakening during your normal sleep period and falling asleep a short time later (10–60 minutes).
trg: Kuzenga mpongi kele mpila mosi ya nge mosi ke telmaka na luzolo na ntangu ya mpongi na nge ti kulala na nima ya mwa ntangu fioti (miniti 10 tii na 60).

src: This can be easily done by using a relatively quiet alarm clock to bring you to consciousness without fully waking you.
trg: Yo lenda salama na pete yonso na kusadila montre ya kele na allarme sambu na kutedimisa nge kukonda nde nge telama ya mvimba.

src: If you find yourself resetting the clock in your sleep, it can be placed on the other side of the room, forcing you to get out of bed to turn it off.
trg: Kana nge me mona nge mosi nge ke yidika montre na ntangu ya kulala, yo lenda tulama na kisika ya nkaka na chambre, sambu yo pusa nge na kutelama na mbeto sambu na kukanga yo.

src: Other biorhythm-based options involve drinking lots of fluid (particularly water or tea, a known diuretic) prior to sleep, forcing one to get up to urinate.
trg: Banzila ya nkaka kutala mutindu muntu ke vandilaka na kisika yandi kele, ke lombaka kunwa masa mingi (mingi-mingi masa to thé) na ntwala ya kulala, sambu yo pusa nge na kutelama na mpongi sambu na kusuba.

src: The amount of inner peace a person possesses correlates oppositely to the amount of tension in one’s body and spirit.
trg: Mingi ya ngemba ya kati yina muntu kele na yo ke wakana ti ve ata fioti ti kunwana yina kele na nitu mpi mpeve na yandi.

src: The lower the tension, the more positive the life force present. Every person has the potential to find absolute peace and contentment.
trg: Kana kunwana kele fioti, ngolo ya luzingu ta vanda ya mbote. Konso muntu lenda baka ngemba mpi kiese.

src: Everyone can achieve enlightenment. The only thing standing in the way of this goal is our own tension and negativity.
trg: Konso muntu lenda temuka. Kima ya lenda kanga beto nzila kele kaka boma mpi bangindu na beto mosi ya mbi.

src: The Tibetan Buddhism is based on the teachings of Buddha, but were extended by the mahayana path of love and by a lot of techniques from Indian Yoga.
trg: Buddhisme ya bana Tibet me simbama na malongi ya Buddha, kansi yo kuyalumukaka tii na nzila ya zola ya mahayana, mpi na mayele mingi ya Yoga ya Inde.

src: In principle the Tibetan Buddhism is very simple. It consists of Kundalini Yoga, meditation and the path of all-embracing love.
trg: Na kutuba ya mbotea, Buddhism ya bantu ya Tibetain kele pete kibeni. Yo ke lombaka kusala Yoga ya Kundalini, kuyindulula mpi nzila ya zola sambu nabantu yonso.

src: With Kundalini Yoga the Kundalini energy (enlightenment energy) is awakened through yoga postures, breathing exercises, mantras and visualizations.
trg: Na Yoga ya Kundalini ngolo ya Kundalini (ngolo ya kutemuna) me telama na nzila ya ba position ya yoga, bangalasisi ya kupema, mantra, mpi kusonga bifwanisu.

src: The center of Tibetan meditation is the Deity Yoga. Through the visualization of various deities the energy channels are cleaned, the chakras are activated and the enlightenment consciousness is created.
trg: Kima ya bantu ya Tibetain ke yindululaka kele Nzambi Yoga. Na nzila ya kumona banzambi ya mutindu na mutindu banzila ya ngolo ke kangukaka, ba chakras ke yantikaka kusala mpi kutemuka ke salamaka.

src: Germany was a common enemy in World War 2, leading to cooperation between the USSR and USA. With the end of the war the clashes of system, process and culture led to the countries falling out.
trg: Allemagne vandaka mbeni ya bantu yonso na Bitumba ya 2 ya Ntoto ya Mvimba, yo salaka nde URSS na Etats-Unis kuwakana. Ntangu bituma manaka, bansi panzanaka sambu na kunwana ya mutindu ya ksala mambu mpi binkulu.

src: With two years of the end of the war, the former allies were now enemies and the Cold War began.
trg: Na mvula zole ya nsuka ya bitumba, bayina vandaka ntete banduku kumaka bambeni, ebuna yo basisaka Bitumba ya Madidi.

src: It was to last for the next 40 years and would be fought for real, by proxy armies, on battlefields from Africa to Asia, in Afghanistan, Cuba and many other places.
trg: Bo nwanaka yo na bamvula 40 yina landaka mpi bo vandaka kunwana na masonga na nzila ya basoda ya bantu ya nkaka, na bisika ya bitumba katuka na Afrika tii na Asie, na Afghanistan, na Cuba mpi na bisika mingi ya nkaka.

src: By September 17, 1939, the Polish defense was already broken, and the only hope was to retreat and reorganise along the Romanian bridgehead.
trg: Na le 17 septembre 1939, basoda ya Pologne kubwaka deja mpi kivuvu na bo vandaka kaka ya kuvutuka na nima mpi kuyilama diaka na bantu ya Roumanie.

src: However, these plans were rendered obsolete nearly overnight, when over 800,000 soldiers from the Soviet's Union Red Army entered and created the Belarussian and Ukrainian fronts after invading the eastern regions of Poland in violation of the Riga Peace Treaty, the Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, and other international treaties, both bilateral and multilateral.
trg: Kansi, bangindu yian bwaka kaka na mpimpa mosi, ntangu basoda ya Armé ya mbwaki kuluta 800 000 ya Union Sauvetique kotaka mpi salaka kimvuka ya Biélorusse mpi ya Ukrainien nka nima ya kukota na bisika ya este ya Pologne kukonda kuzitisa Kuwakana ya Ngemba ya Riga, Kukonda ya kukonda kusalana mbi na kati ya Union Sovietique mpi Pologne, mpi bakuwakana ya nkaka ya bansi mingi, ya bansi zole to ya bansi mingi.

src: Using ships to transport goods is by far the most efficient way to move large amounts of people and goods across oceans.
trg: Kusadila maswa sambu na kunata bima kele mutindu ya mbote kibeni ya kunata bantu mpi bima mingi kibeni na simu ya nzadi-mngwa.

src: The job of navies has traditionally been to ensure that your country maintains the ability to move your people and goods, while at the same time, interfering with your enemy's ability to move his people and goods.
trg: Kisalu ya ya maswa vandaka ntete-ntete ya kusadisa bansi na kuvanda ti makuki ya kunata bantu ti bima na kisika ya nkaka, na ntangu yina mosi, kukanga nzila na bambeni na kunata bantu mpi bima kisika ya nkaka.

src: One of the most noteworthy recent examples of this was the North Atlantic campaign of WWII. The Americans were trying to move men and materials across the Atlantic Ocean to help Britain.
trg: Mbandu mosi ya mfunu mingi ya bilumbu na beto kele kampanye ya Bitumba ya Atlatntique ya Norde ya Mvita ya Zole ya Ntoto ya Mvimba. Basoda ya Amerika vandaka kusosa kunata bantu mpi bima na bo na simu ya Nzadi-Mungwa ya Atlantique sambu na ksuadisa Grande-Bretagne.

src: At the same time, the German navy, using mainly U-boats, was trying to stop this traffic.
trg: Na ntangu kaka mosi yina, basoda ya Allemagne ya ke nwanaka na masa, yina vandaka kusadial bamaswa U-boats, vandaka kusosa kukanga bo nzila.

src: Had the Allies failed, Germany probably would have been able to conquer Britain as it had the rest of Europe.
trg: Kana bo nungaka ve, ziku Allemagne zolaka kununga Grande Bretagne mutindu yo nungaka ndambu ya Europa yina bikalaka.

src: Goats seem to have been first domesticated roughly 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.
trg: Yo ke monana nde bantu bandaka ntete kusansa bankombo kiteso ya bamvula 10 000 me luta na bangumba ya Zagros na Iran.

src: Ancient cultures and tribes began to keep them for easy access to milk, hair, meat, and skins.
trg: Binkulu mpi makanda ya ntama yantikaka kubaka bo sambu na kuzwa miliki, mikana bo, misuni, mpi mpusu na bo.

src: Domestic goats were generally kept in herds that wandered on hills or other grazing areas, often tended by goatherds who were frequently children or adolescents, similar to the more widely known shepherd. These methods of herding are still used today.
trg: Bankombo ya bwala bo vandaka kutanina bo mbala mingi na kimvuka yina vandaka kutambula na bangumba to na bisika ya nkaka ya kele ti matiti, mpi bana to baleke bantu vandaka kukeba bo, kaka mutindu ngungudi ke salaka. Bantu ke landaka kukeba bo mutindu yina bubu yai.

src: Wagonways were built in England as early as the 16th Century.
trg: Bo salaka nzila ya train na Angleterre na lyantiku ya mvu-nkama ya 16.

src: Although wagonways merely consisted of parallel planks of wood, they allowed horses pulling them to achieve greater speeds and pull larger loads than on the slightly more rough roads of the day.
trg: Ata nzila ya train vandaka kaka na mabaya ya kutandama ndambu zole, yo vandaka kusadisa bampunda na ke banda yo na kubaka ntinu ya ngolo mpi kubenda bizitu ya mingi kuluta yina bo ke nataka na banzila ya mabulu.

src: Crossties were introduced fairly early to hold the tracks in place. Gradually, however, it was realised that tracks would be more efficient if they had a stip of iron on the top.
trg: Bo salaka ba crossties na luyantiku mpenza sambu banzila kuanda mbote. Kansi, malembe-malembe, bo bakisaka nde sambu banzila kuvanda mbote mingi, yo ke lomba kutuba mabende na zulu.

src: This became common practice, but the iron caused more wear on the wooden wheels of the wagons.
trg: Bo kumaka kusala yo mingi, kansi bibende vandaka kubebisa mingi bapneu ya bawagon sambu yo vandaka ya mabaya.

src: Eventually, wooden wheels were replaced by iron wheels. In 1767, the first full-iron rails were introduced.
trg: Nsuka-nsuka, bo yingisaka bapneu ya mapaya na bapneu ya mabende. Na 1767, bo salaka nzila ya ntete ya mabende.

src: The first known transportation was walking, humans began walking upright two million years ago with the emergence of Homo Erectus (meaning upright man).
trg: Transport ya ntete ya me zabanaka kele kutambula ya kutelamamakulu bamilio ya bamvula zole me luta ntangu ba Homo Erectus (muntu ya kutelema) basikaka.

src: Their predecessors, the Australopithecus did not walk upright as habitually.
trg: Ba-nkaka na bo, ba Australopithecus vandaka ve kutambula ya kutelama munti bantu ya bubu ke tambulaka.

src: Bipedal specializations are found in Australopithecus fossils from 4.2-3.9 million years ago, although Sahelanthropus may have walked on two legs as early as seven million years ago.
trg: Kutambula na makulu zole ke mona na bafosile ya ba Australopithèque ya bo me salaka bamilio 4, 2 tii 3,9 ya bamvula me luta, Ata ba Sahelanthrope vandaka mpi kutambula na makulu zole bamilio nsambwadi ya bamvula me luta.

src: We can start living more friendly to the environment, we can join to the environmental movement, and we can even be activists in order to reduce the future suffering in some degree.
trg: Beto lenda yantika kuzinga mbote na kisika beto kele, beto lenda vukana na muvema ya environema, mpi beto lenda kuma bantu ya ke sadisa sambu na kukulumusa mwa fioti bampasi ya bilumbu ke kwisa.

src: This is just like symptomatic treatment in many cases. However, if we do not only want a temporary solution, then we should find the root of the problems, and we should deactivate them.
trg: Yo kele bonso kubelula maladi na bidumbu na yo. Kansi, kana beto ke zola ve kaka solution ya ntangu fioti, pana beto fwete sosa kuzaba kisina ya bampasi, mpi beto fwete katula yo.

src: It is obvious enough that the world has changed much because of humankind's scientific and technological advancements, and problems have become greater because of overpopulation and mankind's extravagant lifestyle.
trg: Yo ke pwelele nde nsi-ntoto me sobaka mingi sambu na kuyela ya mambu ya siansi mpi ya technologie, mpi bampasi me kumaka ngolo sambu bantu me lutana mingi mpi bantu kele ti luzingu ya mindondo.

src: After its adoption by Congress on July 4, a handwritten draft signed by the President of Congress John Hancock and the Secretary Charles Thomson was then sent a few blocks away to the printing shop of John Dunlap.
trg: Na nima ya kuvote yo na Congrès na le 4 juillet, president ya Congres John Hancock mpi Sekretrere Charles Thomson tulaka maboko na nsiku yina mpi na nima bo tindaka yo sambu bo kwenda kuniema yo na Joah Dunlap.

src: Through the night between 150 and 200 copies were made, now known as "Dunlap broadsides".
trg: Na mpimpa bo salaka bakokpi na yo na kati ya 150 mpi 200, bubu yayi yo me zabanaka na zina ya "Bandilu ya Dunlap".

src: The first public reading of the document was by John Nixon in the yard of Independence Hall on July 8.
trg: Kutanga ya ntetne na meso ya bantu salamaka na John Nixon na kibansala ya Nzo ya Kimpwanza na le 8 juillet.

src: One was sent to George Washington on July 6, who had it read to his troops in New York on July 9. A copy reached London on August 10.
trg: Bo tindaka mosi na George Washington na le 6 juillet; yandi tangilaka yo basoda na New York na le 9 juillet. Kopi mosi kumaka na Londres na 10 Aout.

src: The 25 Dunlap broadsides still known to exist are the oldest surviving copies of the document. The original handwritten copy has not survived.
trg: Bandilu 25 ya Dunlap yina kele ti bubu yai kele bakopi ya ntama kibeni ya me bikalaka ya mukanda yina. Mukanda ya ntete yina bo sonikaka na maboko ke vandaka diaka ve.

src: Many paleontologists today believe that one group of dinosaurs survived and is alive today. We call them birds.
trg: Bapaléontologue mingi ya bubu ke yindulaka nde kimvuka mosi ya badisonozore gulukaka mpi yo kele na luzingu tii bubu. Bo ke bingaka bandeke.

src: Many people don't think about them as dinosaurs because they have feathers and can fly.
trg: Bantu mingi ke bingaka bo ve badinozore sambu bo kele ti mansala mpi lenda pumbuka.

src: But there are a lot of things about birds that still look like a dinosaur.
trg: Kansi kele mambu mingi ay bandeke yina kele kiteso mosi ya badinozore.

src: They have feet with scales and claws, they lay eggs, and they walk on their two back legs like a T-Rex.
trg: Bo kele ti makulu ya kele ti bampusa mpi manzangulu, bo ke losaka maki, mpi bo ke tambulaka na maboko na bo ya nima bonso T-Rex.

src: Virtually all computers in use today are based on the manipulation of information which is coded in the form of binary numbers.
trg: Na kutuba ya mbote, ba ordinateur yonso ya bo ke sadilaka bubu me katukaka na kusadila bansangu yina bo me kumisaka bakode bonso bantalu ya ke vandaka zole-zole.

src: A binary number can have only one of two values, i.e. 0 or 1, and these numbers are referred to as binary digits - or bits, to use computer jargon.
trg: Ntalu ya binaire lenda vanda ti valere mosi to bavalere zole mu mbandu 0 to 1, mpi bantalu yai bo ke binga yo nombre binaires to bits, sambu na kusadila ndinga ya ordinateur.

src: Internal poisoning may not be immediately apparent. Symptoms, such as vomiting are sufficiently general that an immediate diagnosis cannot be made.
trg: Ndikila ya kati ya nitu ke monanaka nswalu nswalu ve. Bidimbu ya maladi, bonso kuluka ke monanaka na maladi mingi mpi ke pesaka nzila ve na kusonga nki maladi ke na nitu.

src: The best indication of internal poisoning may be the presence of an open container of medication or toxic household chemicals.
trg: Kima ya mbote ke songaka nde ndikila kele na nitu lenda vanda nkisi ya kukanguka to mulandi ya nkisi ya ndikilu ya kutula bunkete na nzo.

src: Check the label for specific first aid instructions for that specific poison.
trg: Sosa ntete mukanda ya nkisi yango sambu na kuzaba mutindu ya kusansa ndikili yina.

src: The term bug is used by entomologists in a formal sense for this group of insects.
trg: Bo ke sadilaka ngogo niama na bantu ya ke longukaka baniama sambu na kutubila kimvuka yai ya baniama.

src: This term derives from ancient familiarity with Bed-bugs, which are insects highly adapted to parasitize humans.
trg: Ngogo yai me katuka na kima mosi ya ke tadila binsekwa, yina kele baniama yina me yikanaka mingi na kuzinga na nitu ya muntu.

src: Both Assassin-bugs and Bed-bugs are nidicolous, adapted to living in nest or housing of their host.
trg: Binsekwa ya nitu mpi binsekwa ya mbeto ke salaka mbi, bo me yikana na kuzinga na buyamba to na nzo ya bantu ya bo me kotila.

src: Across the United States of America, there are approximately 400,000 known cases of Multiple Sclerosis (MS), leaving it as the leading neurological disease in younger and middle aged adults.
trg: Na nsi ya Etats-Unis ya Amerika ya mvimba, kele ti bantu kiteso ya 400 000 ya ke belaka maladi ya Scelorose ya Palaki (MS), yo ke salaka nde yo vanda maladi yina baleke mpi baleke ya me katuka kukuma bambuta ke belaka mingi.

src: MS is a disease that affects the central nervous system, which is made up of the brain, the spinal cord and the optic nerve.
trg: MS kele maladi yayi ke kotaka na katikati ya butomfu, yo me salama na butomfu, moelle épinière mpi misisa ya butomfu.

src: Research has found that females are two times more likely to have MS then males.
trg: Bansosa me mona nde bankento ke vandaka na kigonsa mbala zole ya kubela maladi ya MS kuluta babakala.

src: A couple may decide it is not in their best interest, or in the interest of their child, to raise a baby.
trg: Bankwelani lenda baka lukanu nde yo kele ve mfunu sambu na bo to sambu na mambote ya mwana na bo, na kubuta.

src: These couples may choose to make an adoption plan for their baby.
trg: Bankwelani lenda pona na kusumba mwana ya bebe.

src: In an adoption, the birth parents terminate their parental rights so that another couple may parent the child.
trg: Ntangu ya kusumba mwana, bibuti yina butaka mwana ke sukisaka banswa na bo sambu bankwelani ya nkaka kusansa mwana yina.

src: Science’s main goal is to figure out the way the world works through the scientific method. This method in fact guides most scientific research.
trg: Lukanu ya ntete ya siansi kele ya kuzaba mutindu nsi-ntoto ke tambula na nzila ya bametode ya siansi. Yai metode ya ke twadisaka bansosa mingi ya siansi.

src: It isn’t alone though, experimentation, and an experiment is a test that is used to eliminate one or more of the possible hypotheses, asking questions, and making observations also guide scientific research.
trg: Kansi, yo kele ve kaka na nzila ya kumeka, mpi kumeka bo ke sadilaka yo sambu na kukatula ngindu mosi to mingi, kuyula bangiufula, mpi kubakisa mambu ke twadisaka mpi bansosa ya siansi.

src: Naturalists and philosophers focused on classical texts and, in particular, on the Bible in Latin.
trg: Ba naturaliste mpe bafilozofe tulaka dikebi na masonama ya mfunu, mingi-mingi, Bilia na Latin.

src: Accepted were Aristotle's views on all matters of science, including psychology.
trg: Bantu ndimaka bangindu ya Aristote na mambu yonso ya siansi, ata mpi ya psychologie.

src: As knowledge of Greek declined, the West found itself cut off from its Greek philosophical and scientific roots.
trg: Ntangu nzayilu ya Grece bandaka kukulumka, bantu ya Mputu zengaka misisa na yo ya filozofi ti ya siansi ya Bagreki.

src: Many observed rhythms in physiology and behavior often crucially depend on the presence of endogenous cycles and their production through biological clocks.
trg: Bima mingi ya beto ke monaka na physiologie mpi na bikalulu, mbala mingi yo ke simbamaka na kuvanda ya bansungi ya endogenes mpi na kusalama na yo na bamontre ya biologie.

src: Periodic rhythms, which are not simply responses to external periodic cues, have been documented for most living beings, including bacteria, fungi, plants, and animals.
trg: Barythmes ya ntangu mosi, yina kele ve kaka mvutu na mambu ya ke monana na meso, bo me monaka yo na bigangwa mingi ya kele na luzingu, mu mbandu mikrobe, buboko, banti mpi bambisi.

src: Biological clocks are self sustaining oscillators which will continue a period of free-running cycling even in the absence of external cues.
trg: Bamontre ya biologie kele bapareyi yina ke balukaka yina ke landaka nsungi na yo ya kubaluka ata ntngu yo kele ve ata ti kima mosi na nganda ya ke songa yo na kusala mutindu yina.

src: The Hershey and Chase experiment was one of the leading suggestions that DNA was a genetic material.
trg: Nsosa ya Hershey na Chase vandaka mosi ya bansosa yina moniska nde AND vandaka kima ya bo ke butukaka ti yo.

src: Hershey and Chase used phages, or viruses, to implant their own DNA into a bacterium.
trg: Hershey na Chase sadilaka mikrobe to bavirisi, sambu na kukotisa AND na bo mosi na kati ya mikrobe.

src: They did two experiments marking either the DNA in the phage with a radioactive phosphorus or the protein of the phage with radioactive sulfur.
trg: Bo salaka bansosa zole, bo kotisaka AND na mikrobo ya phospore ya radioactif to bo kotisaka proteine na mikrobe na sulfure radioactif.

src: Mutations can have a variety of different effects depending on the type of mutation, the significance of the piece of genetic material affected and whether the cells affected are germ-line cells.
trg: Bansoba lenda vanda ti bupusi ya kuswaswana na kutadila mutindu ya nsoba, mfunu ya kima ya menga yina yo simbaka mpi kana baselile ya simbaka kele yina ke butaka.

src: Only mutations in germ-line cells can be passed on to children, while mutations elsewhere can cause cell-death or cancer.
trg: Kaka bansoba ya baselile ya ke butaka mpamba bo lenda pesa yo na bana, kansi bansoba ya nkaka lenda fwa selile to kupesa maladi ya cancer.

src: Nature-based tourism attracts people interested in visiting natural areas for the purpose of enjoying the scenery, including plant and animal wildlife.
trg: Tourisme ya kutala lugangu ke bendaka bantu mingi na kutala bisika ya ntama sambu na kusepela na kitoko na yo, yo vanda banti mpi bamfinda.

src: Examples of on-site activities include hunting, fishing, photography, bird watching, and visiting parks and studying information about the ecosystem.
trg: Bambandu ya bisalu ya kisika ya beto me vanda kele kuzomba, kuloba, kubaka bafoto, kutala bandeke mpi kukwenda kutala baparke mpi kulonguka bansangu ya me tala kisika yina.

src: An example is visiting, photographing, and learning about organgatuangs in Borneo.
trg: Mbandu mosi kele kukwenda kutala, kubaka bafoto, mpi kulonguka mambu me tala bamakaku ya maboko nda na Bornéo.

src: Every morning, people leave small country towns in cars to go their workplace and are passed by others whose work destination is the place they have just left.
trg: Na suka yonso, bantu ke katukaka na babwala na bakamio sambu na kukwenda na kisalu mpi bo ke kutanaka ti bantu yina kisika na bo ya kisalu bisika bantu yai me katuka.

src: In this dynamic transport shuttle everyone is somehow connected with, and supporting, a transport system based on private cars.
trg: Na diambu yai ya mfunu, konso muntu ke vandaka na kuwakana mpi ke sadisaka ngidika ya transport ya me simbaka na bakamio ya bantu bo mosi.

src: Science now indicates that this massive carbon economy has dislodged the biosphere from one of its stable states that has supported human evolution for the past two million years.
trg: Siansi ke monisa nde mutindu yai ya nene ya kubumba carbone me katulaka biophere na kisika na yo mosi ya mfunu yina me sadisaka bantu na kuyela na nsungi ya bamilio zole ya bamvula ya me luta.

src: Everyone participates in society and uses transportation systems. Almost everyone complains about transportation systems.
trg: Muntu yonso ke vukanaka na luzingu ya bwala mpi ke sadilaka transport. Bantu yonso ke bokutakaka sambu na transport.

src: In developed countries you seldom hear similar levels of complaints about water quality or bridges falling down.
trg: Na bansi ya kutoma beto ke waka mpenza ve kubokuta ya mutindu ya ke tadila bamasa to kubwa ya bapont.

src: Why do transportation systems engender such complaints, why do they fail on a daily basis? Are transportation engineers just incompetent? Or is something more fundamental going on?
trg: Sambu na nki bantu ke bokuta mingi sambu na transport, mpi sambu na nki yo ke nungaka ve konso kilumbu? Banganga mayele ya transport be ke zaba kisalu ve? To kele na kima ya mfunu ke luta kuna?

src: Traffic Flow is the study of the movement of individual drivers and vehicles between two points and the interactions they make with one another.
trg: Kutadila mambu banzila kele kulonguka mutindu bashofere mpi bakamio ke sala mambu na kati ya bisika zole mpi na bampambu ya nzila na kati na bo.

src: Unfortunately, studying traffic flow is difficult because driver behavior cannot be predicted with one-hundred percent certainty.
trg: Kansi yo kele mawa sambu kulonguka mambu ya banzila kele mpasi sambu beto lenda zaba ve na ntwala mutindu shofere ta sala mambu na mutindu ya kukuka.

src: Fortunately, drivers tend to behave within a reasonably consistent range; thus, traffic streams tend to have some reasonable consistency and can be roughly represented mathematically.
trg: Diambu ya kiese kele nde, bashofere ke vandaka ti bikalulu ya kusala mambu ya mwa mutindu mosi; yo yina, kulonguka mambu ya banzila ke vandaka mwa mbote mpi beto lenda zaba yo na nsadisa ya mathematique.

src: To better represent traffic flow, relationships have been established between the three main characteristics: (1) flow, (2) density, and (3) velocity.
trg: Sambu na kubakisa mbote mambu ya banzila, kuwakana me monanaka na kati ya bima tatu ya mfunu: (1) kutambula, (2) ntalu ya bakamio mpi (3) ntinu.

src: These relationships help in planning, design, and operations of roadway facilities.
trg: Kuwakana ke sadisaka na kubongisa, na kusala baplan, mpi na kutadila mambu ya kuyidika banzila.

src: Insects were the first animals to take to the air. Their ability to fly helped them evade enemies more easily and find food and mates more efficiently.
trg: Baniama vandaka bambisi ya ntete ya kupumbuka na zulu. Makuki na bo ya kupumbuka ke sadisaka bo na kutina bambeni na pete mpi na kuzwa madia mpi nkwelani ya me fwana.

src: Most insects have the advantage of being able to fold their wings back along the body.
trg: Baniama mingi kele na chance sambu bo lenda benda mapapu na bo na kati ya nitu na bo.

src: This gives them a wider range of small places to hide from predators.
trg: Yo me pesaka bo dibaku ya kubumbana na bisika mingi ya fioi sambu na kutina bambeni na bo.

src: Today, the only insects that cannot fold back their wings are dragon flies and mayflies.
trg: Bubu yai, baniama yina lenda benda ve mapapu na yo na nitu kele kaka kipekupeku ya masa mpi ya ndombe.

src: Thousands of years ago, a man called Aristarchus said that the Solar System moved around the Sun.
trg: Mafunda ya bamvula me luta, bakala mosi na zina ya Aristarchus tubaka nde Ngidika ya Ntangu ke tambulaka na nziunga ya ntangu.

src: Some people thought he was right but many people believed the opposite; that the Solar System moved around the Earth, including the Sun (and even the other stars).
trg: Bantu ya nkaka vandaka kuyindula nde yandi tubaka masonga kansi bantu mingi ke yindula ve mutindu yina; bo ke yindula nde Ngidika ya Ntangu ke tambulaka na nziunga ya Ntoto, ata Ntangu yo mosi (mpi ata bambwetete ya nkaka).

src: This seems sensible, because the Earth doesn't feel as if it's moving, does it?
trg: Yo ke monana diambu ya mayele, sambu yo ke monanaka ve bonso nde Ntoto ke tambula, mpidina ve?

src: The Amazon River is the second longest and the biggest river on Earth. It carries more than 8 times as much water as the second biggest river.
trg: Nzadi Amazon kele nzadi ya zole ya kuluta nda mpi ya ntet ya nene na Ntoto. Yo kele ti bamasa bambala 8 kuluta nzadi ya zole ya kuluta nene.

src: The Amazon is also the widest river on Earth, at times six miles wide.
trg: Amazon kele mpi nzadi ya kuluta nene na Ntoto, banangu ya nkaka yo ke vandaka nene ya bamiles sambanu.

src: A full 20 percent of the water that pours out of the planet's rivers into the oceans comes from the Amazon.
trg: Ntalu ya 20% ya masa ya ke basikaka na banzadi ya planete mpi ya ke kwendaka na banzadi-mungwa ke katukaka na Amazon.

src: The main Amazon River is 6,387 km (3,980 miles). It collects water from thousands of smaller rivers.
trg: Nzadi ya nene ya Amazon kele nda 6 387 km (3 980 miles). Yo ke bakaka masa ya ke katukaka na banzadi mingi ya fioti.

src: Although pyramid-building in stone continued until the end of the Old Kingdom, the pyramids of Giza were never surpassed in their size and the technical excellence of their construction.
trg: Ata kutunga Pyramide na matadi ke landaka kusalama tii na nsuka ya Kimfumu ya Ntama, bapyramide ya Giza, bo lutaka yo ve na nene mpi na mayele ya kutunga na ntangu bo tungaka yo.

src: New Kingdom ancient Egyptians marvelled at their predecessors monuments, which were then well over a thousand year old.
trg: Kimfumu ya mpa ya Egypte ya ntama yitukaka bamonima ya bantu ya ntama, yina vandaka ti mafunda ya bamvula.

src: Vatican City's population is around 800. It is the smallest independent country in the world and the country with the lowest population.
trg: Bantu ya mbanza Vatican kele kiteso ya 800. Yo kele insi ya kulutila fyoti ya me bakaka kimpwanza na ntoto ya mvimba mpi yo kele insi ya kele ti bantu ya kulutila fyoti.

src: Vatican City uses Italian in its legislation and official communications.
trg: Mbanza ya Vatican ke sadilaka ndinga ya Italie na mambu ya bansiku mpi na masolo ya leta.

src: Italian is also the everyday language used by most of those who work in the state while Latin is often used in religious ceremonies.
trg: Italien kele mpi ndinga ya konso kilumbu ya bo ke sadilaka mingi na bantu yina ke salaka kisalu ya leta kansi bo ke sadilaka Latin mbala mingi na mambu ya lusambu.

src: All citizens of Vatican City are Roman Catholic.
trg: Bantu yonso ya Mbanza Vatican kele bant uya Roma ya Katolika.

src: People have known about basic chemical elements such as gold, silver, and copper from antiquity, as these can all be discovered in nature in native form and are relatively simple to mine with primitive tools.
trg: Bantu me zabaka mambu ya me tala bima ya chimie mu mbandu wolo, arza, kwivre banda ntama, sambu bo lenda mona mutindu yo ke vandaka mpenza mpi yo ke vandaka mpasi ve na kutimuna yo ti bisadilu ya ntama.

src: Aristotle, a philosopher, theorised that everything is made up of a mixture of one or more of four elements. They were earth, water, air, and fire.
trg: Aristote, muntu ya filozofi, tubaka nde bima yonso me salama na kimvuka ya kima mosi to bima mingi na kati ya bima iya. Bima yango kele ntoto, masa, mupepe na tiya.

src: This was more like the four states of matter (in the same order): solid, liquid, gas, and plasma, though he also theorised that they change into new substances to form what we see.
trg: Yo vandaka mutindu mosi ti mitindu iya ya bima ke vandaka (na ndonga mosi: ngolo, masa, mupepe ti plasma, ata yandi tubaka mpi nde yo ke sobaka mpi ke kumaka bima ya mpa sambu na kusala bima ya beto ke mona.

src: Alloys are basically a mixture of two or more metals. Don't forget that there are many elements on the periodic table.
trg: Ba alliage kele kimvuka ya bibende zole to mingi. Kuvila ve nde kele ti bima mingi na kati ya Tableau périodique.

src: Elements like calcium and potassium are considered metals. Of course, there are also metals like silver and gold.
trg: Bantu ke tubaka nde calcium na Potassium kele ba alliage. Ya kieleka, kile mpi ti bibende bonso arza mpi wolo.

src: You can also have alloys that include small amounts of non-metallic elements like carbon.
trg: Kele ti ba alliage yina kele ti bima mingi ya kele ve bibende mu mbandu carbone.

src: Everything in the Universe is made of matter. All matter is made of tiny particles called atoms.
trg: Bima yono ya kele na Luyalangangu me salamaka na matiere. Matiere yonso me salamaka na bima ya fioti ya bo ke bingaka ba atome.

src: Atoms are so incredibly tiny that trillions of them could fit into the period at the end of this sentence.
trg: Ba atomes kele fioti kibeni na mpila na bamiliare na yo lenda kuka na kuvanda na ditonsi yina kele na nsuka ha nsa yai.

src: Thus, the pencil was a good friend to many people when it came out.
trg: Yo yina, crayon vandaka nduku mbote ya bantu mingi ntangu yo basikaka.

src: Sadly, as newer methods of writing have emerged, the pencil has been relegated to lesser status and uses.
trg: Yo kele mawa sambu, ntangu mitindu ya mpa ya kusonika basikaka, bo kumaka kutula yo na kisika ya nitu mpi kusadila yo diaka ve mingi.

src: People now write messages on computer screens, never having to come close to a sharpener.
trg: Bubu yayi bantu ke sonikaka bansangu na ba ecran ya ordinateur, bo ke pusanaka ve pene-pene ya kima ya kuyidika crayon.

src: One can only wonder what the keyboard will become when something newer comes along.
trg: Muntu lenda kudiyula kana nki ta kumina clavier ntangu kima ya mpa ta basika.

src: The fission bomb works on the principle that it takes energy to put together a nucleus with many protons and neutrons.
trg: Bombi ya fusion ke salamaka na munsiku ya ke tuba nde yo ke lombaka energie sambu na kutula kisika mosi munkanzi ti baproton mpi baneutron mingi.

src: Sort of like rolling a heavy cart up a hill. Splitting the nucleus up again then releases some of that energy.
trg: Mwa fioto bonso kupusa pusupusu na mwa ngumba. Kukabula diaka minkanzi mpi na nima kuyambla ndambu ya energie.

src: Some atoms have unstable nuclei which means that they tend to break apart with little or no nudging.
trg: Batome ya nkaka kele ti minkanzi ya ngolo ve, yo ke tendula nde yo ke kabwanaka kukonda mpasi kukonda bo sala yo ata kima.

src: The surface of the Moon is made of rocks and dust. The outer layer of the Moon is called the crust.
trg: Kisika Ngonda ke vandaka me salama na matadi mpi mfututu. Nganda ya Ngonda bo ke bingaka yo croûte.

src: The crust is about 70 km thick on the near side and 100 km thick on the far side.
trg: Croûte kele na nene kiteso ya 70 km na lweka ya pene-pene mpi nene nene ya 100 km na lweka na yo ya ntama.

src: It is thinner under the maria and thicker under the highlands.
trg: Yo kele fioti na nsi ya maria mpi nene na nsi ya bangumba.

src: There may be more maria on the near side because the crust is thinner. It was easier for lava to rise up to the surface.
trg: Yo lenda vanda na ba maria na lweka ya pene-pene sambu croûte ke vandaka fioti. Yo vandaka pete mingi sambu masa ya tiya kutombuka tii kisika yo kele.

src: Content theories are centered on finding what makes people tick or appeals to them.
trg: Mayele ya kati yo kele na katikati ya kusosa ya yayi ke pesaka bantu ngindu to ke sepedisaka bo.

src: These theories suggest that people have certain needs and/or desires which have been internalized as they mature to adulthood.
trg: Malongi yai ke tubaka nde bantu kele ti bampusa mpi/to banzala yina ke vandaka na kati na bo ntangu bo ke yela na kukuma bambuta.

src: These theories look at what it is about certain people that make them want the things that they do and what things in their environment will make them do or not do certain things.
trg: Malongi yayi ke tadilaka mambu yina ke pusaka bantu ya nkaka na kuzola kusala mambu ya bo ke salaka mpi mambu ya kele na kisika ya bo kele ta pusa bo na kusala to kusala ve mambu ya nkaka.

src: Two popular content theories are Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs Theory and Hertzberg's Two Factor Theory.
trg: Malongi zole ya me zabana mingi kele Ngindu Banzala ya Kimfumu ya Maslow mpi Malongi Zole ya Hertzberg.

src: Generally speaking, two behaviors can emerge as managers begin to lead their former peers. One end of the spectrum is trying to remain “one of the guys” (or gals).
trg: Mbala mingi, bikalulu zole lenda basika ntangu bamfumu ya mpa ke yantika kutwadisa banduku na yandi ya ntama. Mosi kele kusosa kubikala "muntu ya bantu yonso."

src: This type of manager has difficulty making unpopular decisions, performing disciplinary action, performance evaluations, assigning responsibility, and holding people accountable.
trg: Mutindu yai ya kutwadisa ke vandaka mpasi na kubaka balukanu yina bantu ke sepela ve ti yo, na kupesa bandola, na kulandila mambu, na kupesa mikumba, mpi na kusosa kuzaba nani me sala foti.

src: At the other end of the spectrum, one morphs into an unrecognizable individual that feels he or she must change everything the team has been doing and make it their own.
trg: Na ndambu ya nkaka, muntu ya ke balukaka na nima mpi ke kumaka muntu ya bo lenda zaba ve yina ke yindulaka nde yandi fwete soba mambu yonso yina bantu vandaka kusala mpi kukumisa yo ya bo mosi.

src: After all, the leader is ultimately responsible for the success and failure of the team.
trg: Na nima ya yonso, ntwadisi muntu kele ti mukubma ya ntete sambu na kununga mpi kubela ya ekipe.

src: This behavior oftentimes results in rifts between the leaders and the rest of the team.
trg: Mbala mingi, kikalulu yai ke basisaka bitumba na kati ya bamfumu mpi bantu ya nakak ya ekipe.

src: Virtual teams are held to the same standards of excellence as conventional teams, but there are subtle differences.
trg: Baekipi ke salaka na nzila ya internet ke sadilaka bansiku ya mutindu mosi ya me tala kusolula mbote, bonso baekipe yonso, kansi mwa luswaswanu kele.

src: Virtual team members often function as the point of contact for their immediate physical group.
trg: Ekipe ya bantu ay ke salaka na nzila ya Internet, mbala mingi ke salaka bantu ya ke wakanisaka bantu ya nkaka ya bimvuka na bo.

src: They often have more autonomy than conventional team members as their teams may meet according to varying time zones which may not be understood by their local management.
trg: Bo ke vandaka na kimpwanza mingi kuluta bantu ya ke salaka kisika mosi sambu ba ekipe na bo lenda vukana na bantangu ya kuswaswana yina bantu ya ke yala bo lenda bakisa ve.

src: The presence of a true “invisible team” (Larson and LaFasto, 1989, p109) is also a unique component of a virtual team.
trg: Kuvanda na "ekipe ya ke monana ve" ya kieleka (Larson ti LaFasto, 1989, lutiti 109) kele diaka kima ya mfunu ya ekipe ya bantu ya ke salaka na nzila ya Internet.

src: The “invisible team” is the management team to which each of the members report. The invisible team sets the standards for each member.
trg: "Ekipe yai ya ke monanaka ve" kele ekipe ya bamfumu yina konso muntu ke salaka barapore. Ekipe ya ke monanaka ve ke tulaka bansiku sambu na konso muntu.

src: Why would an organization want to go through the time consuming process of establishing a learning organization? One goal for putting organizational learning concepts into practice is innovation.
trg: Sambu na nki kimvuka fwete zola kusadila metode ya ke bakaka ntangu mingi ya kulonguka? Lukanu mosi ya kusala kimvuka ya kulonguka kele kubasisa mitindu ya mpa.

src: When all available resources are effectively used across the functional departments of an organization, creativity and ingenuity can transpire.
trg: Ntangu beno ke sadila mbote bima yonso ya beno kele na yo na badepartema yonso ya kimvuka mosi, yo ke sadisaka na kusala bima ya mpa mpi ya mbote.

src: As a result, the process of an organization working together to overcome an obstacle can lead to a new innovative process to serve the customer's need.
trg: Ebuna, mayele ya kimvuka ya ke salaka kumosi sambu na kununga diambu mosi ya mpasi lenda sadisa na kubasisa mayele ya mpa sambu na kulungisa bampusa ya bakiliya.

src: Before an organization can be innovative, leadership must create a culture of innovation as well as shared knowledge and organizational learning.
trg: Na ntwala nde kimvuka kubasisa bangindu ya mpa, bamfmu fwete sadila mayele ya kubasisa bangindu ya mpa mpi kukabula nzayilu mpi kulonguka na kati ya bantu ya kimvuka.

src: Angel (2006), explains the Continuum approach as a method being used to help organizations reach a higher level of performance.
trg: Angel (2006), ke tuba nde mayele ya Cantinuum kele mayele ya bo ke sadilaka sambu na kusadisa kimvuka na kulungisa nivo ya zulu kibeni ya kisalu.

src: Neurobiological data provide physical evidence for a theoretical approach to the investigation of cognition. Therefore it narrows the research area and makes it much more exact.
trg: Bansangu ya misisa ya butomfu ke pesaka banzikisa ya ke monana sambu na kusala nsosa ya kuzaba mayele ya bantu. Yo yina, yo ke kumisaka mambu ya kulonguka fioti mpi yo ke salaka nde yo vanda ya masonga.

src: The correlation between brain pathology and behaviour supports scientists in their research.
trg: Kuwakanana kati ya kimbefo ya ntu ti bikalulu ke sadisaka banganga mayele ya siansi na bansosa na bo.

src: It has been known for a long time that different types of brain damage, traumas, lesions, and tumours affect behaviour and cause changes in some mental functions.
trg: Yo me zabanaka banda ntama nde bamputa ya kuswaswana ya butomfu, mutungisi, ya mputa ti tumeur ke kotaka na bifu mpi yo ke nataka luswaswanu na bifu ya muntu.

src: The rise of new technologies allows us to see and investigate brain structures and processes never seen before.
trg: Kubasika ya ba technologie ya mpa ke sadisaka beto na kumona mpi na kuzaba mutindu butomfu ke vandaka mpi ke salaka na mutindu yina beto me monaka ntete ve.

src: This provides us with a lot of information and material to build simulation models which help us to understand processes in our mind.
trg: Yo ke pesa beto bansangu mpi mambu mingi sambu na kutuna bifwani yina ke sadisa beto na kubakisa mutindu ntu na beto ke salaka.

src: Although AI has a strong connotation of science fiction, AI forms a very important branch of computer science, dealing with behavior, learning and intelligent adaptation in a machine.
trg: Ata AI ke na kuwakana ya ngolo na siansi ya kieleka ve, Ai kele kitini ya mfunu mingi ya siansi ya ba ordinateur, yo ke landilaka bikalulu, kulonguka, mpi mayele ya kuyikana na kati ya mashine mosi.

src: Research in AI involves making machines to automate tasks that require intelligent behavior.
trg: Bansosa ya Ai ke lombaka kusala bamashine sambu bisalu yina ke lombaka kusadila mayele kusalama yo mosi.

src: Examples include control, planning and scheduling, the ability to answer customer diagnoses and questions, as well as handwriting recognition, voice and face.
trg: Bambandu kele bonso kuyala, kusala plan mpi manaka, mayele ya kuyidika bampasi mpi kupesa bamvutu na bangiufula, mpi kuzaba bisono ya bo me sonikana na maboko, ndinga mpi luse.

src: Such things have become separate disciplines, which focus on providing solutions to real life problems.
trg: Mambu ya mutindu yayi me kuma malongi yo mosi, yo ke tulaka dikebi mingi na kuyidika mambu ya kieleka ya ke basikaka na luzingu.

src: The AI ​​system is now often used in the fields of economics, medicine, engineering and the military, as has been built in several home computer and video game software applications.
trg: Bo me kumaka kusadila mingi mayele ya IA bisalu ya mumbongo, ya kimunganga, ya ingénierie ti ya basoda, bo me kotisaka yo mpi na ba ordinateur mingi mpi na baprograme ya bansaka ya video.

src: Field trips are a large part of any classroom. Quite often a teacher would love to take her students places to which a bus trip is not an option.
trg: Kukwenda kutala bisika kele kitini ya mfunu ya konso klase. Mbala mingi, longi lenda zola kunata balongoki na yandi na bisika yina bisi ke kumaka ve.

src: Technology offers the solution with virtual field trips. Students can look at museum artifacts, visit an aquarium, or admire beautiful art while sitting with their class.
trg: Technologie ke sadisaka na kusala nzietelo yina na nzila ya Internet. Balongoki lenda mona bamizée, kukwenda na ba acquarium, to kusepela ti kifwanisu ya kitoko kaka na kisika bo kele na klase.

src: Sharing a field trip virtually is also a great way to reflect a on a trip and share experiences with future classes.
trg: Kusala nzietelo na nzila na Internet ti bakaka kele mpi mutindu ya mbote ya kuyindula nzietelo yango mpi kukabula bansangu yina ti balongoki ya nkaka na bilumbu ke kwisa.

src: For example, each year students from Bennet School in North Carolina design a website about their trip to the State Capital, each year the website gets remodeled, but old versions are kept online to serve as a scrapbook.
trg: Mu mbandu, konso longoki ya Nzo-Nkanda Bennet na Caroline ya Norde ke salaka site internet ya ke tubilaka nzietelo na bo na Nto-Mbanza, konso mvula bo ke yidikaka site internet yina, kansi bo ke bumbaka midele na yo ya ntama sambu yo vanda album.

src: Blogs can also help improve student writing. While students often begin their blog experience with sloppy grammar and spelling, the presence of an audience generally changes that.
trg: Bablogs lenda sadia mpi na kutomisa mayele ya balongoki ya kusonika. Ata balongoki mingi ke yantikaka kisalu ya kusala bablog ti bifu mingi na kusonika mpi na bangogo, mutindu bantu ke vandaka na internet ke sobaka mpi diambu yai.

src: Since students are often the most critical audience, the blog writer begins to strive to improve writing to avoid criticism.
trg: Sambu mbala mingi balongoki kele bantu yina ke landilaka bifu mingi, muntu ya ke sonikaka blog ke salaka ngolo na kutomisa mayele na yandi sambu bo tubila yandi ve mambu ya mbi.

src: Also blogging "forces students to become more savvy about the world around them." The need to feed the interest of the audience inspires students to be clever and interesting (Toto, 2004).
trg: Kusadila bablog "ke pesaka ngolo na bilongoki na zaba mbote mbote yinza yina me kuzungidila bo". Luzolo ya ku zonza na ntwala ndonga ya bantu mingi ke salaka ti bilongoki vanda na ndwenga na nkinzi ya ku sala yo.

src: Blogging is a tool that inspires collaboration, and encourages students to extend learning well beyond the traditional school day.
trg: Kusonika blog ke kisalu ya ke pusaka na kusala ti bankaka, yo ke siamisaka balongoki na kuyeidsa mayele na bo ya kulonguka na kisika bo suka kaka na nzo-nkanda.

src: Appropriate use of blogs "can empower students to become more analytical and critical; through actively responding to Internet materials, students can define their positions in the context of others' writings as well as outline their own perspectives on particular issues (Oravec, 2002).
trg: Kusadila mbote bablog "lenda sadisa balongoki sambu bo zaba kutadila mambu mpi kuyindula; na nzila ya kupesa bamvutu na bima ya kele na Internet, balongoki lenda zaba kisika bo kele kana bo fwanisa bo ti mayele ya kusonika ya bantu ya nkaka mpi kumonisa pwelele bangindu na bo na diambu mosi ya sikisiki" (Oravec, 2002).

src: Ottawa is Canada's charming, bilingual capital and features an array of art galleries and museums that showcase Canada's past and present.
trg: Ottawa kele mbanza kitoko ya Canada, kisika bantu ke tubaka bandinga zole ya kele na bisadilu ya bansaka na inzo ke bumbaka bisadilu ya ntama mpi ya mpa ya Canada.

src: Farther south is Niagara Falls and the north is home to the untapped natural beauty of the Muskoka and beyond.
trg: Ntama na sude kele Niagara Falls mpi na nordi kele zinamba kitoko ya insi ina batu me sadila ntete ve ya Muskoka mpi kuluta ntama.

src: All these things and more highlight Ontario as what is considered quintessentially Canadian by outsiders.
trg: Bima yai yonso mpi ya nkaka me kuzonzwa sambu na Ontario yo ke yina ke tadisa na bana ya Canada mutindu me kuwakana bantu ya nganda.

src: Large areas further north are quite sparsely populated and some is nearly uninhabited wilderness.
trg: Distrike ya nene diaka ya norde ke na bantu mingi ve na ya nkaka kele na ntoto ya kuyuma kisika bantu ke zingaka ve.

src: For a comparison of population that surprises many: There are more African Americans living in the US than there are Canadian citizens.
trg: Sambu na kumeka bantu yai ke yitukisa mingi: Bantu ya Afro-Amerika ya ke zinga na Amerika ke mingi kuluta bantu yonso ke zinga na insi ya Canada.

src: The East African Islands are in the Indian Ocean off the eastern coast of Africa.
trg: Ba insi yina kele kati na masa ya Afrika ya este me kubakama na masa ya nene ya Inde na nganda ya ndekoso masa ya Afrika ya este.

src: Madagascar is by far the biggest, and a continent on its own when it comes to wildlife.
trg: Madagascar kele ntama nene, mpi ntoto yo mosi na yina ya ke tala mfinda ti bambisi.

src: Most of the smaller islands are independent nations, or associated with France, and known as luxury beach resorts.
trg: Mingi kuluta ya bisanga ya fioti kele bansi na kimpwanza, to ya kuvukana na France, mpi ya kuzabana bonso mabungu ya kubumbama na bilengi.

src: The Arabs also brought Islam to the lands, and it took in a big way in the Comoros and Mayotte.
trg: Ba Arabe nataka Islamu na bwala, na ba kumaka bo mingi na Comores mpi Mayote.

src: European influence and colonialism began in the 15th century, as Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama found the Cape Route from Europe to India.
trg: Mupepe ya bantu ya Mputu mpi colonialisme yantikaka na mvula nkama ya 15, ntangu muntu ya ke salaka bansosa ya Mputulukezo Vasco da Gama monaka Nzila ya Cape katuka na Mputu kwenda tii na Inde.

src: In the north the region is bounded by the Sahel, and in the south and west by the Atlantic Ocean.
trg: Na norde distrike me tulama ndilu na Sahel, mpi na Sudi mpi na Westi na Masa ya Atlantika.

src: Women: It is recommended that any women travellers say that they are married, regardless of actual marital status.
trg: Bankento: Bankento yonso ya kuzieta kupesamaka nsiku ya kutuba nde bokele banketu ya makwela, kutala ve kana bo kele ya kukwelama to ya kukwelama ve.

src: It is helpful to also wear a ring (just not one that looks too expensive.
trg: Yo ke lusadisu na kulwata diyaka (kaka ve yina yo kele ntalu kuluta.

src: Women should realize that cultural differences may result in what they would consider harassment and it is not uncommon to be followed, grabbed by the arm, etc.
trg: Bankento fwete zaba bakulture ya kukesana lenda sala yayi bo kemonaka bonso kingolongolo ti yo kele mfunu ve kulanda, kubaka na kingolo na dikoko, b.n.b.

src: Be firm in turning down men, and don't be afraid to stand your ground (cultural differences or not, it doesn't make it ok!).
trg: Nge fwete buya ti na nsuka bantu mpi kuwa boma ve ya kutubila mpila na nge (kukesana ya baculture to ve, kele mbote ve!).

src: The modern city of Casablanca was founded by Berber fishermen in the 10th century BCE, and was used by the Phoenicians, Romans, and the Merenids as a strategic port called Anfa.
trg: Mbanza nene ya bubu ya Casablanca yo salamaka na balobi mbisi ya Berbere na mvula nkama mosi na ntwala ya ntangu na beto mpi yo vandaka sadilama na Bafenisie, Baromain ti Bamerenide bonso dibungu ya mayele ya kunwanisa na zina ya Anfa.

src: The Portuguese destroyed it and rebuilt it under the name Casa Branca, only to abandon it after an earthquake in 1755.
trg: Bantu kekuzingaka na Portugal bebisaka yo mpi kutungaka diaka yo na zina ya Casa Branca, bo ku bikaka yo na 1755 na nima ya kunikana ya ngolo ya ntoto.

src: The Moroccan sultan rebuilt the city as Daru l-Badya and it was given the name Casablanca by Spanish traders who established trading bases there.
trg: Sultan ya Maroc ya tungaka mbanza mosi na zina ya Daru l-Badya ti yo bakilamaka zina ya Casablanca na bateki ya Espagnole bayayi kutulaka bisika na bo ya kuteka.

src: Casablanca is one of the least interesting places to shop in all of Morocco.
trg: Casablanca kele mosi ya bisika yai kele ya kiese mingi ve sambu na kusala kusumba bima na Maroc ya mvimba.

src: Around the old Medina it's easy to find places selling traditional Moroccan goods, such as tagines, pottery, leather goods, hookahs, and a whole spectrum of geegaws, but it's all for the tourists.
trg: Pene-pene ya Médina ya ntama, yo kele mpasi ve ya kumona bisika yai boketeka bima ya insi ya Maroc ya ntama, bonso tajines, bima ya kusalama na maboko, bima ya mpusu ya bambisi, ba narguilé ti nswa ya geegaws, kansi yonso kele sambu na bantu ya ke sala nzietelo.

src: Goma is a tourist city of the Democratic Republic of Congo in the extreme east near Rwanda.
trg: Goma kele mbanza ya Republique Démocratique ya Congo ina ke bendaka banzenza mingi na kitini ya este ntama mingi ve na insi ya Rwanda.

src: In 2002 Goma was destroyed by lava from the Nyiragongo volcano which buried most of the town’s streets, particularly the town centre.
trg: Na mvula ya 2002 tiya katukaka na volcan ya Nyiragongo vwanzikisaka mbanza ya Goma, yo zikaka banzila ya mbanza, mingi mbanza ya kati kati.

src: While Goma is reasonably safe, any visits outside of Goma should be researched to understand the state of the fighting that persists in the North Kivu province.
trg: Ata Goma ke vandaka na lutaninu, konso munzenza ya ke zola kukwenda kutala goma fwete sala bansosa sambu na kuzaba kana bitumba yina ke salamaka na provense ya Nord-Kivu me mana.

src: The city is also the base to climb the Nyiragongo volcano along with some of the cheapest Mountain Gorilla tracking in Africa.
trg: Mbanza kele mpi kisika me fwete kana na kuyuluka ngumba ya Volcan ya Nyiragongo, kitnwadi na kisika kele ngumba ya fioti Montagne des Gorille to ngumba ya ba Makakou ya nene bantu ke sosaka na Afidica.

src: You can use boda-boda (motorcycle taxi) to get around Goma. The normal (local) price is ~500 Congolese Francs for the short ride.
trg: Nge lenda kusadila boda-boda (moto-taxi) sambu kutambula na Goma. Ntalu (ya bwala) kele 500 Francs Congolais na nzietelo mosi ya nkufi.

src: Combined with its relative inaccessibility, "Timbuktu" has come to be used as a metaphor for exotic, distant lands.
trg: Kuvukaka na diambu ya mpasi ya kukuma kuna, "Timbuktu" kumaka kusadulwa mutindu ngogo yina ke lakisa bantoto yina kele bisika ya mpwenia ke ya kutatuka mingi.

src: Today, Timbuktu is an impoverished town, although its reputation makes it a tourist attraction, and it has an airport.
trg: Bubu, Tombouctou kele mbanza nene ya bobola, kansi kuzabana na yo kele sambu na tourisme yo kele mpi na aéroport.

src: In 1990, it was added to the list of world heritage sites in danger, due to the threat of desert sands.
trg: Na 1990, yo yikamaka na mukanda ya bisika ya difwafwa ya insi-ntoto mvimba yina ya vandaka na kigonsa, na yai ke tala mutungisi ya zelo ya nseke.

src: It was one of the major stops during Henry Louis Gates' PBS special Wonders of the African World.
trg: Yo vandaka mosi ya bisika ya kutelema ya nene na ntangu ya PBS Wonders of the African Wolrd ya Henry Louis Gates.

src: The city is in stark contrast to the rest of the country's cities, because it has more of an Arabic flair than of an African.
trg: Bwala kele na ntugulu ya luswaswanu na bambanza ya nkaka, sambu bo yambaka nkayilu ya bana ya Arabie kulutila ba ya Afrika.

src: The Kruger National Park (KNP) lies in the north-east of South Africa and runs along the border of Mozambique in the east, Zimbabwe in the north, and the southern border is the Crocodile River.
trg: Parc national Kruger (KNP) yo kele na nord-est ya Afrika ya Sudi ti nsinga na ndelo ya Mozambique ya Este, ya Zimbabwe na norde ti ndelo ya sudi kele masa ya bangandu.

src: The park covers 19,500 km² and is divided in 14 different ecozones, each supporting different wildlife.
trg: Park kele nene ya 19, 500 km² mpi me kabuana na bitini 14 ya ecozone, mosi-mosi na mutindu ya Bambisi.

src: It is one of the main attractions of South Africa and it is considered the flagship of South African National Parks (SANParks).
trg: Yo kele mosi ya bifulu ina ke bendaka bantu mingi na Afrika ya Sudi mpi bantu ke talaka yo bonso kidimbu ya luyalu ya ba Parke ya Insi ya Afrika ya Sudi (SANParks).

src: As with all South African National Parks, there are daily conservation and entry fees for the park.
trg: Bonso baparke yonso ya Afrique du Sud, yo ke lombaka kukanga kisika konso kilumbu mpi nge fwete futa na ntwala ya kukota.

src: It may also be beneficial for one to buy a Wild Card, which provides entry to either selections of parks in South Africa or all of the South African National Parks.
