trg: Yo ta lenda kuvanda mbote sambu na muntu sumba Wild Card, kalati ya banfinda yayi kepesaka nzila na bisika ya baparke na Afrika ya Sudi to na baparke yonso ya luyalu ya sudi-afrika.

src: Hong Kong Island gives the territory of Hong Kong its name and is the place that many tourists regard as the main focus.
trg: Kisanga ya Hong Kong ke pesa insi-ntoto ya Hong Kong zina na yo mpi kele kisika wapi bazieti ke monaka bonso kisika ya kutala ntete.

src: The parade of buildings that make the Hong Kong skyline has been likened to a glittering bar chart that is made apparent by the presence of the waters of Victoria Harbour.
trg: Kima me kupesa bumpala na banzo ya yinda mpi ya nene ya mbanza Hong Kong ke ba nganda ke lezimaka na kitoko na masa ya Virctoria Harbour.

src: To get the best views of Hong Kong, leave the island and head for the Kowloon waterfront opposite.
trg: Sambu na kumona mbote nene ya Hong Kong, katuka na kati ya kisanga mpi kwenda na ndambu ya nkaka ya masa ya Kowloon.

src: The great majority of Hong Kong Island's urban development is densely packed on reclaimed land along the northern shore.
trg: Kitini ya kuluta nene ya kisanga ya Hong Kong ya ntombwana ya mbanza ti kele ya nene na bantoto ya bo bakaka na bukulu ya libungu ya nordi.

src: This is the place the British colonisers took as their own and so if you are looking for evidence of the territory's colonial past, this is a good place to start.
trg: Yai kele kisika ba colonisateurs Angleterre bakaka bonso ya bo mosi, mpidina kana nge ke sosa mafwafwa ya bilumbu me luta na diambu ya colonisation na kitini yai ke kisika ya kubantikila.

src: The Sundarbans are the largest littoral mangrove belt in the world, stretching 80 km (50 mi) into the Bangladeshi and Indian hinterland from the coast.
trg: Sundarbans kele ntoto yo ke lutila nene na mangrove na nsi-ntoto ya mvimba, ya ke na inda ya ba km 80 (ba mi 50) kati ya ntoto ya Bangladesh mpi Inde katuka ntengamanu ya mbela nkoko.

src: The Sundarbans has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The part of the forest within Indian territory is called Sundarbans National Park.
trg: Sundarbans me bingama kisika ya Difwafwa ya Insi-Ntoto Mvimb na UNESCO. kisika ya baiti ya nene na Distrike ya Inde me bingama Parke ya Luyalu na Sundarbans.

src: The forests aren't just mangrove swamps though — they include some of the last remaining stands of the mighty jungles which once covered the Gangetic plain.
trg: Bamfinda kele kaka ve kisika matiti na banti ke menaka-- yo ke bumbaka mpi banti na matiti kisika bambisi ya mfinda ke vandaka, kisika yina kele na ntoto ya kuyalumuka ya Gangetic.

src: The Sundarbans cover an area of 3,850 km², of which about one-third is covered in water/marsh areas.
trg: Sundarban ke ya kupanza na nziunga mosi ya bakm2 3, 850, kati na yai kitini mosi na tatu me fuluka na masa/bisika ya ntapata.

src: Since 1966 the Sundarbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.
trg: Banda mvula ya 1996 Sundarbans vandaka mfinda ya kubumbila bambisi, mpi bubu yai yo kele na 400 ya ba tigele ya Luyalu ya Bengale na 30 000 ya bankai ke monana na Distrike.

src: Buses depart the inter-district bus station (across the river) throughout the day, though most, especially those heading to the east and Jakar/Bumthang leave between 06:30 and 07:30.
trg: Babisi ke katukaka na bifulu ya kati ya badistrike sambu na kuzwa bisi kati na bwala (na ndambu ya nkaka na nzadi) na kilumbu, mingi na bayina ke katuka na este ya Jaker/Bumthang, ke katukaka kati na ngunga ya 6:30 na 7:30.

src: As the inter-district buses are often full, it is advisable to purchase a ticket a few days in advance.
trg: Sambu babisi ya kati a distrike ke ke vandaka mingi ya kufuluka mingi, yo kele mbote na kuyita kusumba tike na ntwala.

src: Most districts are served by small Japanese Coaster Buses, which are comfortable and sturdy.
trg: Badistrike mingi kele na babisi ya Bajaponais, yayi kele ya mbote mpi nene.

src: Shared taxis are a quick and comfortable means to travel to nearby places, such as Paro (Nu 150) and Punakha (Nu 200).
trg: Kukabula taxi na mpangi kele nzila ya nkufi mpi ya kudelakana na kusala nzietelo na bisika kele ntama ve, mutindu Paro (ntalu Nu 150) mpi Punakha (ntalu Nu 200).

src: The Oyapock River Bridge is a cable-stayed bridge. It spans the Oyapock River to link the cities of Oiapoque in Brazil and Saint-Georges de l'Oyapock in French Guiana.
trg: Oyapock River Bridge kele pont ya bansinga. Yo me tandama na zulu ya Nzadi ya Oyapack sambu na kukangisa Mbanza ya Oiapoque na Brezil mpi Saint George ya Oyapock na Guyanne ya ba Falanse.

src: The two towers rise to a height of 83 meters, it's 378 meters long and it has two lanes of 3.50 m wide.
trg: banzo zole ya etaje kele na inda ya 83 mètre, inda ya 378 mètre ti banzila zole ya 3,50 m nanene.

src: The vertical clearance under the bridge is 15 meters. Construction was completed in August 2011, it didn't open to traffic until March 2017.
trg: Kisika ya kutelema na yisi ya pont ke bametre 15. Kutunga manisaka na ngonda ya Agusta, mvula ya 2011, nzila pesamaka tete ve tii na ngonda ya Malasi na mvulu ya 2017.

src: The bridge is scheduled to be fully operational in September 2017, when the Brazilian customs checkpoints are expected to be finished.
trg: Bo kanaka na kuyantika kusadila pont na Septembre 2017, ntangu bisalu ya bisika ya kutelemisa bakamio ya douane ya Brazilia ta mana.

src: The Guaraní were the most significant indigenous group inhabiting what is now Eastern Paraguay, living as semi-nomadic hunters who also practised subsistence agriculture.
trg: Bagurani kele kimvuka ya mbalu ya kuluta yonso ya bantu ya ke vandaka na insi ina ya kele bubu Paraguay ya esti, kuzingaka bonso bazombi ya kele kisika mosi kansi kutambulaka kati ya kisika yai na ya nkaka mpi basalak bilanga sambu na kubika.

src: The Chaco region was home to other groups of indigenous tribes such as the Guaycurú and Payaguá, who survived by hunting, gathering and fishing.
trg: Distrike ya Chaco vandaka bisika ya bantu ya makanda ya insi mutindu ba Guaycurú mpi ba Payaguá, yo zingilaka na nkubulu yabambisi, kuyonzika bima ya nfinda na kutakula ba mbisi.

src: In the 16th century Paraguay, formerly called "The Giant Province of the Indies", was born as a result of the encounter of Spanish conquerors with the native indigenous groups.
trg: Na 16e siècle, Paraguay, yina na ntama zina na yo vwandiki "Mbanza ya nene ya Inde", butukaka na nima ya mizingu na basoda ya Espagne na binkuku ya bantu ya bwala.

src: The Spaniards started the colonization period which lasted for three centuries.
trg: Bantu ya Espagne bandaka ntangu ya kinanga na maboko ya banzenza yo zingaka bamvula nkama tatu.

src: Since the foundation of Asunción in 1537, Paraguay has managed to keep a lot of its indigenous character and identity.
trg: Katuka ntangu yina kikunku ya Asuncion salamaka na 1537, Paraguay zwaka ngengolo na kubumba mbelo ya yandi ya kintama na kuvanda bantu ya kintama.

src: Argentina is well known for having one of the best polo teams and players in the world.
trg: Argentine me zabana mingi sambu na kuvanda na ekipi ya nkweso na bibudi nkweso ya kulutila mbote mingi na insi ya mvimba.

src: The largest tournament of the year takes place in December at the polo fields in Las Cañitas.
trg: Bansaka ya kumekasana ngolo ya mvula ke salamaka na ngonda ya Kumi na zole na bifulu ya nsaka ya polo na Canitas.

src: Smaller tournaments and matches can also be seen here at other times of the year.
trg: Na kisika yayi na bantangu ya nkaka ya mvula, bantu lenda tala bansaka mpi bansaka ya balo ya fioti.

src: For news on tournaments and where to buy tickets for polo matches, check Asociacion Argentina de Polo.
trg: Sambu na kuzwa bansangu na tournoi mpi wapi kusumba tiket sambu na lukutakanu ya nsaka ya polo, kwenda kutala mbote na Kimvuka ya Argemfunu ya Polo.

src: The official Falklands currency is the Falkland pound (FKP) whose value is set equivalent to that of one British pound (GBP).
trg: Falkland pound (FKP) kele mbongo ina Falklands ke sadilaka mfunu yo ke talanaka muntindu mbongo ya ba Anglais mosi.

src: Money can be exchanged at the only bank in the islands which is located in Stanley across from the FIC West store.
trg: Mbongo lenda kusoama na banki mosi kaka ya bisanga yina ke na Stanley na ngambu ya nkaka ya makazini ya FIC West.

src: British pounds will generally be accepted anywhere in the islands and within Stanley credit cards and United States dollars are also often accepted.
trg: Bapound mbongo ya Angleterre ta ndimama ndambu yonso na bisanga mpi na kati ya kalati ya credit Stanley mpi dollar americain.

src: On the outlying islands credit cards will probably not be accepted, although British and United States currency may be taken; check with the owners in advance to determine what is an acceptable payment method.
trg: Na kati ya bisanga ya ntama, bakalati ya crédit yo tandimama ve, Ata mbongo ya ba britanniques ti bantua Amerika kele ya kubakama; Tala mbote na bankwa makambu na ntwala nki mpila ya kufuta ya mbote me ndimama.

src: It is nearly impossible to exchange Falklands currency outside of the islands, so exchange money prior to leaving the islands.
trg: Nge lenda kusoba mbongo ya Falklands na nganda ya ba insi ya kati na masa ve, na yina soba mbongo ya nge tekila nge basika na ba insi ya kati ya masa.

src: Since Montevideo is south of the Equator, it is summer there when it's winter in the Northern Hemisphere and vice versa.
trg: Sambu Montevideo ke na Equateor ya sude, ntangu kele kuna na ntangu madidi ke na Hemisphere ya norde na mpi mutindu ina.

src: Montevideo is in the subtropics; in the summer months, temperatures above +30°C are common.
trg: Montevideo ke bwala kele mbanza ya tiya na bangonda mwini ntangu ke vandaka na zulu ya +30°C.

src: The winter can be deceptively chilly: temperatures rarely go below freezing, but the wind and humidity combine to make it feel colder than what the thermometer says.
trg: Nsiungi ya mpio lenda kusa kuvanda na madidi: bandungutila ke kulumuka na 0 mingi-mingi ve, kansi mupepe ti masa ke vukana sambu na kupesa madidi mpila termometre ke songaka.

src: There are no particular "rainy" and "dry" seasons: the amount of rain stays roughly the same throughout the year.
trg: Ntangu ya "kisiwu" mpi ya "mvula" yakingenga yi kele ve: Ntalu ya mvula ke vandaka kaka mutindu mosi na mvula mosi.

src: Though many of the animals in the park are used to seeing humans, the wildlife is nonetheless wild and should not be fed or disturbed.
trg: Bantu mingi ke talaka bambisi yina kele na kati ya mpaka, bambisi mpi banti ke na Mfinda, na muntu lenda kuyundula yo ve mpi ku sala mvwanzi na yo.

src: According to park authorities, stay at least 100 yards/meters away from bears and wolves and 25 yards/meters from all other wild animals!
trg: Na kulanda bamfumu ya parke, nge fete telama na kintamina ya bametre 100 ntama na ngombulu mpi imbwa ya mfinda mpi ba metre 25 ntama na bambisi yina ya nkaka ya mfinda!

src: No matter how docile they may look, bison, elk, moose, bears, and nearly all large animals can attack.
trg: Diambu ve inki luvuvamu bo lenda songisa, biibulu mutindu gombe-bison, eleki, mpakasa-moose, ours, bambisi yonso ya nene bo lenda kunwanisa konso kima yina lenda kusombola bo.

src: Each year, dozens of visitors are injured because they didn't keep a proper distance. These animals are large, wild, and potentially dangerous, so give them their space.
trg: Konso mvula, banzenza ya mingi ke lwalaka sambu na kukonda kuvanda ya ku tatuka. Bambisi yayi kele nene, ya imbi mpi ke vandaka kigonsa, yo yina bikila bo kisika na bo.

src: In addition, be aware that odors attract bears and other wildlife, so avoid carrying or cooking odorous foods and keep a clean camp.
trg: Diaka, zaba yo ti bansudi ke bendaka ba ours mpi bambisi ya nkaka ya mfinda, yo yna buya kunata to kulanda madia ya nsudi mpi tanina camp bunkete.

src: Apia is the capital of Samoa. The town is on the island of Upolu and has a population of just under 40,000.
trg: Apia kele mbanza kimfumu ya Samoa. Mbanza kele na ntoto ya kati ya masa ya Upolu mpi ya kele na bantu 40 000 ke zingaka kuna.

src: Apia was founded in the 1850s and has been the official capital of Samoa since 1959.
trg: Bo salaka Apia na 1850 mpi yo me kumaka bwala ya kimfumu ya ya Samoa banda 1959.

src: The harbor was the site of an infamous naval standoff in 1889 when seven ships from Germany, the US, and Britain refused to leave the harbor.
trg: Dibungu vandaka kisika yina maswa ya basoda ya masa yina vandaka na ngolo ve vandaka kangama na 1889, na ntangu bamaswa ya Allemagne, ya E.U, na Grande Bretagne mangaka kukatuka na kisika ya maswa.

src: All the ships were sunk, except for one British cruiser. Nearly 200 American and German lives were lost.
trg: Bamaswa yonso yo dindaka na masa. Katula kaka bwatu mosi ya babritaniki. Pene ya bantu 200 ya amerike ti Alemagne bofwaka.

src: During the struggle for independence organised by the Mau movement, a peaceful gathering in the town resulted in the killing of the paramount chief Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.
trg: Na ntangu ya kunwana sambu na kimpwanza yina kikunku ya Mau salaka, bantu vukanaka na ngemba na mbanza na nima ya lufwa ya ntinu ya nene Tupua Tamasese Lealofi III.

src: There are many beaches, due to Auckland's straddling of two harbours. The most popular ones are in three areas.
trg: Kuna kele na makumu mingi, sambu na lukutanu ya mabungu zole na Auckland. Ya ke zabana mingi kuluta yonso kele na binziunga tatu.

src: North Shore beaches (in North Harbour district) are on the Pacific Ocean and stretch from Long Bay in the north to Devonport in the south.
trg: Mabungu ya Norde (na Distrike ya North Harbour) me kubakama na Mbu Pacique mpi ke kubandaka na Long Bay na norde ti na Devonport na sude.

src: They are almost all sandy beaches with safe swimming, and most have shade provided by pohutukawa trees.
trg: Yo kele na banwtala ya mabundu me fuluka ya ntoto sambu na kuyobila kukonda kuzwa mambu ya mpasi, na mingi ke na mpeho ina bayiti ya pohutukawa ke pesaka.

src: Tamaki Drive beaches are on the Waitemata Harbour, in the upmarket suburbs of Mission Bay and St Heliers in Central Auckland.
trg: Mabungu ya Tamaki Drive kele na dibungu ya Waitemata, na zandu ya zulu ya kitini ya mbanza ya missio ya Bay mpi St Heliers na Auckland ya kati-kati.

src: These are sometimes-crowded family beaches with a good range of shops lining the shore. Swimming is safe.
trg: Bantangu ya nkaka ntoto me zungidila imbu ke vanda ya dikanda me kufulu ka bantu na bo ke vandaka mpi na banzo biteki bakoton bankento ke sadilaka. Na yo kuyobila na imbu ke vandaka mbote.

src: The main local beer is 'Number One', it is not a complex beer, but pleasant and refreshing. The other local beer is called "Manta".
trg: Malafu ya bwala me zabana mingi kele "Number One", yakele Malafu ya kidi- kidi ve kansi ya kitoko ya ke zunisaka ntima.. Malafu ya bwala ya nkaka zina na yo "Manta".

src: There are many French wines to be had, but the New Zealand and Australian wines might travel better.
trg: Vinu mingi ya France ke vandaka kuna, kansi vinu ya Nouvelle Zelande mpi ya Australie lenda vanda mbote sambu na nzietelo.

src: The local tap water is perfectly safe to drink, but bottled water is easy to find if you are fearful.
trg: Masa ya bwala ya pompi kele mbote na kunwa konda kuzwa kimbefo, kansi nge lenda zwa kukonda mpasi masi ya milangi kana nge kele na boma.

src: For Australians, the idea of 'flat white' coffee is foreign. A short black is 'espresso', cappuccino comes heaped high with cream (not froth), and tea is served without milk.
trg: Sambu na bantu ya Australie, dibanza ya "kafi ya mpembe kaka " kele diambu ya nzenza. Ya ndombi fioti ke "espresso", cappuccino ke kwisaka ya kuvukana na miliki ya kukangama (kukonda fulu- fulu), mpi ti kepesamaka kukonda miliki.

src: The hot chocolate is up to Belgian standards. Fruit juices are pricey but excellent.
trg: Chocolat ya tiya ke talanaka mingi na Belgique. Malafu yina bo ke salaka na bambuma ya kudia kele ntalu kansi kele mbote mingi.

src: Many trips to the reef are made all year around, and injuries due to any of these causes on the reef are rare.
trg: Banzietelo mingi ya kukwenda na ditadi yo ke salamaka konso mvula, mpi bantu kelwalaka ve mpenza.

src: Still, take advice from authorities, obey all signs, and pay close attention to safety warnings.
trg: Kansi, baka malongi na bamfumu ya bwala, zitisa bidimbu yonso, na sala angele na ba lukanu ya kubumba nitu mbote.

src: Box jellyfish occur near beaches and near river estuaries from October to April north of 1770. They can occasionally be found outside these times.
trg: Mbisi na kifuana ya buwa talanana na bankumu ya mabundu na ntwala sika ya masa mwila ke kuanda buaka na mabundu na ngonda ya Okutoba ti ya Apili ya norde ya 1770. Bambisi ina lenda talana na nsungi ya nkanka.

src: Sharks do exist, however they rarely attack humans. Most sharks are scared of humans and would swim away.
trg: Mbenga ya nenenene kele, kansi bo ke nwanisaka bantu ve. Mbenga ya nenenene kuluta mingi ke tinaka bantu mpi kukwenda ntama.

src: Saltwater Crocodiles do not actively live in the ocean, their primary habitat is in river estuaries north from Rockhampton.
trg: Bangandu ya masa ya mungwa ke vandaka mingi na mabundu ya nene ve, Bo me vandaka na ba nzadi ya norde ya Rockhampton.

src: Booking in advance gives the traveller peace of mind that they will have somewhere to sleep once they arrive at their destination.
trg: Kufuta sambu ba kusadisila nge kisika tekila kukuma ya nge, ke pesaka bantu ya ke sala nzietelo ngemba na kutala ti bo ke kuzwa kisika ya kuladila kana bo me kuma na kisika bo kanaka kukuma.

src: Travel agents often have deals with specific hotels, although you may find it possible to book other forms of accommodation, like camping grounds, through a travel agent.
trg: Bantu ya vwayaje ke vandaka mingi-mingi na ngwizani na bahotele, Ata nge lenda kubumbisa kisika na mpila nkaka ya kulala bonso bisika ya campingi, na nzila ya muntu ya vwayaje.

src: Travel agents usually offer packages that include breakfast, transportation arrangements to/from the airport or even combined flight and hotel packages.
trg: Ba agence nzitelo ke pesaka mbala mingi mwa bima ya madia fioti, kubongisa transport ya kunata na / kubanda na aéroport to kutu bima ya nkaka na avion ti hôtel.

src: They can also hold the reservation for you if you need time to think about the offer or procure other documents for your destination (e.g. visa).
trg: Bo lenda bumbila nge mpi kisika kana nge kele na mfunu ya ntangu ya kuyindula mpila ya kupesila nge to sambu na kubaka mikanda nkaka sambu na kisika yina nge ke kwenda (mbandu, viza).

src: Any amendments or requests though should be coursed through the travel agent first and not directly with the hotel.
trg: Kansi, konso nsoba to kulomba fwete salama ntete na nzila ya agence ya nzietelo kansi ve mbala mosi na nsadisa ya hotel.

src: For some festivals, the vast majority of the attendants to music festivals decide to camp on site, and most attendants consider it a vital part of the experience.
trg: Sambu na bafeti ya nkaka, mingi ya bantu ina me baka kisika na mukembo ya banzimbu bakaka lukanu na kulala na kuna, mingi talaka ti kulala na kisika ya mukembo kele mbote naku yangalala mbote.

src: If you want to be close to the action you're going to have to get in early to get a camping site close to the music.
trg: Kana nge zola ku zinga lukufi na kisika ya nkembo, nge fwana kuzwa na ntangu kisika ya mvundulu kele lukufi na kisika ya miziki.

src: Remember that even though music on the main stages may have finished, there may be sections of the festival that will keep playing music until late into the night.
trg: Nge fwete zaba yo ti Ata ngimbudulu yina ba solaka lenda kumanisa, yo ke na bikunku ya fesitivale ina lenda kutatamana kuyimba tii na nkokila.

src: Some festivals have special camping areas for families with young children.
trg: Bantu ya nkaka yina ya ke yangalala ke na ba ka sambu na mabuta ya kele na bana ya fioto.

src: If crossing the Northern Baltic in winter, check the cabin location, as going through ice causes quite horrible noise for those most affected.
trg: Na nsabukuluya Baltic ya norde na ntantu ya madidi ya insi ya nzenza, zaba kisika ya nsinga, sambu kutambula na matadi ya madidi ke salaka makelele ya ngolo na bantuke yoka mpasi.

src: Saint Petersburg cruises include time in town. Cruise passengers are exempted from visa requirements (check the terms).
trg: Bamaswa ya Saint-Pétersbourg yo kele na bantangu yai yo ke lutisa na mbanza. Bantu ya ke tambula na maswa yango bo ke lomba bo viza ve (beno tala bakondisio).

src: Casinos typically make many efforts to maximize time and money spent by guests. Windows and clocks are usually absent, and exits can be hard to find.
trg: Bakazino ke salaka ngolo na vanda na ntangu mingi ya kisalu na kuvanda na mbongo mingi yina bibudi nsaka ke pesaka. Bafenetele na kisadilu ya kutadila ntangu ke vandaka ve, na yo ke vandaka mpasi na mona mwelo.

src: They usually have special food, drink and entertainment offers, to keep guests in a good mood, and keep them at the premise.
trg: Bo kevadaka mbala mingi na madia, ya kunwa mpi ti bima ya kulutisa ntangu na bakilian sambu bovanda mbote mpi ti bovanda kaka pana.

src: Some venues offer alcoholic beverages on the house. However, drunkenness impairs judgement, and all good gamblers know the importance of staying sober.
trg: Bisika ya nkaka ya nene ke tekisaka baMalafu ya ngolo. Ya kedika, kukolwa na ndwinu ke talanaka imbi, na bibudi bansaka yonso ya mbote zaba nkizi ya kunwa Malafu na ludedomo yonso.

src: Anyone who's going to drive at high latitudes or over mountain passes should consider the possibility of snow, ice, or freezing temperatures.
trg: Konso muntu ke yuluka bangumba ya nda to kuzieta na ngumba fwete zaba nde yandi lenda bwa na neze, matadi ya madidi ya mpembe to ntangu ya madidi mingi.

src: On icy and snowy roadways, friction is low and you cannot drive as if you were on bare asphalt.
trg: Na banzila ya matadi ya mvula ya mpembe, kuniemfuna kele ya ngolo ve mpi nge lenda ve kunata kamio bonso na nzila ya makadame ya mpamba.

src: During blizzards, enough snow to get you stuck can fall in very little time.
trg: Na ntangu ya mipepe ya ngolo ya madidi, mvula ya mpembe ya kulunga ya kukanga nge lenda bwa na ntangu ya fioti.

src: Visibility may also be restricted by falling or blowing snow or by condensation or ice on vehicle windows.
trg: Kumona mbote lenda vanda na ndilu sambu na kubwa ya mvula mpembe to na midinga to na lubungi to na madidi ya bavoiture.

src: On the other hand, icy and snowy conditions are normal in many countries, and traffic goes on mostly uninterrupted all year round.
trg: Na ngambu ya nkaka, ba glace mpi ntangu ya baneige kele kaka mbote na babwala mingi ti kutambula ke salamaka mingi-mingi kuzanga kukangama mvula mvimba.

src: Safaris are perhaps the greatest tourism draw in Africa and the highlight for many visitors.
trg: Basafari kele mbala ya nkaka bima ya ke bendaka bantu mingi na kukwenda kutala Afrika mpi kisika yina bantu mingi ke kwendaka kutalai.

src: The term safari in popular use refers to overland travel to view the stunning African wildlife, particularly on savanna.
trg: Ngogo Safari zola tuba nzietelo na ntoto ya Afrika, na mfinda mingi na kutala bambisi.

src: Some animals, such as elephants and giraffes, tend to approach closely to cars and standard equipment will allow good viewing.
trg: Bambisi ya nkaka, mutindu nzawu na zilafe, ke mekaka kupusana na ntwala bakamio na kisadilu yina ke pesaka nzila na kutala mbote bizizi.

src: Lions, cheetahs and leopards are sometimes shy and you will see them better with binoculars.
trg: Bantambu, ba guépards mpi bankoyi ke vandaka nsoni-nsoni bantangu ya nkaka mpi nge ta mona bo mbote na ba jumelle.

src: A walking safari (also called a "bush walk", "hiking safari", or going "footing") consists of hiking, either for a few hours or several days.
trg: Safari ya kutambula (bo ke binga yo diaka "kutambula na Nseke", "safari ya kutambula", to kwenda "footing") ke lomba kwenda tambula ntama, ata sambu na ngunga fioti to bilumbu mingi.

src: The Paralympics will take place from 24 August to 5 September 2021. Some events will be held in other locations throughout Japan.
trg: Bansaka ya Olympiki ya ba handikape yonso ta salama kubanda kilumbu ya 24 Aouti tii na kilumbu ya 5 Septemba 2021. Mambu ya nkaka ta salama na bisika ya nkaka na Japon.

src: Tokyo will be the only Asian city to have hosted two summer Olympics, having hosted the games in 1964.
trg: Tokyo ta vanda siti mosi kaka ya Azia ya me yamba bansaka ya Olimiki ya nsungi ya kisiwu zole, sambu bo yambaka bansaka yina na 1964.

src: If you booked your flights and accommodation for 2020 before the postponement was announced, you may have a tricky situation.
trg: Kana nge me sumba batike ya avion ti kisika na nge ya kulala sambu na 2020 na ntwala ya kusonga nsoba, ngeta lenda kuvanda na kigonsa.

src: Cancellation policies vary, but as of late March most coronavirus-based cancellation policies don't extend to July 2020, when the Olympics had been scheduled.
trg: Mutindu ya kumangina ba politiki ke ya luswaswanu, kansi kaka na ngonda ya Malasi mingi ya ba lukanu me tadila ku yimina ba mambu kulaka ve tii na ngonda ya Yuni ya 2020, ntangu bansaka ya Olympiki zola salama.

src: It's expected that most event tickets will cost between ¥2,500 and ¥130,000, with typical tickets costing around ¥7,000.
trg: Ya me zabakana ti ba ke sumba tike ya 2500 Y na 130 000Y, na kutala ntalu ya zabakana ya tike yina kele 1 000 Y.

src: Ironing damp clothes can help them dry. Many hotels have an iron and ironing board available for loan, even if one is not present in the room.
trg: Kulutisa felo ke kandulaka bilele ya masa-masa ke sadisa yo na kuyuma. Ba hotel mingi ke na fer mpi na mesa ya kurepasser sambu na kudefisa ata kana mosi kele ve na chambre.

src: If an iron isn't available, or if you don't fancy wearing ironed socks, then you can try using a hairdryer, if available.
trg: Kana kisalulu ya kikandulu bilele kela ve, to kana ke zola ve kuvwata ba sosweti ya mutindu ina, nge lenda kusadila kisadilu kiyumisi suki ya kula kana yo kele.

src: Be careful not to allow fabric to become too hot (which can cause shrinkage, or in extreme cases, scorch).
trg: Sala keba kubika ve lele kukuma tia mingi (yo lenda kuyoka lele, to na kukumisa yo kuyokama).

src: There are different ways of purifying water, some more effective against specific threats.
trg: Banzila ya kutemusa masa ke swaswana, mingi ya nkaka kusala yo mbote na kutina bimbefo ya nkaka.

src: In some areas boiling water for a minute is enough, in others several minutes are needed.
trg: Na bizunga ya nkaka ku tedika masa na minute mosi me kulunga, na bima ya nkaka bo fwete sadila baminutes mingi.

src: Filters vary in effectiveness, and should you have a concern, then you should consider buying your water in a sealed bottle from a reputable company.
trg: Bafiltre ke swananaka na ngolo na yo, mpi kana diambu ke tungisa nge, nge lenda mpidina kusumba masa na nge na mulangu ya kele ya kukangama mbote tuka na kompani ya lukumu ya mbote.

src: Travellers may encounter animal pests that they are not familiar with in their home regions.
trg: Bantu ya ke sala nzietelo lenda kutana ti bambisi ya mbi yai ya bo ke zaba ve na bwala yina bo me katuka.

src: Pests can spoil food, cause irritation, or in a worse case cause allergic reactions, spread venom, or transmit infections.
trg: Bambisi ya fioti lenda kubebisa madia, kutatika na nitu, na kuluta mbi kusala mbi na nitu, kupanza ndikila, to kupesa bimbefu.

src: Infectious diseases themselves, or dangerous animals that can injure or kill people by force, do not usually qualify as pests.
trg: Bimbefo ya sambukila to Bambisi ya kigonsa yai ya lenda kuzukisa to kufwa bantu, lenda kubingama Bambisi ya bimenina ve.

src: Duty free shopping is the opportunity to buy goods exempted from taxes and excises at certain locations.
trg: Kusumba bima konda kufuta mbongo ke le ntangu ya mbote ya kusumba bima konda kufuta mpaku na yo ke salamaka na bizunga yonso ve.

src: Travellers bound for countries with heavy taxation can sometimes save a considerable amount of money, especially on products such as alcoholic beverages and tobacco.
trg: Bantu na nzietelo katuka na bansi ya mpaku ya ntalu kuluta lenda ntangu ya nkaka kubumba mbongo mingi, mingi mingi sambu na kusumba bima bonso malafu ya tiya mpi makaya.

src: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain.
trg: Mwa ntoto ya me tandama katikati na Point Marionmpi Fairmont kele kitina ya nzila ya mpasi kuluta yonso sambu na kutambwisa kamio na balabala ya nenen ya Buffalo-Pitttsburg, kulutaka mbala na mbala nanzila ya bantu ke lutaka ve na nima ya bwala.

src: If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate.
trg: Kana nge me yikama ntete ve kunata kamio na banzila ya insi kangula meso: mipanzi ya ngumba ya nda, nzila ya kukangama fioti, mpi kubukama ya nzila ya ngolo me lutana.

src: Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise.
trg: Bidimbu ya ke tula nsuka ya ntinu ya kutambwisa kamio vandaka kumonana na bitini ya ntete mpi ya kulanda ya nzila -- mingi mingi kilometre 56-64 na ntangu mosi -- mpi kulemfukila yonso kele mfunu mingi kuluta.

src: Curiously, though, mobile phone service is much stronger here than along many other stretches of the route, e.g. the Pennsylvania Wilds.
trg: Kansi, kima ya bendaka dikebi kele nde bisalu ya telefone ya maboko ke ngolo mingi awa kuluta na bitini ya nkaka ya nzila, mu mbandu na Pennsylvania Wilds.

src: German pastries are quite good, and in Bavaria, are quite rich and varied, similar to those of their southern neighbor, Austria.
trg: Nsadilu ya bagato ya bana Allemagne me lutila mbote, na ya bana Bavaria, yo me fuluka na bavitamine mpi ya luswaswanu, na yo me fwetekana na ya ba mpangi ya bo ya sude, ya Autriche.

src: Fruit pastries are common, with apples cooked into pastries year round, and cherries and plums making their appearances during the summer.
trg: Ba gateaux ke monana, na mbuma ya pomme ya bo ke lambaka bamvula na mvula, cerises mpi prunes ya ke monana na nsungi ya kisiwu.

src: Many German baked goods also feature almonds, hazelnuts, and other tree nuts. Popular cakes often pair particularly well with a cup of strong coffee.
trg: Bima mingi ya kuteka ya bo ke salaka bonso mampa na Allemagne ke vandaka mpi ti ba amande, bangasi mpi mikanzi ya nkaka. Mbala mingi, bagato ya bantu ke zolaka mingi, bo ke diaka yo ti kafe ya ngolo.

src: If you want some small though rich pastries, try what depending on region are called Berliner, Pfannkuchen or Krapfen.
trg: Kana nge zola kudya ba gato ya luwu ya sikisiki, meka yina ke salamaka na bizunga ya Berliner, Pfannkuchen to Krapfen.

src: A curry is a dish based on herbs and spices, together with either meat or vegetables.
trg: Curry kele madia ya me lambama na matiti ti baepise, ya kusangisa ti musuni to bandunda.

src: A curry can be either "dry" or "wet" depending on the amount of liquid.
trg: Curry lenda vanda ya "kuyuma" to ya "masa" yo ke talaka mpila masa kele.

src: In inland regions of Northern India and Pakistan, yogurt is commonly used in curries; in Southern India and some other coastal regions of the subcontinent, coconut milk is commonly used.
trg: Na bisika ya kati ya nordi ya Inde to ya Pakistan, bo ke sadilaka mingi yayourt na kusansa maladi ya meno; na sude ya Ine mpi na bisika ya nkaka ya pene-pene ya masa, bo ke sadilaka mingi mukanzi ya kokoti.

src: With 17,000 islands to choose from, Indonesian food is an umbrella term covering a vast variety of regional cuisines found across the nation.
trg: Na bantoto 17 000 ya kati ya masa lenda solwa, madia ya Indonesie kele ngogo yina ke bumbaka bikuku ya bizunga mingi na insi.

src: But, if used without further qualifiers, the term tends to mean the food originally from the central and eastern parts of the main island Java.
trg: Kansi, kana kusadila yo ngatu bikalulu, ngogo kele kubaka ntendula ya madia yina me katuka na bitini ya katikati mpi ya esti ya kisanga ya Java ya nene.

src: Now widely available throughout the archipelago, Javanese cuisine features an array of simply seasoned dishes, the predominant flavorings the Javanese favor being peanuts, chillies, sugar (especially Javanese coconut sugar) and various aromatic spices.
trg: Sesepi yo kele kisika yonso na archipel, na kikuku ya bajavanaise bo ke pesaka madia ya pete na yayi ke tala baepise, bansudi ya mbote ya baJavanais kezolaka ya banguba, bapilipili, sucre (mingi mingi sukali ya nkuku ya bajavanais) ti baepise ya mpila yonso ya nsudi.

src: Stirrups are supports for the rider's feet that hang down on either side of the saddle.
trg: Baétriers kele basupports sambu na makulu ya munwani/basoda na mpunda kele na bangambu zole ya selle/kima ya kuvandila.

src: They provide greater stability for the rider but can have safety concerns due to the potential for a rider's feet to get stuck in them.
trg: Bame kubika mvwandulu ya mbote ya kinati mpunda kansi ba fwana kutadila mpi diambu ya kubumba nitu mbote sambu na makulu ya kinati mpunda lenda kutala mpasi.

src: If a rider is thrown from a horse but has a foot caught in the stirrup, they could be dragged if the horse runs away. To minimize this risk, a number of safety precautions can be taken.
trg: Kana mutambwisi me losama na mpunda kansi dikulu mosi me kangama na étrier, yandi lenda kubendana kana mpunda kutina. Sambu na kulembisa kigonsa yai, mwa mambu ya kukeba lenda vanda mfunu.

src: First, most riders wear riding boots with a heel and a smooth, quite narrow, sole.
trg: Ya ntete, binati mpunda mingi ke vwataka baboti ya yinda na ke kangaka nitu.

src: Next, some saddles, particularly English saddles, have safety bars that allow a stirrup leather to fall off the saddle if pulled backwards by a falling rider.
trg: Bivwandulu na zulu ya mpunda ya nkaka, mingi mingi bivwandulu ya ba Anglais, kele na bayiti yu lukengolo ya nitu yina kele ya kwile, nge ke kuvanda na zulu na yo kana nge ke kinati mpunda.

src: Cochamó Valley - Chile's premier climbing destination, known as the Yosemite of South America, with a variety of granite big walls and crags.
trg: Vallée ya Cochamo - kele kisika ya Chilie yi banzenza ke kwisaka mingi, mutindu Yosemite ya Amrique ya Banda, na matadi ya fyoti fyoti ya kibaka ya nene na matadi.

src: Summits include breath-taking views from peaks. Climbers from all parts of the world are continually establishing new routes amongst its endless potential of walls.
trg: Na nsongi kele pesa nzila ya kumona na ntama bifwani-fwani ya ke zenga mpema katuka nsonge. Bantu ya ke kutombuka kuna katuka ndambu na ndambu n insi ya mvimba ke kulanda kutula banzila ya mpa na kati-kati ya yina lendaka kuvanda bibaka.

src: Downhill snowsports, which include skiing and snowboarding, are popular sports involving sliding down snow-covered terrain with skis or a snowboard attached to your feet.
trg: Bansaka ya neige ya kukulumuka ngumba, yina ke tadila ski mpi bansaka ya neige, kele bansaka ya bantu mingi ke zolaka yina ke lombaka kusietumuka na kisika mosi ya kele ti neige mingi to na mabaya ya bo me kanga nge na makulu.

src: Skiing is a major travelling activity with many enthusiasts, occasionally known as "ski bums," planning entire vacations around skiing at a particular location.
trg: Ski kele kisalu ya nene ya nzietelo yina kele ti bantu mingi ya ke zolaka yo, bantangu ya nkaka bo ke bingaka bo “bampika ya ski,” bo ke yidikaka nzietelo na bo ya mvimba sambu na kusala ski na kisika mosi buna.

src: The idea of skiing is very old — cave paintings depicting skiers date back as far as 5000 BC!
trg: Ngindu ya ski kele ya ntama mpenza - kusala bifwanisu ya bantu ya ski ke mata na mabulu me yantikaka banda na mvu 5000 na ntwala ya ntangu na beto!

src: Downhill skiing as a sport goes back to at least the 17th century, and in 1861 the first recreational ski club was opened by Norwegians in Australia.
trg: Ski alpin bonso nsak, bandaka na mvu-nkama, mpi na 1861, bo salaka ekipe ya ntete ya Ski ya nsaka na bantu ya Norvege na Australie.

src: Backpacking by ski: This activity is also called backcountry ski, ski touring or ski hiking.
trg: Kusietumuka ya ski: Kisalu yai bo ke bingaka yo mpi ski ya mudindu, ski ya nzietelo, to ski ya kutambula.

src: It is related to but usually not involving alpine style ski touring or mountaineering, the latter ones done in steep terrain and requiring much stiffer skis and boots.
trg: Yo ke tala kansi ke lomba mutindu ya kusala tour ya nsaka ya ski to ya kumata ngumba ve, ya nima yai salamaka na ntoto ya kukita mingi mpi ke lomba ski ya ngolo mpi ba bottes.

src: Think of the skiing route as of a similar hiking route.
trg: Beno kanina na nzila ya ski bonso na nzila ya kutabula ya mila mosi.

src: In good conditions you will be able to cover somewhat greater distances than walking – but only very seldom you will get the speeds of cross country skiing without a heavy backpack in groomed tracks.
trg: Kana nge ke na mavimpi ya mbote ke tambula kitini ya yinda - kansi ke lenda sala ski na kukwenda ntinu konda vanda na kizutu.

src: Europe is a continent that is relatively small but with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, travelling through multiple countries would mean having to go through visa applications and passport control multiple times.
trg: Europa kele kontina ya fioti kansi na bansi mingi ina kele na kimpwanza. Na ntangu mambu kele mbote, tekila na kuzieta na ba insi ina muntu fwana kusala ndombolo ya Visa mpi kulutisa mfimpulu Passeport ba ntangu mingi.

src: The Schengen zone, however, works somewhat like one country in this respect.
trg: kitini ya Shengen, ke salaka nzokande, bonso insi mosi na kutalaka mambu yai.

src: As long as you stay in this zone, you can generally cross borders without going through passport control checkpoints again.
trg: Kana nge me kuzina ntama na Distrike yayi, nge lenda kusabuka bandilu konda kusonga Passeport na bifulu ba polisi ke lombaka yo.

src: Similarly, by having a Schengen visa, you do not need to apply for visas to each of the Schengen member countries separately, hence saving time, money and paperwork.
trg: Kana nge ke na viza ya Schengen, nge fwana ku lomba visa Shengen na ba insi zole ya luswaswanu ve, sambu na kusadila ntangu, kubumba mbongo na mpi lu kebolo ya mikanda ya kisalu.

src: There is no universal definition for which manufactured items are antiques. Some tax agencies define goods older than 100 years as antiques.
trg: ntinula ya zabakana kele ve na kutala bunkoko ya na bangogo me tadila kuzinga bifunda.

src: The definition has geographic variations, where the age limit might be shorter in places such as North America than in Europe.
trg: Ntendula ke sobaka na kutadila mambu ya geographie, kisika nsuka ya mvula lenda vanda nkufi na bisika ya nkaka mu mbandu na Amerika ya Norde kuluta na Eropa.

src: Handicraft products might be defined as antiques, though they are younger than similar mass-produced goods.
trg: Bisalu ya maboko lenda talana kima ya ntama, mingi ke salaka yo ke bantwanya kansi ke salaka mbingi mpi mbote kisalu ya bo.

src: Reindeer husbandry is an important livelihood among the Sámi and the culture surrounding the trade is important also for many with other professions.
trg: Kuvunga mameme kele mfunu sambu na kikunku ya ba Sami kansi kutekisa mpi kele mbote na bisalu ya nkaka.

src: Even traditionally, though, not all Sámi have been involved in big scale reindeer husbandry, but lived from fishing, hunting and similar, having reindeer mostly as draft animals.
trg: Na yina me tadila kinkoka, bantu ya Sami yonso ve ke yundulaka bambisi, kansi ke lobaka ba mbisi, kufwaka ba mbisi na bisalu yonso me fwetena na yayi, na ke yundulaka mpi bambisi na zina ya renne.

src: Today many Sámi work in modern trades. Tourism is an important income in Sápmi, the Sámi area.
trg: Bubu yayi bantu ya Sami ke tekisaka bima na nzila ya kuzangama. Dyambu yamba banzenza ke bumina bisika ya kintama ya bwala me nata mbongo mingi na Sapmi, na Distrike ya Sami.

src: Though it is widely used, especially among non-Romani, the word "Gypsy" is often considered offensive because of its associations with negative stereotypes and inaccurate perceptions of Romani people.
trg: Na yina ti ba ke sadilaka yo mingi, mingi kati na bayina ke le bana ya Loma ve, ngogo "Gypsy" ke talanaka mbi sambu na kati na yo kele bangogo ya busafu na yo ke songaka mpi mutindu ntalulu ya mbi ya bana ya Loma.

src: If the country you will be visiting becomes subject to a travel advisory, your travel health insurance or your trip cancellation insurance may be affected.
trg: Kana bwala yayi nge takwenda sambu na kutala yo me kuma kisika na nge ya vwayaje, assurance na nge ya maladi ya vwayaje to assurance na nge ya annulation yo lenda baka kigonsa.

src: You may also wish to consult the advice of governments other than your own, but their advice is designed for their citizens.
trg: Nge lenda kulomba ndongisila ya basadi ya nkaka kuluta ya nge mosi, kansi conseil na bo yo ke vandaka sambu na bantu na bo.

src: As one example, American citizens in the Middle East might face different situations from Europeans or Arabs.
trg: Mbandu mosi, bana ya insi ya Amerika, na bansi ya ntangu ke lalaka, to Myen Orient, lenda kutana na makambu ya luswaswani katuka na bansi ya Europa to ya Alaba.

src: Advisories are merely a brief summary of the political situation in one country.
trg: Mabanza ke mfunu Kutunga ya luyalu ya insi.

src: The views presented are often cursory, general and oversimplified compared to the more detailed information available elsewhere.
trg: Bifwani bo me kusonga kele mfunu mingi ve, mpi me kutadila mambu yonso na nsoba ya mingi ve kana yo me kufwanukuswa na mambu ya nginzi mingi fwana ku zabakana bisika yonso.

src: Severe weather is the generic term for any dangerous weather phenomenon with the potential to cause damage, serious social disruption, or loss of human life.
trg: Nsungi ya mbi kele ngogo ya me lunga sambu nsungi yonso yai kigonsa lenda kusala ete bima kubeba, luzingu ya kimvuka ya bantu kubeba, to kuvidisa luzingu ya bantu.

src: Severe weather can occur anywhere in the world, and there are different types of it, which can depend on geography, topography, and atmospheric conditions.
trg: Ba conditions météorologiques ya ngolo yo lenda kwisa na bisika yonso na ntoto, ba mpila yo kele ya kuswanakisa, yayi lenda vanda sambu na géographie, topographie ti ya ba conditions atmosphériques.

src: High winds, hail, excessive precipitation, and wildfires are forms and effects of severe weather, as are thunderstorms, tornadoes, waterspouts, and cyclones.
trg: Mipepe ya makasi, mvula ya matadi,manoka ya kuluta, mpi tia ya ke manisa mfinda kele mitindu ya mpi mpasi ya ngolo ya nsiungu ya mbi, mutindu kele mvula ya banzadi, kuluma, masa kokita ntinu, mpi mupepe ya ngolo.

src: Regional and seasonal severe weather phenomena include blizzards, snowstorms, ice storms, and dust storms.
trg: Bansoba ya ntangu na Distrike kele bitembo ya neze, bitembo ya matadi, bitembo ya ntoto.

src: Travellers are strongly advised to be aware of any risk of severe weather affecting their area as they may affect any travel plans.
trg: Ya me kulombama na bantu ya ke sala nzietelo na kuzaba mambu ya mpasi kitembo ya ngolo lenda nata sambu yo lenda kubebisa nzietelo ya Bo.

src: Anyone planning a visit to a country that could be considered a war zone should get professional training.
trg: Muntu yonso ya ke yilama kusala nzietelo na insi ya bo lenda tala bonso kisika ya muzingu fwete kulonguka.

src: A search of the Internet for 'Hostile environment course' will probably provide the address of a local company.
trg: Na nsosolo ya "Hostile environment course" na inteleneti, yo ke pesa zina ya kisika kompani yayi ke zingaka.

src: A course will normally cover all the issues discussed here in far greater detail, usually with practical experience.
trg: Malongi ta tadila mambu yina ya beto me tubila awa na nda ya ya makambu, mingi mingi na mayele ya kusadila.

src: A course will normally be from 2-5 days and will involve role play, a lot of first aid and sometimes weapons training.
trg: Kulonguka tasala bilumbu 2 tii 5 mpi yota vanda na bansaka, kulonguka ya mingi ya ntete ti mbala ya nkaka kulonguka ya minduki.

src: Books and magazines dealing with wilderness survival are common, but publications dealing with war zones are few.
trg: Babuku na magazina me tadila kizingu ya ntoto ya kuyuma kele mutindu mosi, kansi bansonokono yina me tadila bizunga yina bantu ke na kunwana mvita kele fyoti.

src: Voyagers planning sex reassignment surgery abroad must ensure they're carrying valid documents for the return trip.
trg: Bantu ya vwayaje yayi kezolaka kuchanje nitu na bo ya kibubakala to ya kibunkento na bwala ya bapaya bofwete nata mikanda na bo ya kuvutuka.

src: The willingness of governments to issue passports with gender not stated (X) or documents updated to match a desired name and gender varies.
trg: Nswa ya ba guvernema ya kupesa ba passeport ntangu sexe me tadisama ve (X) to mikanda ya mbote sambu na kuvanda mpila mosi na zina ti sexe ya mbote.

src: Willingness of foreign governments to honour these documents is just as widely variable.
trg: Manzangu ya mbula matadi ya nzenga na ku pesa lukumu na mikanda yayi vandaka ya luswaswanu.

src: Searches at security checkpoints have also become far more intrusive in the post-September 11, 2001 era.
trg: Bo me kumaka mpi kutala mikanda ngolo na bisika ya bo ke talaka mikanda na nima ya kilumbu ya 11 septembre 2001.

src: Pre-operative transgender people should not expect to pass through the scanners with their privacy and dignity intact.
trg: Bantu ya transgenre na ntwala ya kusala operation bolendaka ve kubanza kuluta na bascanner na bifu na bo ti mpila na bo ya mbote.

src: Rip currents are the returning flow from waves breaking off the beach, often at a reef or similar.
trg: masa ya ngolo ke kulumukaka na masa ke nangukaka na mvingu yonso kuluta tii na ntwala bamasa, yo ke yalanganaka tii na matadi.

src: Due to the underwater topology the return flow is concentrated at a few deeper sections, and a fast current to deep water may form there.
trg: Mutindu bandongokolo ya yisi ya masa me kusonga, kuvutuka ya masa ke salama na bisika yina masa kele na ndilu mingi, na masa ya ngolo yina kelutaka ntinu lenda kutalana kuna.

src: Most deaths happen as result of fatigue trying to swim back against the current, which may be impossible.
trg: Bantu mingi ka bo ke na nitu ya kulemba kana bame kota na masa ke na kuluta ngolo na lweka ya kaka, ba ke fwaka mingi, na kutala ya zolaka salama ve.

src: As soon as you get out of the current, swimming back is no more difficult than normally.
trg: Kana nge basika na courant, natation kele mpasi ve kuluta bifu.

src: Try aiming somewhere where you are not caught again or, depending on your skills and on whether you have been noticed, you might want to wait for rescue.
trg: Meka kusosa kubula wapi nge me kangama ntete ve, to yo me tadila mayele na nge mpi kana bo zabisaka nge, nge fwete kinga sambu na kubika.

src: Re-entry shock comes on sooner than culture shock (there's less of a honeymoon phase), lasts longer, and can be more severe.
trg: Mpasi ya kukota diaka kwisaka ntama ve kuluta mpasi ya mabu ya luzingu ya bantu (kitini ya kiese ya libala ya ntete ke fioti), ke wumela mingi mpi lenda kuma ngolo kuluta.

src: Travellers who had an easy time adjusting to the new culture sometimes have a particularly hard time readjusting to their native culture.
trg: Bantu ya nzietelo ya ke na ntangu ya pete ya kuyikama nswalu na bunkoko ya mpa ke vandaka na mpasi ya kuyikama na bunkoko na bo ya mbutukulu.

src: When returning home after living abroad, you've adapted to the new culture and lost some of your habits from your home culture.
trg: Kana nge me vutuka na bwala ya nge na nima ya kuzingila na insi ya nzenza, nge fwana kulonguka diaka mutindu ya kuvandila samu nge ke zimbisa bifu ya nkaka ya bunkoko yange.

src: When you went abroad at first, people were probably patient and understanding, knowing that travellers in a new country need to adapt.
trg: Na ntangu nge ke zieta na insi ya nzenza mbala ya ntete, nge ke tala bantu kele na luvibudulu na ngwilu, kuzaba sambu na insi ya nzenza bantu ya ke sala nzietelo fwete kulongoka ndiatulu ya malumalu.

src: People may not anticipate that patience and understanding are also necessary for travellers returning home.
trg: Bantu lenda kuyita mona ve nde kuvanda na mfunu nene ti kubakisa kele bima i ya mfunu sambu na bantu ya nzietelo yai kele vutuka na bwala na bo.

src: The pyramid sound and light show is one of the most interesting things in the area for kids.
trg: Makelele mpi nsemo ya pyramide kele na kati ya bima ya mfunu ya bisika yina sambu na bana.

src: You can see the pyramids in the dark and you can see them in silence before the show begins.
trg: Nge lenda mona Pyramide na mudidi mpi nge lenda mona yo na nie na ntwala ya nsaka kuyantika.

src: Usually you always here the sound of tourists and vendors. The story of the sound and light is just like a story book.
trg: Nge ke wa mingi ndinga ya bantu ya ke sala nzietelo na biteki Kintama ya ndinga na nsamina ke mutindu buku ya kinsamu.

src: The Sphinx is set as the backdrop and the narrator of a long story.
trg: Sphynx me kusalama mutindu tuku ya siansi na kisoni ya kinsamu ya yinda.

src: The scenes are displayed on the pyramids and the different pyramids are lit up.
trg: Makambu kutulamaka na zulu ya ba pyramide ti ba pyramide ya kukesana kele na minda.

src: South Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by several nations and have the most bases, with sixteen active in 2020.
trg: Ba insi mingi ke na kusosa kuzwa ntoto ya Shetland ya sude, ina bantu talaka na 1819, yo kele na bifulu mingi na Ntalu ya 16 na 2020.

src: The archipelago lies 120 km north of the Peninsula. The largest is King George Island with the settlement of Villa Las Estrellas.
trg: Archipel kele na bakilometre 120 na nord ya péninsule. Ya nene kele Ile du roi George ti colonie ya Villa Las Estrellas.

src: Others include Livingston Island, and Deception where the flooded caldera of a still-active volcano provides a spectacular natural harbour.
trg: Bantu ya nkaka ke tanga kisanga ya Livingstone, mpi Deception wapi volcan ya caldera yina bwaka na mvula ya kele kusala kaka ke pesa libungu mosi ya mutindu na yo ya ngituka.

src: Ellsworth Land is the region south of the Peninsula, bounded by the Bellingshausen Sea.
trg: Ellsworth Land kele région na sudi ya ntoto ntama ve na masa, mfinama na nzadi ya Bellingshausen.

src: The mountains of the Peninsula here merge into the plateau, then re-emerge to form the 360 km chain of the Ellsworth Mountains, bisected by the Minnesota Glacier.
trg: Bangumba ya Peninsule ke vukanaka na bisiya yina ngumba kele ve, na ke kuvukanaka dyaka na ku yidika mulonga ya bamyongo ya Ellsworth ya bakilometre 360, me kabana na matadi ya Ngalasi ya Minnesota.

src: The northern part or Sentinel Range has Antarctica's highest mountains, the Vinson Massif, peaking at 4892 m Mount Vinson.
trg: kitini ya nore to ya Sentinel Range kele na ngumba ya zulu ya Antantique, nene na yo ya vison, kekumaka na na 4892 m ya ngumba na zina ya Mount Vinson.

src: In remote locations, without cell phone coverage, a satellite phone may be your only option.
trg: Na bisika ya ntama, yina telefone ke salaka ve, telefone ya satelita lenda vanda kima mosi mpamba ya nge lenda sadila.

src: A satellite phone is not generally a replacement for a mobile phone, as you have to be outdoors with clear line of sight to the satellite to make a phone call.
trg: Telefone ya satellite kele kibeni ve ya kutula na kisika yai telefone ya maboko ve, sambu nge fwete vanda na nganda na esika ya kumonana mbote na satellite yina sambu na kubinga.

src: The service is frequently used by shipping, including pleasure craft, as well as expeditions who have remote data and voice needs.
trg: Kisalu ke salamaka mingi mingi na maswa, mpi na babato, ti na baexpedition yayi kele na mfunu ya makambu ti nzila.

src: Your local telephone service provider should be able to give more information about connecting to this service.
trg: Muntu yayi kepesaka beno bisalu ya telefone locale lendaka kuvanda na makoki ya kupesa beno bansangu na yayi metala connexion na kisalu yayi.

src: An increasingly more popular option for those planning a gap-year is to travel and learn.
trg: Mosi nzila ya batu kuluta mingi ke pona sambu na bayina ya ke yidika kupema mvula mosi kukonda kusala kisalu kele kusala nzietelo mpi kulonguka.

src: This is especially popular with school leavers, allowing them to take a year out before university, without compromising their education.
trg: Yo ke salama mingi na nganda universite, me zabakana na bantu yonso, bo ke zwaka mvula mosi na nganda tekila bo kota na universite ya nene, konda kutula kibaka na ndongokolo ya bo.

src: In many cases, enrolling on a gap-year course abroad can actually improve your chances of moving into higher education back in your home country.
trg: Na makambu mingi, kusonika zina na katikati ya mvula na insi ntama lenda kieleka na ntangu yai lenda kuyika mabaku ya kuzwa nzila ya kutanga kelasu ya minene na kuvutuka na insi na nge.

src: Typically there will be a tuition fee to enroll in these educational programs.
trg: Mfutulu ya mbongo ya kingenga fwana vanda kana nge zola sonikisa zina na nge na mutindu ya malongi yayi.

src: Finland is a great boating destination. The "Land of a thousand lakes" has thousands of islands too, in the lakes and in the coastal archipelagos.
trg: Finlande kele insi ke yambaka bamaswa mingi. Bo ke bingaka yo "Ntoto ya mafunda ya ba nzadi ya fioti" sambu Finlande ke na mafunda ya bantoto ina na kati ya masa, na ba nzadi ya fioti, na ba Archipel na ndambu ya bangumba.

src: In the archipelagos and lakes you do not necessarily need a yacht.
trg: Nge ke na satu ya maswa ve na ba Archipel mpi Ba nzadi ya fioti.

src: Although the coastal archipelagos and the biggest lakes are indeed big enough for any yacht, smaller boats or even a kayak offer a different experience.
trg: Ata baarchipele ya pembeni ya masa ti balake ya nene kuvanda balaki ya nene sambu na yacht, bamaswa ya fioti to kutu kayak yo kepesaka kuzaba ya kuswanana.

src: Boating is a national pastime in Finland, with a boat to every seven or eight people.
trg: Ku tambula ba bota kele nzila ya kulutisa ntangu na Finland, konso sambunu to nana ya bantu kele na bota ya bo mosi.

src: This is matched by Norway, Sweden and New Zealand, but otherwise quite unique (e.g. in the Netherlands the figure is one to forty).
trg: Yo me fwetekana na yina ya Norvège, Suède, na Nouvelle Zelande, kansi ya nkaka mpi kele yo mosi ( mutindu na Hollande kizizi kele mosi kati na bizizi makumi iya).

src: Most of the distinct Baltic Cruises feature an extended stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.
trg: Mingi ya ba maswa ya Baltique ya zabakana kubikaka kutatamana ku vanda na St. Petersburg, Russie.

src: This means you can visit the historic city for a couple of full days while returning and sleeping on the ship at night.
trg: Yo ke tendula nde, nge lenda kwenda kutala mbanza yina ya mfunu na mwa bilumbu zole ya mvimba mpi kuvutuka sambu na kukwenda kulala na mpimpa na maswa.

src: If you only go ashore using shipboard excursions you will not need a separate visa (as of 2009).
trg: Kana nge ta zola sala nzietelo na maswa ya nene nge ke vanda na nsatu ya kuzwa mukanda ya Visa ve ya luswaswanu (mutindu na 2009).

src: Some cruises feature Berlin, Germany in the brochures. As you can see from the map above Berlin is no where near the sea and a visit to the city is not included in the price of the cruise.
trg: Babwatu ya nkaka kesongaka Berlin, Allemagne na mikanda. Bonso beno lenda mona na zulu ya kalati yayi kele na nsi, Berlin kele pene ya mer ti kutala ya ville kele ve na kati ya ntalu ya bwatu.

src: Travelling by plane can be a scary experience for people of all ages and backgrounds, particularly if they've not flown before or have experienced a traumatic event.
trg: Kuzieta na avio lenda tala diambu ina ke pesaka boma na bantu ya bamvula yonso na siansi yonso, sungula kana yo ke mbala ya ntete ya kuzwa avio to zwaka avio na bwabanaka na dyambu ya mpasi.

src: It is not something to be ashamed of: it is no different from the personal fears and dislikes of other things that very many people have.
trg: Yo ke kima ya kuwila nsoni ve: yo ke swaswana ve na kubanga mpi bima ya nge ke zolaka ve nge mosi na yina ya bima ya bantu mingi ke vandaka na yo.

src: For some, understanding something about how aircraft work and what happens during a flight may help to overcome a fear which is based on the unknown or on not being in control.
trg: Sambu na bamosi kubakisa kima mosi me tadila nki mutindu avion ke salaka mpi nki ke salamaka ntangu avion ke pumbuka lenda kulunga na kukatula boma ya ke kwisaka sambu na kukonda kuzaba to kukonda kudiyala.

src: Courier companies are well paid for delivering things quickly. Frequently, time is very important with business documents, merchandise or spare parts for an urgent repair.
trg: Bakompani ke fidisaka mikanda ke zwaka mfutu ya mbote na yina ti bo ke fidisaka mikanda na swalu yonso?Ntangu kele kima ya nkinzi na mikanda ya kisalu, bifunda, kesadika ntangu na yina me tadila kuyidika ya kima na ntinu.

src: On some routes, the larger companies have their own planes, but for other routes and smaller firms there was a problem.
trg: Sambu na kuzieta na banzila ya nkaka ba kompani na nene ke vandaka na ba avio ya bo, kansi sambu na ba nzika ya nkaka mpi ba kompani ya fioti yo kele diambu ya mpasi.

src: If they sent things by air freight, on some routes it may have taken days to get through unloading and customs.
trg: Kana Bo me fidisa bima na nzila ya avio, yo lenda baka bilumbu mingi na banzila ya nkaka na ku basisa yo mpi kufuta mpaku.

src: The only way to get it through faster was to send it as checked luggage. Airline regulations will not allow them to send luggage without a passenger, which is where you come in.
trg: Nzila ya kukwenda ntinu na yo vandaka kufidisa yo mutindu nkutu Bo me fimpa.bansiku ya nzia mupepe ke pesa bo nzila ve na kufidisa nku kodwa kizieti, ke na kisika nge me katukla.

src: The obvious way of flying in first or business class is to fork out a thick wad of money for the privilege (or, better yet, get your company to do it for you).
trg: Mfunu ya kuzietila na mupepe na kisika ya ntete to ya nzole kele ku losa mafunda ya bamgongo sambu na lulendo (to, be to lenda tuba, nge fwana bika kompani ya nge ku futila nge mbongo).

src: However, this does not come cheap: as rough rules of thumb, you can expect to pay up to four times the normal economy fare for business, and eleven times for first class!
trg: Kansi, yo ke kuma ntalu fioti ve: kaka bonso nsiku ya mfinama, nge lenda kukinga nde nge futa mbala iya kuluta yina ya bantu ya Classe Economie ke futaka na ntangu ya mbote, mpi mbala kumi na mosi kuluta premiere classe.

src: Generally speaking, there is no point in even looking for discounts for business or first-class seats on direct flights from A to B.
trg: Na mpila ya nene, mfunu kele ve ya kusosa kukitisa ntalu na bakiti ya ntete to na klase ya ntete na kati ya bavion yayi kekwendaka mbala mosi ya A tii na B.

src: Airlines know well that there is a certain core group of flyers who are willing to pay top dollar for the privilege of getting somewhere fast and in comfort, and charge accordingly.
trg: Bakompani ya baavion bokezabaka mbote kimvuka ya bantu mefuta mbongo na bo sambu na kusala voyage ya nswalu mpi kuvanda mbote na kisika, ti mpi kufuta na ntwala.

src: The capital of Moldova is Chişinău. The local language is Romanian, but Russian is widely used.
trg: Bwala kimfumu ya Moldavie kele Chişinău. Ndinga ya bwala kele ki Roumain, kansi bo ke tubaka mingi mpi Russe.

src: Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has suffered from ethnic conflict.
trg: Moldavie kele insi ya makanda mingi ya me mona mpasi mingi na kukonda kuwakana ya makanda yina.

src: In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of the self-proclaimed Transnistria Republic in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency but is not recognised by any UN member country.
trg: Na 1994, kuswana yayi yo nataka bo na kusala République autoproclamée ya Transnistrie na este ya Moldavie, yo kele na guvernema ti mbongo na yo mosi nkansi yo kezabanaka ve bonso bwala mosi ya ONU.

src: Economic links have been re-established between these two parts of Moldova despite the failure in political negotiations.
trg: Mikanganu ya mimbongo yo salamaka na kati ya biteni zole yayi ya Moldavie ata kuzanga ya disolo ya bantu ya politiki.

src: The major religion in Moldova is Orthodox Christian.
trg: Dibundu ya nzambi me zabakana mingi ya Moldavie kele Bankwa Kristu ya Orthodoxe.

src: İzmir is the third largest city in Turkey with a population of around 3.7 million, the second biggest port after Istanbul, and a very good transport hub.
trg: Izmir kele mbanza ya tatu ya nene ya Turquie yo kele na bantu pene ya 3,7 million, dibongo ya zole ya nene na nima ya Istambul ti kisika mosi ya mbote ya transport.

src: Once the ancient city of Smyrna, it is now a modern, developed, and busy commercial center, set around a huge bay and surrounded by mountains.
trg: Yina mbanza ya Smyrna ya ntama ntama kumaka mbanza ya yimpa, ya kuzanguka na vandaka na zandu ya nene na kati ya bwala, zungidilaka ntwala ya masa na myongo.

src: The broad boulevards, glass-fronted buildings and modern shopping centers are dotted with traditional red-tiled roofs, the 18th century market, and old mosques and churches, although the city has an atmosphere more of Mediterranean Europe than traditional Turkey.
trg: Banzila ya nene, ba bâtiments ya bitalatala ti bisika ya kutekila ya bubu yomesalama na batole ya bwala ya mbwaki, zandu ya 18ème siècle ti ya ba mosquées ya ntama ti banzonzambi, Ata bwala kimfumu kele na mpila ya mosi ya méditerranéenne kuluta ya Turquie traditionnelle.

src: The village of Haldarsvík offer views of the nearby island Eysturoy and has an unusual octagonal church.
trg: Bwala ya Haldarsvík ke tadisaka kumona ya mbote na zulu ya kisanga ya mfinama ya Eysturoy mpi kele na nzo-nzambi ya Octogonale ya mutindu ya bantu yonso ke monaka ve.

src: In the churchyard, there are interesting marble sculptures of doves over some tombs.
trg: Na lupangu ya nzo-nzambi kisika bo ke zikaka bantu, kele ti bifwani ya kitoko ya ya bapizio ya marbre na maziamu ya nkaka.

src: It's worth half an hour to stroll about the intriguing village.
trg: Yo ke zua nge ndambu ya ngunga na ku tambula na bwala ya mindondo.

src: To the north and within easy reach is the romantic and fascinating town of Sintra and which was made famous to foreigners after a glowing account of its splendours recorded by Lord Byron.
trg: Na nord mpi na kisika bantu lenda kuzwa yo kele siti ya Sintra mpi yai ya kuzabanaka na banzenza na nima ya masolo ya lokumu mpi kitoko yai Lord Byron kusonikaka.

src: Scotturb Bus 403 travels regularly to Sintra, stopping at Cabo da Roca.
trg: Bus ya Scotturb 403 ke kwendaka mbala na mbala na Sintra, kutelema na nzila na Cabo da Roca.

src: Also to the north visit the great Sanctuary of Our Lady of Fatima (Shrine), a place of worldwide famous Marian apparitions.
trg: Na norde, beno tala diaka Nzo-nzambi ya nene ya Notre-Dame ya Fatima (nzo-nzambi), kisika Maria ke monanaka ya me zabana na ntoto ya mvimba.

src: Please remember that you are essentially visiting a mass grave site, as well as a site that has an almost incalculable meaning to a significant portion of the world's population.
trg: Beto lomba nde nge yibuka nde nge ke na kutala kisika ya matadi mingi, mpi yai ya ntendula kele na ntalu ya kutanga ve sambu mfinama na ndambu ya mingi kuluta ya bantu ya insi.

src: There are still many men and women alive who survived their time here, and many more who had loved ones who were murdered or worked to death there, Jews and non-Jews alike.
trg: Babakala mpi bankento mingi vandaka moyo na kisika yayi, na mingi na ba yankaka zolaka nkento to bakala ba kufwaka to fwaka na kifule ya kisalu, bajuifs na ba yina vandaka ba juifs ve.

src: Please treat the site with all of the dignity, solemnity and respect it deserves. Do not make jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis.
trg: Mulemvo, sadila kisika na kuzangula yonso, kuzaba mpi buzitu yo ke pesa. Ku sala bansaka ve na yina me tadila Munkayilu to Nazis.

src: Do not deface the site by marking or scratching graffiti into structures.
trg: Kubebisa kisika ve na ku sala bansonokono ya nge na bibaka.

src: Barcelona's official languages are Catalan and Spanish. About a half prefer to speak Catalan, a vast majority understands it, and virtually everyone knows Spanish.
trg: Bandinga officielle ya Barcelone yokele Catalan ti Espagnol. Pene ya katikati ya bantu kezolaka kutuba catalan, bantu mingi kowaka mpi bantu yonso kezabaka Espagnol.

src: However, most signs are indicated only in Catalan because it is established by law as the first official language.
trg: Kansi, mingi kuluta ya bidimbu ke monana kaka na Catalan sambu bo me tula yo bonso ndinga ya ntete ya mbula-matari.

src: Yet, Spanish is also widely used in public transport and other facilities.
trg: Ndinga ya Espagnole ke tubamaka mingi na ba transporte ya bantu yonso mpi na bisadilu ya nkaka.

src: Regular announcements in the Metro are made only in Catalan, but unplanned disruptions are announced by an automated system in a wide variety of languages including Spanish, English, French, Arabic and Japanese.
trg: Bansangu mingi ya Metro ke pesamaka kaka na ndinga ya Catalan, kana yo me zenga kizonzolo ya otomatiki ke baka kisika na bandinga mingi mutindu Espangloe, Anglais, Français, Arabe na Japonais.

src: Parisians have a reputation for being egocentric, rude and arrogant.
trg: Bantu ya France me zabanka nde bo kele bwimi, ntu-ngolo, mpi lulendo.

src: While this is often only an inaccurate stereotype, the best way to get along in Paris still is to be on your best behavior, acting like someone who is "bien élevé" (well brought up). It will make getting about considerably easier.
trg: Ata yo kele mpenza ve bandinga ya mbote ve, mpila mosi ya mbote ya kuwakana na Paris yokele ya kuvanda na kifu na nge ya mbote mingi, kusala bonso muntu yayi kele na "education" ya mbote (education ya mbote). Yayi tasadisa na pete bakutambula na beno.

src: Parisians' abrupt exteriors will rapidly evaporate if you display some basic courtesies.
trg: Nganda ya ngumba ya ngolo ya Paris ta vila nswalu kana nge songa bikalulu ya ntete ya kuzinga mbote na bantu ya nkaka.

src: The Plitvice Lakes national park is heavily forested, mainly with beech, spruce, and fir trees, and features a mixture of Alpine and Mediterranean vegetation.
trg: Parc national ya laki ya Plitvice yo ke vandaka ti nfinda, mingimingi banti ya nene, baepinete, mpi yo ke vandaka ti nfinda to bimenina ya alpine ti méditerranée.

src: It has a notably wide variety of plant communities, due to its range of microclimates, differing soils and varying levels of altitude.
trg: Yo kele na bakominote ya mingi ya banti kemonana nene, na mfunu ya mpila na yo ya microclimats, ya bantoto ya kukesana ti ndelo ya altitude kele mpila mosi ve.

src: The area is also home to an extremely wide variety of animal and bird species.
trg: Bambisi ti bandeke mingi kibeni ya mutindu na mutindu ke vandaka mpi na kisika yina.

src: Rare fauna such as the European brown bear, wolf, eagle, owl, lynx, wild cat and capercaillie can be found there, along with many more common species
trg: Bambisi ya ke monanaka diaka ve bonso ours ya mbwaki ya mputu, mbwa ya mfinda, ngo-zulu, kinkutunkutu, pusu ya makasi, pusu ya mfinda mpi ngwadi lenda kumonana kuna, kisika mosi na bima mingi ya bantu me zaba.

src: While visiting the monasteries, women are required to wear skirts covering the knees and have their shoulders covered, too.
trg: Na ntangu ya vizite ya bamonastères, bankento fwete lata bajipe ya mezipa mabolongo na bo ti bozipa diaka mapeka na bo mpi.

src: Most of the monasteries do provide wraps for women who come unprepared, but if you bring your own, especially one with bright colors, you'll get a smile from the monk or nun at the entrance.
trg: Bamonastere mingi ke pesaka bilele ya kufika na bankento ya ke kwisa nkatu kuyilama, kansi kana nge nata ya nge mosi, mingimingi yina ya kele bula meso na langi, ba moine/to bamasele yina ta sekisa nge na kukota na nge.

src: Along the same line, men are required to wear trousers covering the knees.
trg: Na nzila mosi, bo ke lombaka babakala na kulwata bapantalo yina ke fika mabolongo.

src: This too can be borrowed from the stock at the entrance but that clothing isn't washed after every user so you may not feel comfortable wearing these skirts. One size fits all for men!
trg: Yai mpi bo lenda defa yo na butiki na kukotila, kansi lele yina lenda kusukwama ve na nima ya muntu yonso ya ke Lata yo, mpidina nge lenda kuwa mbote ve na kulata binkutu yai, kaka mezure mosi kulunga bayakala yonso.

src: Majorcan cuisine, like that of similar zones in the Mediterranean, is based on bread, vegetables and meat (specially pork), and uses olive oil throughout.
trg: Kikunku ya bantu ya Mayorc, kele mutindu kikuku ya Distrike bantu ya Mediterranee, yo me ke kusalamaka na mapa, ndunda pe ngombe (mingi ngombe ya ngulu) na bo ke kusadilaka luile ya olive.

src: A simple popular dinner, especially during the summer, is the Pa amb Oli: Bread with olive oil, tomato, and any available condiments such as cheese, tunafish, etc.
trg: Kudia mosi ya simple, mingi mingi na ntangu ya Eté, yokele Pa amb Oli: Ndimba ya mafuta ya olive, ya tomate ti ya baepise yonso bonso fromaje, thon, ti ya nkaka.

src: All nouns, alongside the word Sie for you, always begin with a capital letter, even in the middle of a sentence.
trg: Bazina yonso, na ngambu ya ndinga Sie sambu na beno, yo ke bandaka ntangu yonso na letele ya nene, ata na katikati ya ndinga.

src: This is an important way to distinguish between some verbs and objects.
trg: Yai ikdle nzila ya kuluta mfunu ya kusL luswaswanu ngongo ya kusala (verbe) ti bima.

src: It also arguably makes reading easier, though writing is somewhat complicated by the need to find out whether a verb or adjective is used in a substantivized form.
trg: Bo lenda mpi simba nde yo ke kumisa kutanga pete, ata kusonika kele mpasi na mpusa ya kuzaba kana ngogo ya kusala (verbe), ya songa bikalulu (adjectif) lenda kusalama na mutindu ya ngogo kaka (mot).

src: Pronunciation is relatively easy in Italian since most words are pronounced exactly how they are written
trg: Kutanga bisono kele pete mingi na Italien sambu bangogo ke tangamaka kaka mutindu yo ke ya kusonama.

src: The main letters to watch out for are c and g, since their pronunciation varies based on the following vowel.
trg: Bisono yina nge fwete tanga kele C na G, sambu ntangulu ya bo kele ya luswaswanu na kutala bisono bambanu ya alafabe na zina ya voyelles.

src: Also, make sure to pronounce r and rr differently: caro means dear, whereas carro means chariot.
trg: Mpi, zaba kutanga mpi kuswasikisa r na rr: caro zola kuwakana nduku ya kuzolakana, na lweka ya nkaka carro zola kuwakana kamio ya ba pine iya.

src: Persian has a relatively easy and mostly regular grammar.
trg: Ndinga ya Perse kele ti gramere mpi bangogo ya pete mpi ya me zabana.

src: Therefore, reading this grammar primer would help you learn much about Persian grammar and understand phrases better.
trg: Yo yina, kutanga bangogo yai ya luyantiku ya gramere yai ta sadisa nge na kulonguka mambu mingi ya me tala gramere ya Perse mpi na kubakisa bansa mbote.

src: Needless to say, if you know a Romance language, it will be easier for you to learn Portuguese.
trg: Yo ke mfunu ya kutuba ve, kana nge kuzaba ndinga ya romance, yo ta vanda pete sambu na kulonguka Portugese.

src: However, people who know a little Spanish may hastily conclude that Portuguese is close enough that it need not be studied separately.
trg: Yo yina, batu yai ke zabaka ndinga ya Espagne mwa fioti lenda sukisa na nswalu nde ndinga ya portugais kele ya pene-pene ti espagnol mfunu ya kulonguka yo kele ve.

src: Pre-modern observatories are usually obsolete today, and remain as museums, or sites of education.
trg: Ba observatoire ya ntangu ya ntama ke vandaka diaka ve na mfunu bubu, mpi yo me kumaka kaka ba mize, to bisika ya kulonga.

src: As light pollution in their heyday was not the kind of problem it is today, they are usually located in cities or at campuses, easier to reach than those built in modern times.
trg: Kubeba ya fioti ya mupepe vandaka ve diambu ya ngolo mutindu yo kele bubu yai, yo ke vandaka mbala mingi na bambanza to na ba campus, yo ke vandaka pete na kumona yo kuluta yina bo ke salaka na bilumbu na beto.

src: Most modern research telescopes are enormous facilities in remote areas with favorable atmospheric conditions.
trg: Batelescope mingi ya bansosa ya bilumbu na beto kele bisika ya nene ya kele ntama mpi yo ke vandaka na mupepe ya mbote.

src: Cherry blossom viewing, known as hanami, has been a part of Japanese culture since the 8th century.
trg: Nti ya mbuma ya Cerise, yina me zabana na zina ya hanami, vandaka na kintama ya bana ya Japon banda na bamvula nkama 8.

src: The concept came from China where plum blossoms were the flower of choice.
trg: Ngindu yina katukaka na Chine kisika ya prune vandaka kisika ya kuzolakana mingi.

src: In Japan, the first cherry blossom parties were hosted by the emperor only for himself and other members of the aristocracy around the Imperial Court.
trg: Na Japon, makaya ya ntete ya ba mbuma ya selize natwaka na ntinu sambu na yandi mosi na binama ya nkaka ya luyalu ya bamvuama kati na nzo ya Ntinu.

src: Plants look their best when in a natural environment, so resist the temptation to remove even "just one" specimen.
trg: Bayiti ke basikaka mbote kana yo me kunwa na kisikaya mbote, yo ke vandaka ngolo Ata bantu lenda vuza ata kifwani ya yiti "mosi".

src: If visiting a formally arranged garden, collecting "specimens" is also going to get you ejected, without discussion.
trg: Kana nge ke kwenda kutala dilanga ya nge yidikaka na ntwala, kulokuta, "bima ya ntama" ta basisa nge na nganda, kukonda lisolo.

src: Singapore is generally an extremely safe place to be and very easy to navigate, and you can buy almost anything after arriving.
trg: Singapour ke kisika ya mbote, ya ngemba na kuzinga na ya mbote na kutambula, nge lenda sumba konso kima na kukuma ya nge.

src: But being placed in the "high tropics" just a few degrees north of equator you will need to deal with both heat (always) and strong sun (when the sky is clear, more rarely).
trg: Kansi, sambu yo kele na "zulu ya tropique" kaka ba degre fioti na norde ya equateur, nge ta kutana ti ntangu (mbala mingi) mpi mwini ya ngolo (kana zulu ke ya kukanguka, mbala mingi ve).

src: There are also a few buses going north to Hebron, the traditional burial place of the Biblical patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and their wives.
trg: Babakamio ya fyoti ke kwendaka na norde ya Hebron, kisika bo zikaka ba-nkaka yina Biblia ke tubilaka bonso Abrahami, Izaki. Yakobo, mpi bankento na bo.

src: Check that the bus you are thinking of taking goes into Hebron and not just to the nearby Jewish settlement of Kiryat Arba.
trg: Tala ntete kana bisi ya nge ke yindula kubaka ke kwendaka na Hébron mpi kaka ve na kimvuka ya Bayuda ya pene-pene ya Kiryat Arba.

src: Inland waterways can be a good theme to base a holiday around.
trg: Banzila ya masa ya kati kati lenda kuvanda kisika ya mbote sambu na conge.

src: For example visiting castles in the Loire Valley, the Rhine valley or taking a cruise to interesting cites on the Danube or boating along the Erie Canal.
trg: Mbandu, kukwenda kutala banzo ya ntama/châteaux ya vallée de la Loire, ya vallée du Rhin to ya kutambula na bambanza ya mfunu na Danube to kusala maswa na mfinama ya Canal Érié.

src: They also define routes for popular hiking and cycling trails.
trg: Bo me yidika mpi banzila ya bantu ke sadilaka velo.

src: Christmas is one of the most important holidays of Christianity, and is celebrated as the birthday of Jesus.
trg: Nkinsi ya Lubutuku kele kilumbu ya kuluta nene ya Bakristu, mpi bo ke kumisaka yo bonso lubutuku ya Yesu.

src: Many of the traditions surrounding the holiday have been adopted also by non-believers in Christian countries and non-Christians around the world.
trg: Mingi ya binkulu ya bo ke sadilaka na bankinzi, bo me ndimaka yo mpi na bantu yina ke ndimaka ve na ba insi ya Bukristu mpi na ba insi ya Bukristu ve na ntoto ya mvimba.

src: There's a tradition to pass the Easter night awake at some exposed point to see the sunrise.
trg: kele na bansiku ya bambuta ya kuluta mpimpa ya Pasika nkatu kulala sambu na kutula na kisika mosi sambu na kutala mutindu ntangu ke basika.

src: There are of course Christian theological explanations for this tradition, but it may well be a pre-Christian Spring and Fertility ritual.
trg: Mpidina ntendula na malongi na Bakristu kele ya kieleka na bisalu ya ntama, kansi yo lenda vanda mbote nkinsi mosi ya ntangu na ntwala ya Bakristu ya kumenina mpi ua kubuta.

src: More traditional churches often hold an Easter Vigil on Saturday night during the Easter weekend, with the congregations often breaking into celebration at the stroke of midnight to celebrate Christ's resurrection.
trg: Mbala mingi, mabundu mingi ya ntama ke kembisaka Pake na Mposo na nkokila na wikende ya Pake, mpi mbala mingi mabundu ke salaka bafete na mpimpa sambu na kukumisa lufutumuku ya Kristu.

src: All animals that originally arrived in the islands came here either by swimming, flying or floating.
trg: Bambisi yonso ya kumaka kuna na luyantiku, kumaka na bisanga yina na kukasa masa na kupumbuka to na kutepa.

src: Due to the long distance from the continent mammals were unable to make the journey making the giant tortoise the primary grazing animal in the Galapagos.
trg: Na kikuma ya ntama katuka na ntoto bambisi lungaka ve kukwenda na nzietelo kumisaka kafulu ya nene mbisi ya ke monana mingi na matiti ya Galapos.

src: Since the arrival of man to the Galapagos, many mammals have been introduced including goats, horses, cows, rats, cats and dogs.
trg: Banda ntangu muntu tulaka makulu ya yandi na Galapagos, bambisi mingi ya nkento nataka mutindu, mameme, bampunda, bangombe, bampuku, baniawu mpi bangulu.

src: If you visit the Arctic or Antarctic areas in the winter you will experience the polar night, which means that the sun doesn't rise above the horizon.
trg: Kana nge kwenda kutala bisika ya Arctiques to ya Antarctiques na nsungi ya madidi, nge ta mona bampimpa ya pole, yo ke tendula nde ntangu ke basikaka ve na zulu.

src: This offers a good opportunity to see the Aurora borealis, as the sky will be dark more or less around the clock.
trg: Yo ke pesaka nzila ya mbote na kutala Aurora Borealis, sambu dizulu ke kuma ndombe mingi to fioti na kitalulu ntangu.

src: As the areas are sparsely populated, and light pollution therefore often not a problem, you will also be able to enjoy the stars.
trg: Sambu bisika yina kele ve ti bantu mingi, mpi nsemo ke vandaka ve kigonsa sambu na kisika bo ke zinga, nge lenda sepela na kumona bambwetete.

src: Japanese work culture is more hierarchical and formal that what Westerners may be used to.
trg: Mpila ya kisalu ya japon ke landaka ndonga ya kimfumu mpi bansiku kuluta yai ya bantu ya Mputu ke sadilaka mbala na mbala.

src: Suits are standard business attire, and coworkers call each other by their family names or by job titles.
trg: Bakazaka kele bilele ya kisalu yina bantu mingi ke sadilaka, mpi banduku ya kisalu ke binganaka na bazina na bo to na zina ya bisalu ya bo ke salaka.

src: Workplace harmony is crucial, emphasizing group effort rather than praising individual accomplishments.
trg: Kuwakana na kisika ya kisalu kele kima mosi ya nfunu mingi, kisalu ya kimvuka kele nfunu kuluta bisalu ya muntu yandi mosi.

src: Workers must often get their superiors' approval for any decisions they make, and are expected to obey their superiors' instructions without question.
trg: Bantu ya kisalu fwete baka ntangu yonso kundimama ya bamfumu na bo sambu na balukanu yonso yai bo bakaka mpi bo fwete lemfukila malongi ya bantwadisi na bo na kukonda kuyufula.
